chapters.title: Chapter 751: Focus
paragraphs: The assistants whispered among themselves, while the patient and the onlookers arduously kept up a conversation. However, Ling Ran who was the chief surgeon did not utter a single word as he operated on Tian Guozheng.

If he were operating on Tian Guozheng in Yun Hua Hospital, Ling Ran would only need an assistant who would be operating the arthroscope to execute the surgery. This was also why he brought Yu Yuan and Ma Yanlin to Brazil. Lu Wenbin and Zhang Anmin were more skilled compared to them, and while Ling Ran was not around, they could operate on more patients. This way, they could gain more experience while filling up the hospital beds that became empty after patients got discharged.
Of course, it would be impossible for them to fill up all the hospital beds. But by the time there were a lot of empty hospital beds, Ling Ran should be back in Yun Hua Hospital already.
Overall, Ling Ran was very relaxed and at ease.

As the patient, Tian Guozheng was tremendously nervous. His butler was also very nervous, and even the doctors who were standing around the operating table and watching the surgery were feeling the stress. However, Ling Ran was not the kind of person who got affected by the atmosphere around him.

The atmosphere around Ling Ran was often weird. For unknown reasons, the people around him would be anxious, stressed, shy, or experience other emotions. Hence, Ling Ran had long since avoided analyzing the thought processes of those around him. Not only were they disorderly, but they were also illogical.
It had always been Ling Ran’s habit to focus on his own tasks.
As long as he carried out his own tasks well, all the problems around him would be solved automatically. This had always been the way Ling Ran functioned, and today was no exception.
In reality, as the surgery progressed, the attitude of the people around Ling Ran changed too.

Yu Yuan and Ma Yanlin who were acting as assistants have come to realize that the progress of the surgery would not be affected by the patient’s anxiety or the cameras around them. Hence, they became more focused. Department Director Li, Wallace, and the other doctors watching the surgery saw that Ling Ran had no desire to engage in conversation at all and was fully focused on the surgery. Moreover, they could not help but focus on the operating table when they saw that the surgery was progressing without a hitch.

The random onlookers in the operating theater, including Brandon, who was uploading images and videos to the internet, were swept along by Ling Ran’s momentum. The way Ling Ran was focused on the surgery had affected them and changed the way they thought, and they focused on the surgery as well.

Brandon, who was holding the camera, started talking about the surgery itself. “Arthroscopy is a type of keyhole surgery. An incision that functions as the keyhole is made on the knee, and the arthroscope which functions as the key is inserted into the incision. It’s just like opening a lock with a key. Of course, the difference between opening a lock and performing arthroscopy is that arthroscopy involves plenty of tools...”
Next to Brandon, the butler said nonchalantly, “Opening a lock requires a lot of tools too...”

Brandon paused for a moment and said, “The difference between arthroscopy and opening a lock is that during arthroscopy, we can see what’s going on inside the knee joint on the screen through the use of an endoscope.”
“You can do the same when opening a lock too. You can see what’s going on inside the keyhole on the screen...” The butler continued arguing about this based entirely on the standpoint of an outsider.
Brandon hummed in acknowledgment and said slowly as he looked at the butler, “Which is why I said that arthroscopy is a type of keyhole surgery.”
The butler gave him a thumbs up.

“In conclusion, the good thing about arthroscopy is that it inflicts a small amount of pain, there’s low chances of infection, and the recovery time is short. You guys shouldn’t underestimate these benefits. When it comes to orthopedic surgery, infection is a very serious problem. Most complications that occur as a result of orthopedic surgeries are caused by infection. The advent of arthroscopy lowers the risk of infection and makes things a lot better for patients.” Brandon explained things without going in-depth.
He had uploaded a few hundred videos to YouTube and already knew how the viewers were like. Hence, he would not go in-depth when talking about medical stuff.
When Tian Guozheng, who was receiving surgery, heard what Brandon said, he became a little calmer.

His English was pretty good. Not only could he understand what Brandon was saying, but he was also able to detect the hidden meaning behind Brandon’s words. He could feel that the surgery was going pretty well, and his entire being relaxed.
Soon, Ling Ran shifted his gaze away from the screen.
Tian Guozheng, who had been paying close attention to Ling Ran, became anxious again. He fixed his gaze on Ling Ran as he wanted to know what Ling Ran was about to do.
The butler smiled and said, “Mister Guozheng, it’s normal even for thieves who are opening safe deposit boxes to take a short break.”
Tian Guozheng grunted and asked, “Does my knee look like a safe deposit box to you?”
“Your knee is more precious than a safe deposit box.” The butler bowed a little.
Tian Guozheng flashed a satisfied smile.
This was when Ling Ran nodded and said, “The surgery is almost over. Ma Yanlin, I’ll leave the rest up to you.”
Ling Ran habitually stepped aside and made way for Ma Yanlin.
“Wait a moment!” Tian Guozheng shouted. He continued, “Doctor Ling, you should finish what you started. I don’t feel comfortable with someone else operating on me.”

Ling Ran hesitated for a moment. Many patients had made similar requests to him. However, most of them would only ask him to finish off the surgery. They would not talk about how they were not comfortable with someone else operating on them. After all, ordinary patients would not want to offend any doctor, even if the doctor was only a junior doctor like Ma Yanlin.
However, in this case, Ma Yanlin did not dare to offend a patient like Tian Guozheng. He quickly said, “Doctor Ling, why don’t you do it instead? I’m worried that my hands would tremble.
“Why would your hands tremble?” Ling Ran furrowed his eyebrows. Shaky hands was a major problem for doctors.

When Ma Yanlin saw Ling Ran’s solemn expression, he quickly said, “That’s not what I meant. I’m just thinking about how after we traveled all the way to Brazil, Mister Guozheng treated us to a feast of tremendously delicious beef. Doctor Ling, why don’t you close the incision for Mister Guozheng? You’re better at suturing, and the stitches would look nicer.”

Ling Ran glanced at the growing hair on Tian Guozheng’s shaved leg and said, “If you guys don’t want to do it, I’ll close the incision. But with the patient’s condition right now, the stitches would not look nice no matter what.”
After Ling Ran finished speaking, he examined the patient’s knee joint and aspirated the fluid out of the patient’s joint cavity. He then took a needle holder and started closing the incision.
Yu Yuan, who was standing beside Ling Ran, reminded him. “Doctor Ling, the patient is under local anesthesia.”
“I know,” Ling Ran replied. He then turned and asked, “Did I say something wrong just now?”
Yu Yuan stayed silent for a few seconds before she answered, “It’s true that you didn’t really watch your words.”

Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgment. He then thought about what he had said for a moment and added, “By closing the incision, I can at most make sure that the patient’s knee looks like how it used to. But the patient’s knee doesn’t look nice, to begin with...”
“Doctor Ling,” Yu Yuan cut Ling Ran off. “Why don’t we focus on the surgery?”
“Sure.” Ling Ran lowered his head. He attached a surgical thread to the needle holder and made a knot.

Tian Guozheng experienced conflicting emotions after he heard what Ling Ran said. He wanted to refute Ling Ran’s statement, but when he raised his head and saw how Ling Ran looked like as he focused on the surgery, he could not help but sigh and say, “Doctor Ling looks really handsome.”
Everyone in the operating theater nodded in unison.
After Ling Ran finished closing the incision, he stepped aside again and said, “You guys will be applying the surgical dressing and bandaging the incision.”
Yu Yuan and Ma Yanlin did not say no this time. They quickly stepped forward and got to work.
Tian Guozheng grunted in slight displeasure, and the butler quickly asked, “Doctor Ling, why are you stopping again?”

Yu Yuan replied on Ling Ran’s behalf, “You’ve watched documentaries where lions eat the meat of their prey, haven’t you? But have you seen lions licking the bones of their prey clean? Bandaging is akin to licking the bones clean.”
“So... this means that you’re vultures?” Tian Guozheng nodded in understanding.
Yu Yuan parted her mouth a little. She wanted to retort, but she suddenly realized that what the other party was saying made a lot of sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 752: In Front of the Manor
paragraphs: In the morning, warm sunlight shone on the bed. The person covered by the blanket looked like he was covered by yellow sand. It was so calm and holy that it made others have the urge to kneel down.
Ling Ran felt the excitement of the sunlight and had his eyelashes flutter. Then, he slowly opened his eyes.

A young lady immediately walked forward and used her trained voice that will first make her speak softly before she increased the volume of her voice and gently asked, “Doctor Ling, are you awake? What do you want to get?”
Ling Ran quirked an eyebrow. “What?”

“Breakfast. Do you want to have your breakfast?” A sincere smile was seen on the face of this beautiful lady instead of a professional smile. She was very good with the professional smile, but when she saw such a handsome doctor like Ling Ran, she would naturally smile sincerely. She could not even use her professional smile even if she wanted to do so.
Ling Ran breathed out and brought out one of his arms from under the blanket. Then, he sensed the temperature outside and asked again, “How did you get in?”

“I just pushed the door to come in,” the beautiful lady said gently, “I’m a maid of the manor, Selena. I’m Sino-Portuguese, so I can speak Mandarin, Portuguese, and English. If you need any help, you are welcome to find me anytime.”
“Oh,” Ling Ran replied, and he was still immersed in the condition of the room. He continued to ask, “I remember that I had locked the door yesterday.”
“I don’t quite know that. But when I came up just now, the butler opened the door to do some checking.”
“The butler entered my room too?”
“It’s because Mister Tian Guozheng wanted to express his gratitude to you. He deliberately reminded the butler to ensure your stay is comfortable. That’s why he sent the butler to check your room.”
Ling Ran was silent for a few seconds and said, “Since Mister Tian Guozheng’s surgery is completed, I want to go back home as soon as possible.”

“But...” Selena hesitated for a few seconds, opened her eyes widely and said, “Mister Tian Guozheng is a super-rich man. He’ll provide you with a lucrative service as your host and introduce some Brazillian stars to you. Do you like soccer? Brazil has the most soccer athletes. If Doctor Ling requested it, Mister Tian Guozheng should be able to invite them. He used to invite the sports stars to the parties he threw last time.”
“Is there any soccer athlete who got knee injuries or had their Achilles tendons torn?” Ling Ran sat up, as it was improper to lie down.

Selena felt disappointed when she saw Ling Ran wearing pajamas. She pouted and remembered what Ling Ran said. She felt amused and said, “If you must have soccer athletes who have knee injuries or their Achilles tendons injured, Mister Tian Guozheng should be able to look for them for you. Otherwise, we can pay them to ride a horse...”
Selena immediately closed her mouth, “I was rambling.”
“Rambling?” Ling Ran felt lost.
Selena instantly relaxed and quickly asked, “What breakfast would you like to have?”
“What choices do you have?”
“We have many choices for breakfast. You can choose anything you like.” Selene smiled lightly.
“Deep-fried dough sticks and tofu pudding,” Ling Ran immediately answered.
Selena blinked, smiled faintly, and said, “I understand.”
Ling Ran started to brush up after she went out.
After brushing up, he saw a sumptuous breakfast laid out on the table. There were deep-fried dough sticks, fried eggs, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, bacon, hot dogs, grilled meat, porridge, and...
“Mapo tofu?” Ling Ran looked at the bowl in front of him.
“The chef said that it’s like tofu pudding broken into pieces.” Selena nodded seriously.
Ling Ran looked at Selena and said seriously, “This is Mapo tofu.”

“Impossible. We have hosted Chinese before, and they said it was very delicious. It is tofu pudding.” Selena suddenly remembered something. She quickly took out her phone and said, “Let me do a search.”
Ling Ran then picked other food and ate it. When he was almost full, he saw that Selena had finished her search and stared blankly at her phone.
“You found it?”
“Yes. The chef lied to me since young and said that this is tofu pudding.” Selena’s trust of people, the world, and values seemed to be broken.
Ling Ran just wanted to ensure that she was not mentally-ill and nodded. Then, he said, “I’ll go out and take a walk.”
After he said that, Ling Ran went out and went down the floor.
The beautiful Selena stared at the big mirror in the room and felt even sadder.
In front of the manor, a few cowboys used wood to build a long bench and a small hut.
Yu Yuan and Ma Yanlin woke up very early. They were holding a cup of tea, leaning against the wall, and looking at them working.
When they did not have to perform surgeries with Ling Ran, both of them felt very free but empty at the same time.
“Doctor Ling.” Ma Yanlin was the first to see Ling Ran. He greeted him, smiled, and said, “Do you know what they are doing?”
Ling Ran shook his head.

They’re making a rehabilitation room,” Ma Yanlin said with an impressed tone, “Can you imagine it? We told him that once he can walk around, he can start with rehabilitation. The patient asked for specific requirements, and they started building a rehabilitation room.”
Ling Ran looked at the long corridor that was dozens of feet long and asked, “Isn’t that really long? Didn’t you tell him about the specifications?”

“He said that he will not turn back once he starts rehabilitation. That’s why he intends to build a 656 feet corridor to connect this place to the shieling. It will be more convenient for him to look at the horses during rainy days.” Ma Yanlin was so envious that he was drooling. “Those are all high-grade logs. If I had so many good logs, I’d bring them back to the country and sell them back to Lu Wenbin...”
Yu Yuan laughed out loud when she heard that. She raised her head and looked at Ma Yanlin’s chin, “Your good-for-nothing look is quite similar to Lu Wenbin’s.”
“Doctor Ling.” Tian Guozheng came down while he was in the wheelchair.

Some patients who received knee arthroscopy recovered slower, and they might only be able to get down from the bed after three to four days. Meanwhile, it was normal for those who recovered quickly to get down from the bed on the second day itself.

Tian Guozheng let Ling Ran perform the surgery for him. He might not dare to apply too much strength on his knee, but he looked much better. The usual pain on the knee was now replaced by the pain on the spot where the incision happened. His mood became better as the pain felt satisfying because it meant that he was getting better.

When Tian Guozheng saw Ling Ran at this moment, he smiled and said, “Doctor Ling, you woke up so early. Have you eaten your breakfast? Zheng’s Farm is famous for its sumptuous breakfast. Usually, it has more than thirty types of breakfast. Our head chef knows how to make dishes from more than thirty countries, and it can satisfy everyone.”
Ling Ran nodded slightly.

Tian Guozheng was used to Ling Ran’s attitude too. He smiled and said, “Doctor Ling, Ma Yanlin, both of you are not in a hurry to go back, right? Is there any activity that you like? I can arrange them for you.”
Ma Yanlin turned around and noticed that Ling Ran was thinking about something. He immediately said, “Doctor Ling, if we go back now, no hospital beds are free.”
“Okay.” Ling Ran thought about it and said, “I hope to perform surgery for Brazillian sports stars.”
Tian Guozheng looked at Ling Ran’s handsome face, sighed, dug his ears, and said, “I might have heard wrongly just now. You want to get signatures from Brazillian sports stars?”
“The informed consent forms must be signed, of course.” Ling Ran reinterpreted Tian Guozheng’s words.
Ma Yanlin patted his head and said, “Let us go for a ride then.”
“Or travel around.” Yu Yuan jumped gently.

“Oh, Doctor Yu... If you like to travel, that should not be a problem,” Tian Guozheng immediately said, “You can go with my private jet. If it is nearer, you can just take the helicopter. Brazil is very large, and the roads in some places are not very smooth to walk...”

He might not dare to apply too much strength on his knee, but he looked much better.
The usual pain on the knee was now replaced by the pain on the spot where the incision happened.
His mood became better as the pain felt satisfying because it meant that he was getting better.
When Tian Guozheng saw Ling Ran at this moment, he smiled and said, “Doctor Ling, you woke up so early.
Have you eaten your breakfast?
Zheng’s Farm is famous for its sumptuous breakfast.
Usually, it has more than thirty types of breakfast.
Our head chef knows how to make dishes from more than thirty countries, and it can satisfy everyone.”
Ling Ran nodded slightly.
Tian Guozheng was used to Ling Ran’s attitude too.
He smiled and said, “Doctor Ling, Ma Yanlin, both of you are not in a hurry to go back, right?
Is there any activity that you like?
I can arrange them for you.”
Ma Yanlin turned around and noticed that Ling Ran was thinking about something.
He immediately said, “Doctor Ling, if we go back now, no hospital beds are free.”
“Okay.” Ling Ran thought about it and said, “I hope to perform surgery for Brazillian sports stars.”
Tian Guozheng looked at Ling Ran’s handsome face, sighed, dug his ears, and said, “I might have heard wrongly just now.
You want to get signatures from Brazillian sports stars?”
“The informed consent forms must be signed, of course.” Ling Ran reinterpreted Tian Guozheng’s words.
Ma Yanlin patted his head and said, “Let us go for a ride then.”
“Or travel around.” Yu Yuan jumped gently.
“Oh, Doctor Yu...
If you like to travel, that should not be a problem,” Tian Guozheng immediately said, “You can go with my private jet.
If it is nearer, you can just take the helicopter.
Brazil is very large, and the roads in some places are not very smooth to walk...”

chapters.title: Chapter 753: Conflict
paragraphs: Yu Yuan was full of spirits when she knew she could go out and have fun.

She was truly exhausted. Forget about her role as the chief resident for the past one year prior to joining Ling Ran’s group, she had worked really hard. However, during that time, she was looked down upon by her surgical teams, so she could only put her passion in front of the computer, try hard to read medical reference books, read articles, and write articles, which were all useless skills in the eyes of many practical surgeons.
Since most surgeons thought that these were not useful skills, she had to carry on with her daily tasks. So, Yu Yuan’s life as a resident doctor was very miserable.
In comparison, the hard work she poured in during her university days was not worth mentioning at all.

During the few years in the hospital, Yu Yuan had accumulated a large amount of pressure. If not for her conditioning from handling pressure since young and the leeway of spending some time on her own hobbies, Yu Yuan might have collapsed at any moment.
Now, as Yu Yuan stood in front of the big map showed by Tian Guozheng, a beaming smile was on her face.

“I must find a place with beautiful scenery such as mountains and lakes...” Yu Yuan held her face and lost herself in imagination. “Brazil’s specialty is their grassland, right? There’s their plains too, so we will be riding horses. It will be better if we can ride a cow. The food must be simple comfort food and the accommodation should not be too bad. The distance is fine to me. After the plane lands, I’m fine even if I have to transfer to another vehicle for a few hours.”
“It’s here,” Ma Yanlin replied on her behalf.
Yu Yuan was rendered speechless.
Tian Guozheng’s manor was right beside the river and mountain. The manor itself was already a big ranch, with a racecourse and an airport. It was much better than what Yu Yuan thought.
Tian Guozheng chuckled and said, “Doctor Yu echoes my thoughts. So later, I bought this ranch and built my manor over here with this standard of judgment...”
Yu Yuan stopped being in a daze and sighed, “So, we can only play around in the manor?”
For Yu Yuan, it was more important to take a flight for the trip. What was more, it was a private jet!

Although Tian Guozheng was a strange patient, he was good at observing expressions. He laughed when he saw Yu Yuan’s expression, “I understand what you mean, Doctor Yu. What you mentioned are just some basic requirements, right? You still want an actual vacation, right?”
“Yes, yes.” Yu Yuan nodded her head readily. It was rare for her to get a chance to get out. She had the urge to let loose out there.

“I see that your request was quite similar to mine. How about this? You can look at my property first. If something catches your eye, you can visit that place and even change places during your trip. You don’t have to keep staying at the same place. That will be the easiest thing to do. If you can’t find a place you like, you can think about travelling to other places. We will find something suitable.” When Tian Guozheng finished, he said to the butler, “Go and get the aircraft personnel over here and ask everyone to brainstorm for a flight planning.”

“Now, only a few members of Flight One are here.” The butler mentioned the brand new Gulfstream that was meant for Tian Guozheng. Since there was no work for it now, it had been brought to rest in the hangar. The aircraft personnel were also stretching their legs. Meanwhile, the other partially new Gulfstream needed to bear the business responsibility from the ranch and company and had flown everywhere.
Tian Guozheng nodded casually, “You may discuss matters among yourself. I can’t go out anyway. Doctor Ling, I can’t go out and have fun, right?”
Tian Guozheng gazed at Ling Ran with wide eyes, and he hoped that the “straightforward” Doctor Ling could give him a different answer.
Ling Ran did not hesitate and said, “You can’t go out. Over the next few days, it would be good for you to lie on the bed and rest, then check on the condition of your rehabilitation.”
Tian Guozheng felt resigned and pursed his lips. Then, he saw that Yu Yuan had laid down on the map and started searching with her hands. He said to the butler, “Get Zebo Four for me to take a look.”
The butler was stunned. “Zebo Four hasn’t grown up yet.”
“Oh,” Tian Guozheng replied and said, “I just want to take a look.”
The butler looked at Tian Guozheng doubtfully and whispered, “No thief will just shut the safe after taking a peek inside.”
“My knee was injured, and I can’t eat as much meat as I want. I’m just looking at Zebo Four to ease my soul.” Tian Guozheng kept explaining with fake sincerity.
The butler looked at Tian Guozheng’s knee and said, “Then I’ll ask someone here to take a look. Coincidently, now it’s the time for it to take a walk.”
“What do the colors on the map represent?” Yu Yuan pointed at the map of America on the wall after they finished.

Finally, a normal question. The butler immediately turned around, smiled and said, “The blue dot over here means property like ranches and farms, along with the location of some factories. On another note, the dark blue color belongs to the Tian family and the light blue color belongs to Mister Tian Guozheng, who either has sole ownership over it, or has a large portion of shares over it. The indigo color belongs to other family members. For example, this land belongs to Miss Tian Qi, and it was a present given by Mister Tian Guozheng to Miss Tian Qi for her 18th birthday.”
“The gift is a ranch?” Yu Yuan blinked.

The butler smiled faintly and said, “It also comes with additional facilities. Also, there are one hundred thousand cows that are currently taken care of by the family. There is a beautiful lake and many different fishes in it. Oh, by the way, there not many mountains at the front. It also produces some mushrooms, and we can go for hunting as well as do other activities over there. It’s quite fun too...”

“There’s wildlife over there as well?” Yu Yuan could not help but remember her experience at the national wildlife zoo. She was already in holiday mood, but she did not want to decide immediately, so she grabbed the opportunity and asked, “How about the green and red colors?”
The butler said, “Green color refers to some projects carried out by Tian Guozheng’s foundation, they mainly focus on recycling. The red color is the location of Guozheng Charity Hospital.”
“There are more than ten hospitals?” Yu Yuan was surprised.

“Most of them are small hospitals with only the level of a clinic.” Tian Guozheng smiled. “The population is scarce here. The coverage of a big hospital doesn’t work here. I’m trying to set up a smaller scale hospital, and I might promote that model when I go back to China in the future.”
Yu Yuan nodded while listening and looked at Ling Ran again. She could not help but ask, “Why don’t we go to the places with hospitals? You should like it, Doctor Ling.”
“I’m not going.” Ling Ran had lost his interest when he saw Yu Yuan’s fingers swiping at the location of Amazon.

If the operating theater of the hospital was the role model for good order, then native forests like the Amazon forest would be the best example of having absolutely no order whatsoever. Maybe many people would want to have their adventure in this kind of native forests, but Ling Ran preferred staying at the operating theater and waiting for these brave warriors to come back and perform surgery for them.
Since Ling Ran had made his decision, Yu Yuan had an easier time in making hers.
Yu Yuan quickly pointed at a blue dot and said, “Why don’t we go to the Amazon forest and watch the wildlife there?”

“No problem. The Amazon rainforest has a very large surface area. Actually, it’s the same over here.” The area drawn by the butler was already a land that was worth more than a few hundred thousand square miles.
Yu Yuan looked at Ma Yanlin and asked, “Will you stay over here or have fun at the Amazon?”
Ma Yanlin looked at Yu Yuan and Ling Ran. He fell into the conflict of staying back at the hospital or having fun with poop at other places.

chapters.title: Chapter 754: Heavy Rain
paragraphs: The private jet playfully moved its rear wings a few times. It then steered upwards, sped up, and soared into the sky. Soon, only a trail of white condensation could be seen.

The butler waved a hand in front of Ma Yanlin, who had chickened out at the last minute. “Doctor Ma, is your decision final? The Amazon rainforest is a renowned rainforest after all, and it’s a pretty interesting place to visit. If you were to miss out on this opportunity, you might have to wait a few years for a chance like this to come by again. You can let me know if you have changed your mind. I can still ask the private jet to make a U-turn.”

Ma Yanlin shook his head vehemently. “The people working on the farm don’t look like they’re interested in going there, either. Even the guide looks like he was having second thoughts. Why would I go along? Moreover, Doctor Yu’s purpose of going there doesn’t align with mine.”
“But those who are older in age such as Department Director Li and Doctor Wallace went along too.”
“They don’t know what they’ve signed up for.” Ma Yanlin pursed his lips. “They’ll come back crying.”

“Yeah, the part of the Amazon rainforest where Doctor Yu wants to go is pretty remote.” When the butler saw that Ma Yanlin truly had no intention of going, he chuckled and led Ma Yanlin back to the mansion.
Even though Ma Yanlin had made his decision, he still looked tremendously conflicted.

Like what the butler said, the Amazon rainforest was pretty famous. A trip there should be a pretty good experience. Department Director Li and his entourage, who came from China, as well as Doctor Wallace and Doctor Brandon from the United Kingdom agreed to join the trip immediately because of how they had always wanted to visit the place.
However, Ma Yanlin felt tremendously anxious about going to the Amazon rainforest with Yu Yuan. Moreover, Yu Yuan was the one who planned the itinerary.

Aside from this, Zheng’s Farm was a pretty good place to stay in too. Ma Yanlin believed that it would be a great pleasure to have fun on the farm for a few days. He would get to eat plenty of meat, drink wine, and take a good rest. He would even be served by beautiful career women in maid costumes who probably made quite a lot of money.

The more Ma Yanlin thought about it, the more he believed that he had made the right choice. By the time they arrived at the main building of the mansion, Ma Yanlin was already smiling. ‘Yu Yuan can go to the rainforest to expand her collection if that’s what she wants. It is other people’s business that they chose to go with her. I’ll just lie down comfortably on the farm...’
“Doctor Ma.” A career woman in a maid costume was standing before the mansion. The moment the car stopped in front of the mansion, she greeted Ma Yanlin with a smile.
“Hello there.” Ma Yanlin greeted her with a smile too. “Where’s Doctor Ling?”

“Doctor Ling went to the horse ranch,” the maid said with a smile. “Before he left, he asked me to remind you to check on the patient three times a day: in the morning, in the afternoon, and at night. He also told you to give him a call if any problem arises.”
Ma Yanlin hummed in acknowledgement out of habit. He then immediately came back to his senses. “So, does this mean that I’m the only one responsible for checking on the patient?”

“Seems like it.” The butler looked at Ma Yanlin with a smile and said, “From what I understand, making ward rounds and checking on patients is a little like being a thief and acting as a lookout. Your job is to observe the movements of the disease and see if it’s planning a silent or large-scale attack. The moment you notice that something is off, you would notify everyone about it so that they can draw out a plan for a retreat or a counterattack based on a predetermined formula. You do have one, yes?”
“Erm... we have guidelines.”

“That’s great.” The butler seemed to be breathing a sigh of relief. He smiled at Ma Yanlin again and said, “I hope that you’ll do your job as a lookout well, then. Mister Guozheng is a treasure that must be protected at all costs.”

“Understood.” Ma Yanlin agreed, but the more he thought about it, the odder the whole thing sounded. He would have to make ward rounds thrice a day. Even though there was only one patient, the patient was a weirdo. No matter how he thought about it, he felt that he would be ripped off more than two hours of his day, every single day...

But Ma Yanlin soon thought about it from another point of view. ‘It’s fortunate that Doctor Ling is having fun at the horse ranch. If he were to have fun in the hospital, I would need to stay in the hospital and help him out for more than two hours a day.’
The thought of this put Ma Yanlin in a better mood, and he immediately felt rejuvenated. It was as if he had found a direction in life once again.

As a member of Ling Treatment Group, it was necessary to be capable of looking at the bright side of things. Even if a doctor did not possess this skill to begin with, after working in Ling Treatment Group for a while, the reality of life would force this skill out of him.
At the horse ranch, Ling Ran was riding a tame and huge horse. He took things slow and let the horse jog instead of gallop as he rode beside Tian Qi.

Tian Qi was obviously a lot better when it came to horse riding. However, she did not gallop either. She slowed down her horse so that it matched the pace of Ling Ran’s horse. As the horse advanced slowly and steadily, she even stopped her horse from overtaking Ling Ran’s horse or biting Ling Ran’s horse...
It started drizzling a little. Tian Qi was wearing a hat, and she waved her hands in the air. She felt extremely calm and relaxed.
“Doctor Ling, would you be willing to stay all year long in a farm?” Tian Qi turned and asked with a smile. She passed Ling Ran a cowboy hat while she was at it.

“Yes.” Ling Ran took the cowboy hat from Tian Qi and wore it. He continued, “A common illness among farm dwellers, hydatidosis, requires hepatectomy as a treatment. Ruptured Achilles tendons and damaged knees should be even more common in farms. As long as the farm is big enough, I can probably stay there for a long time.”
Tian Qi did not listen closely to the second half of what Ling Ran said. She merely stared at Ling Ran who was wearing a cowboy hat, and her cheeks were flushed.

After Ling Ran put on the cowboy hat, his aura changed drastically. Right now, he looked extremely fierce. Tian Qi suddenly felt like teaching Ling Ran how to ride a horse, as she wanted to see the way Ling Ran riding at a gallop across the meadow. Of course, even without doing this, he was already handsome enough.
The rain became heavier. Even though Tian Qi was a little reluctant, she called out, “Ling Ran, why don’t we go back first? Heavy downpour is very common here.”
“Sure.” Ling Ran nodded without saying much. He gazed at the mountain range before them. It looked a little blurry now. The lake near the mansion was covered with mist too.

“Let’s ride our horses back.” Tian Qi waved and called two of her bodyguards over. Without saying a word, the two young women rode their horses over. They were quick and nimble. They skillfully made a swift turn and grabbed the bridles of Tian Qi and Ling Ran’s horses. The four horses who were divided into two groups swiftly made their way back to the mansion.
Lu Junjie was also riding a horse as he came over from the other side, braving the rain. He called out loudly, “It’s raining, I’m here to fetch you guys...”
Ling Ran flashed a socially appropriate smile. Meanwhile, Tian Qi nodded politely at Lu Junjie and continued riding her horse forward as she followed Ling Ran’s horse closely.
With great effort, Lu Junjie turned his horse around. By the time he caught up with Tian Qi and Ling Ran, it was already raining so heavily that rainwater filled his mouth the moment he opened it.

Fortunately, the mansion was not far away from the horse ranch. Everyone rode their horses until they were safe from the rain under the eaves. The moment Tian Qi and Ling Ran dismounted, a group of maids crowded around them with all kinds of towels.

The maids were skillful and earnest. Some dried their hair, while some helped them with taking off their shoes. The maids even wrapped them up in thick bathrobes, and they immediately felt warm and comfortable. They then returned to the bathrooms in their respective rooms.

Lu Junjie rode toward the mansion under the rain. He dismounted the moment he was shielded from the rain by the eaves, and saw that a tall and burly man who was holding a towel was walking toward him with a smile on his face.
“Wait... ” Lu Junjie was a little hesitant.
He was a little cold. But at that very moment, his heart was even colder.
“No problem, I’m more efficient.” The tall and burly man chuckled. He then started wiping Lu Junjie down with the towel.
“Wait...” Lu Jinjie shouted, but his scream was muffled by the sounds made by the course cotton towel.
The rain was getting heavier and heavier, and the lake beside the mansion could no longer be seen clearly.
The mountain range nearby flickered in the rain, and it was as if the rain had formed a protective layer over it.
The rain continued for an hour.
And then two.
The rain fell for a day and a night.

At the horse ranch, Ling Ran was riding a tame and huge horse.
He took things slow and let the horse jog instead of gallop as he rode beside Tian Qi.
Tian Qi was obviously a lot better when it came to horse riding.
However, she did not gallop either.
She slowed down her horse so that it matched the pace of Ling Ran’s horse.
As the horse advanced slowly and steadily, she even stopped her horse from overtaking Ling Ran’s horse or biting Ling Ran’s horse...
It started drizzling a little.
Tian Qi was wearing a hat, and she waved her hands in the air.
She felt extremely calm and relaxed.
“Doctor Ling, would you be willing to stay all year long in a farm?” Tian Qi turned and asked with a smile.
She passed Ling Ran a cowboy hat while she was at it.
“Yes.” Ling Ran took the cowboy hat from Tian Qi and wore it.
He continued, “A common illness among farm dwellers, hydatidosis, requires hepatectomy as a treatment.
Ruptured Achilles tendons and damaged knees should be even more common in farms.
As long as the farm is big enough, I can probably stay there for a long time.”
Tian Qi did not listen closely to the second half of what Ling Ran said.
She merely stared at Ling Ran who was wearing a cowboy hat, and her cheeks were flushed.
After Ling Ran put on the cowboy hat, his aura changed drastically.
Right now, he looked extremely fierce.
Tian Qi suddenly felt like teaching Ling Ran how to ride a horse, as she wanted to see the way Ling Ran riding at a gallop across the meadow.
Of course, even without doing this, he was already handsome enough.
The rain became heavier.
Even though Tian Qi was a little reluctant, she called out, “Ling Ran, why don’t we go back first?
Heavy downpour is very common here.”
“Sure.” Ling Ran nodded without saying much.
He gazed at the mountain range before them.
It looked a little blurry now.
The lake near the mansion was covered with mist too.
“Let’s ride our horses back.” Tian Qi waved and called two of her bodyguards over.
Without saying a word, the two young women rode their horses over.
They were quick and nimble.
They skillfully made a swift turn and grabbed the bridles of Tian Qi and Ling Ran’s horses.
The four horses who were divided into two groups swiftly made their way back to the mansion.
Lu Junjie was also riding a horse as he came over from the other side, braving the rain.
He called out loudly, “It’s raining, I’m here to fetch you guys...”
Ling Ran flashed a socially appropriate smile.
Meanwhile, Tian Qi nodded politely at Lu Junjie and continued riding her horse forward as she followed Ling Ran’s horse closely.
With great effort, Lu Junjie turned his horse around.
By the time he caught up with Tian Qi and Ling Ran, it was already raining so heavily that rainwater filled his mouth the moment he opened it.
Fortunately, the mansion was not far away from the horse ranch.
Everyone rode their horses until they were safe from the rain under the eaves.
The moment Tian Qi and Ling Ran dismounted, a group of maids crowded around them with all kinds of towels.
The maids were skillful and earnest.
Some dried their hair, while some helped them with taking off their shoes.
The maids even wrapped them up in thick bathrobes, and they immediately felt warm and comfortable.
They then returned to the bathrooms in their respective rooms.
Lu Junjie rode toward the mansion under the rain.
He dismounted the moment he was shielded from the rain by the eaves, and saw that a tall and burly man who was holding a towel was walking toward him with a smile on his face.
“Wait... ” Lu Junjie was a little hesitant.
He was a little cold.
But at that very moment, his heart was even colder.
“No problem, I’m more efficient.” The tall and burly man chuckled.
He then started wiping Lu Junjie down with the towel.
“Wait...” Lu Jinjie shouted, but his scream was muffled by the sounds made by the course cotton towel.
The rain was getting heavier and heavier, and the lake beside the mansion could no longer be seen clearly.
The mountain range nearby flickered in the rain, and it was as if the rain had formed a protective layer over it.
The rain continued for an hour.
And then two.
The rain fell for a day and a night.

chapters.title: Chapter 755: The Collapsing Wall
paragraphs: The rain did not have any intention of letting up.
The cowboys who sat and talked happily in the manor could not wait any longer and went out to face the storm. They herded the cattle in the rain and brought them to shelter.

In such weather, herding the cattle became a dangerous task. The helicopter which was used to release the cattle to eat the grass could not fly because of the heavy rain, so the cowboys had to ride on horses and herd the cattle. The farm had many low-lying areas. When the farm started to accumulate water, the water in the low-lying area could make a cow drown. Naturally, the more likely scenario would be humans drowning.
“We’ll be losing a lot of cows this year.” The butler looked out through the window, and he was worried.
“If the cattle can survive, they will take good care of their calves.” Tian Guozheng looked serious. He straightened his body on the wheelchair and looked slightly nonchalant.
The butler nodded lightly, “We’ll run into all sorts of things in the world, regardless of whether it is good or not. I hope the best for the cowboys. Mister Guozheng, let’s go to the town.”
Tian Guozheng nodded without saying anything, but Lu Junjie, who had been by his side, could not hold it in and said, “We’re going now? The rain is so heavy that even the cars are bogged down.”
“Mister Lu, if we don’t go now, later, when the manor is fully flooded, we will not be able to leave.” The butler looked calm, as if he was looking at a silly boy who was throwing a tantrum.

Lu Junjie did not look at the butler, but he stared at Tian Guozheng and said, “Uncle Tian, your manor has been constructed with the possibility of such weather in mind, right? Being flooded will be too much of an exaggeration, isn’t it?”
Tian Guozheng smiled faintly. “Of course I had thought about it before. A true man won’t stand beside a collapsing wall.”
“Then, we’re now...”

“We can’t stand beside the collapsing wall too,” Tian Guozheng calmly said, “It’s pouring all over the state now. Judging by the looks now, it won’t stop raining heavily for two to three days. Even if we stay in the manor, we would be confined to the first floor or above. If that’s the case, why don’t we go to the town earlier and leave?”

Lu Junjie was instantly rendered speechless. If a floor was going to be flooded in the manor, then it would be considered a deluge by the standards of China. If he still insisted on not leaving, he would look very silly. At that time, not only would they not have water and electricity, but the internet might also be disconnected. Was it not stupid if he stayed in a place without internet?
“I will get the car ready.” The butler stopped nagging, quickly stood up, and went down the stairs to give instructions.
Tian Guozheng also smiled faintly and said, “Everyone should go and pack your things. Since we’ve decided, we will depart in thirty minutes.”
At this time, Tian Guozheng acted extraordinarily seriously and swiftly.
Lu Junjie was still slightly hesitant. He said in a low voice, “Since we have already decided it, why shouldn’t we just leave? Why are we still going to the town?”

“The route to leave by land requires us to pass through the town.” Tian Guozheng continued to smile faintly. “Don’t look down on the people. Even though Cuba Town is small, it has still experienced a history of more than one hundred years. Over the years, when other places were flooded, the people in Cuba Town only experienced slight inconvenience in their daily lives, but they were never in grave danger...”
Tian Guozheng intended to educate Lu Junjie. This young man was too naggy, and this affected his mood.
Lu Junje did not figure out Tian Guozheng’s hidden intention of educating him. Instead, but he kept asking him, “By ‘grave’ danger, do you mean that there is still danger?”
“Isn’t people dying from a deluge something pretty normal?” Tian Guozheng’s expression became serious. “Every person who died are young men who are full of themselves.”
Lu Junjie finally understood what he meant this time, and his expression inevitably changed.

Tian Guozheng nodded in satisfaction before he said to Ling Ran and Tian Qi in a cordial manner, “Both of you, quickly go and pack your things. If it’s too difficult to carry, just label it and let the people who stay behind move them to the top floor.”
“Are there still people staying here? Will it be too dangerous?” Tian Qi was slightly worried.

“The house still has a lot of valuable things, so I still have to get some people to look for them, otherwise, I’m afraid that some people will try to sneak in.” Tian Guozheng said in a profound manner before he continued, “After the cowboys chase the cattle to higher ground, some whose houses are nearby will come back. At that time, if the rain hasn’t stopped yet, they will take the charge boat to the town.”
“Your knees might not be suitable for riding in cars for an extended period of time.” Ling Ran reminded him at this time.
Tian Guozheng smiled. “I have a few Unimogs, it shouldn’t be a problem.”
Half an hour later, they saw Tian Guozheng’s Unimog... motorcade.
From the appearance, the Unimog which were labelled with the Mercedes-Benz logo looked more like one of those domineering but middle-sized trucks. When they were lined up in a row, it was impressive.
Lu Junjie cried out when he saw this, “Uncle Tian, you bought so many Unimogs? One may cost three to four million, right? You’ve made us a mini target.”

“The manor needs them,” Tian Guozheng pointed at the car in front as he said, “Go into the car first. The cars will leave in groups of three so that we can take care of each other without affecting each other.”
The rain outside became heavier. Lu Junjie was also suddenly worried. He turned around and looked at Tian Qi before he said, “Miss Tian should go with me. Ladies first.”
“You go first.” Tian Guozheng waved his hand and said, “There are still many cars at the back.”
Lu Junjie then got into the front seat of a Unimog. The back of this truck seemed to contain food and water. Lu Junjie felt it would be safer if he took this car.
“Hi, Mister Lu. Please fasten your seat belt. We are leaving now.” The driver waited for Lu Junjie to shut the door before he smiled and said these words. Then, he locked the car door.
Lu Junjie found the voice to be slightly familiar, so he turned around and took a look. He saw that the driver under the cowboy hat was the buff servant who had wiped his body just now.
Lu Junjie could not help but look at his rough and big hands, “Why is it you?”

“It’s that much of a coincidence.” The driver smiled and showed his gold tooth. “The butler also said I’m so lucky that even if I get into a prison car that sends prisoners on death row, I will still fall out from the car because of an accident. Alright, please be seated, I will send you to the destination safely.”
The driver stepped on the accelerator as he spoke, and the car was driven into the muddy land.
“Huh? Why aren’t you taking the road? Are we not going to town?” Lu Junjie almost jumped because of the bumpy road.

“Fasten your seat belt.” The driver reminded him before he continued, “The motorcade needs to leave separately. The rain is very heavy, and we don’t know about the situation on our way to town. We’re taking the alternate road. This road was developed by the manor, and it is nearer to the town. We used to herd the cows and sheep here, so it’s quite convenient too.”

The dirt road was soaked by muddy water, and it had become a mud road, and there was a big puddle that was a few inches deep not far away. Lu Junjie instantly felt horrible because of how bumpy the road was. When he turned around, he saw a Unimog recreational vehicle slowly starting out, and it was driven to the front along the asphalt road under the guidance of a few others Unimog.
Lu Junjie turned around in despair. “Ling Ran and the others are leaving with the recreational vehicle? There are two roads?”
“There are three roads in total. The other is the old road. It has not been maintained for years, but most of it is asphalt. The truck that fetches Zebo Two and Zebo Four uses that road.”
“I’m not even comparable to a cow?”
The driver cast a curious glance at Lu Junjie. “They’re cows with names!”

chapters.title: Chapter 756: Evacuation
paragraphs: The citizens in Cuba Town had started evacuating. This was especially urgent on the part of those in the service industry. After they saw the weather forecast and got the evacuation notice from the government, they immediately fled the town with their children.
All the civil servants, teachers, and medical staff members were basically gone too.
The mayor and the sheriff stayed, but they only had a total of two subordinates. All four of them were holding up flags and directing traffic.

Tian Guozheng arrived at Cuba Town in his limousine. When he saw this, without hesitation, he ordered half of his subordinates to help. He also instructed his subordinates to use half of the resources in the Unimogs in his fleet. After all, most of the supplies in the beds of his fleet of Unimogs could be kept in Guozheng Charity Hospital. The hospital was located on high ground, and there were plenty of unused buildings. Hence, there was more than enough space to keep all the supplies.
Even Zebo Two and Zebo Four were moved to the garden of the mansion. Tian Guozheng even instructed people to build a canopy for them. He also sent a few men there just to take care of the two zebos.

When the mayor saw the people and fleet of Unimos from Zheng’s Farm, he immediately walked over to convey his gratitude. He then entered Tian Guozheng’s limousine while he was at it. He took a rest while drinking some high-quality tea.

“Mister Guozheng, have you gathered all of your herd? The damage isn’t huge, is it?” The mayor sipped a cup of red tea. He squinted as he curiously sized up Ling Ran and Tian Qi, who were sitting opposite him.
Ling Ran and Tian Qi smiled at him. They paid him no more heed and continued drinking tea.
Tian Guozheng was well-dressed, and it was not obvious that he had just received knee surgery. He did not want to appear weak at a time like this.

Tian Guozheng’s face lit up with pride at the mention of his farm. He said, “The cowboys have evacuated all the large herds to high ground. They will spend half a day looking for the rest of the cattle, and there’s nothing else that we can do about the ones that are left behind.”

“It’s indeed pretty hard to gather all the cattle who are scattered all over the farm.” The mayor paused for a moment and continued, “However, the damage Zheng’s Farm sustained should be the least among all the farms. Unless the heavy rain stops before tomorrow morning...”

It was highly unlikely that the rain would stop by tomorrow morning. The Brazillians were very used to this kind of rain. Every few years, an area would be struck by disaster, with a few hundred casualties. Floods and landslides that affected more than ten thousand people happened all the time, and many people tried their best to mitigate the damage caused.

However, now that the mayor was saying that Zheng’s Farm would sustain the least damage, Tian Guozheng did not see the need to agree to the statement. He neither denied nor agreed to it and said, “Most farms have disaster mitigation plans. The smaller a farm is, the easier this should be.”

“This might be true in the past, but things are different now.” The mayor sighed and took the opportunity to say, “The herds nowadays are a lot larger than they used to be, and there are fewer and fewer cowboys. In the past, even small farms had two or three employees. However, most farms are family farms nowadays. Hence, when a disaster like this happens, it’s very hard for the farm owners to gather all their cattle.”
“Large farms face the same problem too. We don’t have enough manpower to gather all the cattle in the farm,” Tian Guozheng said nonchalantly.

All of the men he sent to help out in Cuba Town were service crews from the mansion. Even though some of them were raised to become cowboys, they were not professionals. As for the professional cowboys, all of them had been sent to gather the cattle in Zheng’s Farm. But even so, there were not even enough cowboys for this purpose.

“Things might be worse for other large farms.” The mayor sighed and said in Portugese, “Things are different from the past now. The farm workers nowadays are no longer as attached to the farm they are working in. Back when I was young, whenever a disaster struck, all the farm workers would be extremely willing to brave the risk and help out. This was because the relationship between the farm workers and the farm owners was more than an employer-employee relationship. They might be neighbors, and they were all residents of the same town. However, nowadays, farms often hired men from other places. Hence, at a time like this, farm owners would not be able to find anyone to help out.”
Tian Guozheng raised his head and glanced at the mayor.

The mayor put down his teacup and said earnestly, “Mister Guozheng, you are probably the farm owner with the most employers in Cuba Town right now. All your subordinates are loyal to you, and the relationship between you guys is like how things are between the farm owners and farm workers decades ago. Moreover, you have a lot of trucks, and this would be really helpful to the other farm owners... Mister Guozheng, everyone hopes that you can lend them a hand...”
“I get it.” Tian Guozheng chuckled as he glanced at the mayor. “So, if I don’t help out, everyone in town will point at my nose and scold me, right?”

“Why would they? Everyone knows that Mister Guozheng is a charitable and generous man. By building Guozheng Charity Hospital, you have done everyone in Cuba Town a huge favor,” the mayor said pointedly.
“It must have helped a lot in securing your position as the mayor too, hasn’t it?”
“Of course. I have always been very grateful toward you, Mister Guozheng.”

“But even though my farm doesn’t have enough manpower now, you’re blackmailing me to send my men to help out the other farms. You even want me to send my trucks over. Whose farm do you want me to help? Klaus’?”
The mayor said shamelessly with a smile, “How is this considered blackmail? But of course, it would be best if you could lend them a hand.”
Tian Guozheng hummed in acknowledgement. He then changed the topic. “I’ll send my men to help out if you sell the plot of land at the north to me.”
“Mister Guozheng, this is not a decision I can make alone.”

“I know, but you guys can talk about it,” Tian Guozheng said in a straightforward manner, “If you guys would like to express your gratitude to me, do sell me the plot of land. However, if you guys refuse to do so, I would know where you stand.”
The mayor’s expression changed a little. “Mister Guozheng, we have talked about this before...”
“This might be the last time we’re talking about this.” Tian Guozheng waved in dismissal and continued, “Do go ahead and do what you have to. I’ll talk to Klaus.”

The mayor, who was tasked with this difficult mission, went pale a little. He put down his cup of hot tea, rose, and opened the door of the limousine. It was raining cats and dogs outside, and he mentally prepared himself as he stepped outside the car.
*Bang*
He closed the door of the limousine.
Tian Guozheng grunted. He then looked outside the window and said, “I’ll gather my men so that we can leave. The rain is way too heavy, and Cuba Town seems to be in a mess.”
“Will everyone be able to make it in time?” Tian Qi was not anxious. After all, it was only raining, and the flood had not started yet.

“Most families here have cars. I’ll leave a few Unimogs here, and they should be enough to ferry all the unlucky people who don’t have cars away,” Tian Guozheng said, “Let’s head to the hospital to take a rest first. I’ll ask some men to get out of the car to take a look at what’s going on.”
Tian Qi took the initiative to say, “I’ll help out in town too.”
Tian Qi then looked at Ling Ran and said, “Doctor Ling, you should stay in the hospital.”
Compared to Cuba Town, Guozheng Charity Hospital was a safer place to be at.
Tian Guozheng furrowed his eyebrows and said, “You guys should both stay at the hospital. Tian Qi, if you want to help out, just do so at the hospital.”
“The hospital should have enough manpower. I would like to take a look at Cuba Town.” Tian Qi insisted.
When Tian Guozheng saw Tian Qi’s expression, he did not bother talking her out of it.
The fleet of Unimogs were soon divided into two.
Ling Ran hesitated a little, but he ended up heading for the hospital.
After all, the hospital was a place where he could be in his element.
Thirty minutes later, Ling Ran was certain that he had made the right decision.
The waiting hall of the hospital was covered with patients. However, there was no doctor at all. There was not even enough drugs.
This was when a notification from the system appeared.
[Mission: Treat the Wounded and Sick]
[Mission Details: Treat 30 casualties]
[Mission Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]

He did not want to appear weak at a time like this.
Tian Guozheng’s face lit up with pride at the mention of his farm.
He said, “The cowboys have evacuated all the large herds to high ground.
They will spend half a day looking for the rest of the cattle, and there’s nothing else that we can do about the ones that are left behind.”

“It’s indeed pretty hard to gather all the cattle who are scattered all over the farm.” The mayor paused for a moment and continued, “However, the damage Zheng’s Farm sustained should be the least among all the farms.
Unless the heavy rain stops before tomorrow morning...”
It was highly unlikely that the rain would stop by tomorrow morning.
The Brazillians were very used to this kind of rain.
Every few years, an area would be struck by disaster, with a few hundred casualties.
Floods and landslides that affected more than ten thousand people happened all the time, and many people tried their best to mitigate the damage caused.
However, now that the mayor was saying that Zheng’s Farm would sustain the least damage, Tian Guozheng did not see the need to agree to the statement.
He neither denied nor agreed to it and said, “Most farms have disaster mitigation plans.
The smaller a farm is, the easier this should be.”

“This might be true in the past, but things are different now.” The mayor sighed and took the opportunity to say, “The herds nowadays are a lot larger than they used to be, and there are fewer and fewer cowboys.
In the past, even small farms had two or three employees.
However, most farms are family farms nowadays.
Hence, when a disaster like this happens, it’s very hard for the farm owners to gather all their cattle.”
“Large farms face the same problem too.
We don’t have enough manpower to gather all the cattle in the farm,” Tian Guozheng said nonchalantly.
All of the men he sent to help out in Cuba Town were service crews from the mansion.
Even though some of them were raised to become cowboys, they were not professionals.
As for the professional cowboys, all of them had been sent to gather the cattle in Zheng’s Farm.
But even so, there were not even enough cowboys for this purpose.
“Things might be worse for other large farms.” The mayor sighed and said in Portugese, “Things are different from the past now.
The farm workers nowadays are no longer as attached to the farm they are working in.
Back when I was young, whenever a disaster struck, all the farm workers would be extremely willing to brave the risk and help out.
This was because the relationship between the farm workers and the farm owners was more than an employer-employee relationship.
They might be neighbors, and they were all residents of the same town.
However, nowadays, farms often hired men from other places.
Hence, at a time like this, farm owners would not be able to find anyone to help out.”
Tian Guozheng raised his head and glanced at the mayor.
The mayor put down his teacup and said earnestly, “Mister Guozheng, you are probably the farm owner with the most employers in Cuba Town right now.
All your subordinates are loyal to you, and the relationship between you guys is like how things are between the farm owners and farm workers decades ago.
Moreover, you have a lot of trucks, and this would be really helpful to the other farm owners...
Mister Guozheng, everyone hopes that you can lend them a hand...”
“I get it.” Tian Guozheng chuckled as he glanced at the mayor.
“So, if I don’t help out, everyone in town will point at my nose and scold me, right?”
“Why would they?
Everyone knows that Mister Guozheng is a charitable and generous man.
By building Guozheng Charity Hospital, you have done everyone in Cuba Town a huge favor,” the mayor said pointedly.
“It must have helped a lot in securing your position as the mayor too, hasn’t it?”
“Of course.
I have always been very grateful toward you, Mister Guozheng.”
“But even though my farm doesn’t have enough manpower now, you’re blackmailing me to send my men to help out the other farms.
You even want me to send my trucks over.
Whose farm do you want me to help?
Klaus’?”
The mayor said shamelessly with a smile, “How is this considered blackmail?
But of course, it would be best if you could lend them a hand.”
Tian Guozheng hummed in acknowledgement.
He then changed the topic.
“I’ll send my men to help out if you sell the plot of land at the north to me.”
“Mister Guozheng, this is not a decision I can make alone.”
“I know, but you guys can talk about it,” Tian Guozheng said in a straightforward manner, “If you guys would like to express your gratitude to me, do sell me the plot of land.
However, if you guys refuse to do so, I would know where you stand.”
The mayor’s expression changed a little.
“Mister Guozheng, we have talked about this before...”
“This might be the last time we’re talking about this.” Tian Guozheng waved in dismissal and continued, “Do go ahead and do what you have to.
I’ll talk to Klaus.”
The mayor, who was tasked with this difficult mission, went pale a little.
He put down his cup of hot tea, rose, and opened the door of the limousine.
It was raining cats and dogs outside, and he mentally prepared himself as he stepped outside the car.
*Bang*
He closed the door of the limousine.
Tian Guozheng grunted.
He then looked outside the window and said, “I’ll gather my men so that we can leave.
The rain is way too heavy, and Cuba Town seems to be in a mess.”
“Will everyone be able to make it in time?” Tian Qi was not anxious.
After all, it was only raining, and the flood had not started yet.
“Most families here have cars.
I’ll leave a few Unimogs here, and they should be enough to ferry all the unlucky people who don’t have cars away,” Tian Guozheng said, “Let’s head to the hospital to take a rest first.
I’ll ask some men to get out of the car to take a look at what’s going on.”
Tian Qi took the initiative to say, “I’ll help out in town too.”
Tian Qi then looked at Ling Ran and said, “Doctor Ling, you should stay in the hospital.”
Compared to Cuba Town, Guozheng Charity Hospital was a safer place to be at.
Tian Guozheng furrowed his eyebrows and said, “You guys should both stay at the hospital.
Tian Qi, if you want to help out, just do so at the hospital.”
“The hospital should have enough manpower.
I would like to take a look at Cuba Town.” Tian Qi insisted.
When Tian Guozheng saw Tian Qi’s expression, he did not bother talking her out of it.
The fleet of Unimogs were soon divided into two.
Ling Ran hesitated a little, but he ended up heading for the hospital.
After all, the hospital was a place where he could be in his element.
Thirty minutes later, Ling Ran was certain that he had made the right decision.
The waiting hall of the hospital was covered with patients.
However, there was no doctor at all.
There was not even enough drugs.
This was when a notification from the system appeared.
[Mission: Treat the Wounded and Sick]
[Mission Details: Treat 30 casualties]
[Mission Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]

chapters.title: Chapter 757: Gone
paragraphs: “How can so many people get hurt?” Ma Yanlin, who followed Ling Ran to the hospital, knowing that he was about to suffer.

Regardless of what kind of injury the patients had, he would definitely be handling the most tiring and unappreciated tasks. Moreover, the medical staff of Guozheng Charity Hospital was almost gone. Now, there were only a few nurses and care workers left. Ma Yanlin could only imagine the weight of it all.

Chef Zhu, who was also a temporary interpreter with a frying pan on his back, was stunned when he came in and saw the wailing patients. He whispered some questions before he got up and said, “There are patients here who were injured in car accidents, some of them even had their houses falling on them, some fell from their barns when they were working on them, and some fell from their horses.”
“So, these patients all had accidents? All of them?” Ma Yanlin was more surprised.
“It didn’t happen in one day, but these patients recently came over together. Since medical staff is in such short supply, the volunteers gathered them in the hall to solve their problems in one go.”
Ma Yanlin looked at the hall of the small rural clinic. He had a nauseated-looking face, “The volunteers who come to help are not even doctors.”

“The doctors are all gone, so we have to find a way to transfer the seriously injured patients out of here,” Chef Zhu asked a couple more questions, came back, and shrugged. He said, “It’s like the apocalypse. Now, there are at least one hundred wounded people with varying degrees of injuries. All of them need to be dealt with urgently...”
Ma Yanlin heard this and suddenly laughed.
“What’s going on?”
“Oh, nothing. I mean...” Ma Yanlin thought for a moment and said, “This is far from the apocalypse. This is what the large-scale tertiary Grade A hospitals in China deal with every day.”
“What?”

“We have two doctors, one hundred patients, a few inexperienced volunteers, and several nurses, right? Do we still have enough hospital beds?” Ma Yanlin pursed his mouth and said, “Before coming to Brazil, we did this kind of thing every day. All right, roll up your sleeves.”

Ma Yanlin said as he led Chef Zhu to the group of patients. One by one, they checked the tags on the patients’ wrists and made further check-ups. After he saw the state of the hospital, he lost faith in the volunteers’ classification on the patients.
“The doctors are all gone...? You Brazilians sure know how to handle stuff,” Ma Yanlin said as he shook his head.
Chef Zhu chuckled. “I’m no Brazilian. Besides, doctors are of high status. It’s impossible for them to stay here.”
Ma Yanlin cast a sideways glance at Chef Zhu. “We are doctors, aren’t we?”
“That was wrongly worded, I’m sorry.” Chef Zhu coughed a couple of times and said, “At times like this, the doctors from China are the most reliable.”
“We are reliable. But there are some useless people that cannot be relied on,” Ma Yanlin spoke as he checked on the patients.
At this time, Ling Ran came back from the operating theater, and he was accompanied by a beautiful girl named Selena, who was dressed in a maid costume. Her task was to be an interpreter.

“The operating theaters can still be used. Now, there are only two nurses in total. Leave one outside, I’ll take one in. By the way, Selena will temporarily be our surgical nurse.” Ling Ran made a quick decision. He looked around again, picked out one of the patients, and called the patient’s family, “We will send him to the operating theater first. Send all the patients back to their rooms.”

“This won’t do.” Right then, the volunteer-in-charge of the hospital stood up. She was a middle-aged lady, and she looked very imposing. She said, “We can only take care of the patients once we gather them in one place. Now, we are short of manpower. No one knows how long the storm and flood will last. During this period, helicopters are unable to come...”

“Gathering patients together will increase the risk of infection. This hospital lacks sufficient drugs, so send the patients back to their rooms.” Ling Ran was willing to speak a little more when he made a medical explanation, but his tone was a little firmer.

The middle-aged lady snorted a couple of times. She became slightly worried but insisted. “We only have five volunteers in total, and we need to take care of hundreds of patients. If we disperse them to different rooms... we are not professional nurses...”

“Let the patient’s family members help, and tell those with minor injuries take care of themselves.” Ling Ran had been in the Emergency Department for more than a year. He had not only done surgeries and emergency treatments, but also listened to Hu Congjun talk about some technical things. Military doctors were already familiar with situations like this since a long time ago, and they had various full-developed plans to handle them.
In truth, if no doctor came over to help within a short period of time, Ling Ran’s surgeries in the operating theaters would have to go through some changes as well.
For example, he would not complete the surgery, but would prioritize saving lives and stabilizing the patients’ conditions.

The current Guozheng Charity Hospital was not a hospital with complete facilities. The lack of medical staff, especially lack of drugs, blood products, and medical consumables had greatly reduced the ability of the hospital to guarantee the safety of the patient.
At present, the main problem of the hospital was the lack of transportation.

Due to the storms in Cuba Town, helicopters could neither take off nor land at all, and ordinary SUVs and pickups could not drive through more than sixty miles in the mud, much less ordinary cars. Only big trucks could barely pass through the mud, and whether or not they succeeded depended on the drivers’ driving skills and the mechanical condition of the vehicles as well.

Most importantly, Cuba Town was currently located in high ground. At least, it was not threatened by floods and mudslides. Once someone drove out, they might run into a section of the road which would be surrounded by floods and mud. This was a problem of probability. It could not be avoided even if the driver had a good quality car or the driver had good driving skills.

Even for Unimogs, they were also helpless when they ran into a mudslide or if they encountered a road after a landslide or mudslide, where a large amount of soil would be piled up, because it would cause real trouble.
Such trouble increased the risk of transportation. So, this made it impossible for them to transport patients to Cuba Town.
Ling Ran also realized that he would need to go through an extended period of time with a lack of sufficient medicine. So, he was also very resolute when he faced the volunteers.
The volunteers who stood across Ling Ran looked at him and had no more energy to oppose him any further.
“Okay, then. You’re the only doctor here. We’ll listen to you.” The middle-aged female volunteer sighed and said, “My name is Julia. Just call me Julie. What should we do now?”

“Organize and clean the ward, make a list of the drugs and medical consumables in the storeroom. Then, move the patients to the ward. Form a connection with the outside world. It’s best if it’s a satellite phone.” Ling Ran poured out the information he learned from Hu Congjun. He roughly did a check-up on the patients and entered the operating theater.
“The patient has an abdominal injury, and his shoulder is in great pain. He had a car accident, but there’s no X-ray machine here,” the nurse said a few words, and Selena translated them to Ling Ran.
In just a few seconds, the bad condition of the hospital was exposed.
Fortunately, X-rays could be replaced by the Virtual Human. Ling Ran nodded, looked at the right side habitually, frowned, and asked, “Where is the anesthetist?”
“Gone.” Selena directly translated it.
Ling Ran was solemn, yet he was still handsome in that sobriety.
