Among all the cuts of beef, rump was a favorite among Brazilians.
“I have decided.
When I return home after this mission, I won’t be renting a yacht.
I’ll just find a bar and stay there.
I’ll eat rump every day and f*ck girls with large a*ses every day.
And when I’m done f*cking, I’ll continue eating.” The only Portuguese in the team was Silva from Spain.
He settled down in Brazil after studying in the United Kingdom.
His favorite food was Brazilian barbequed meat, and he was chewing so hard right now that his mouth was full of juice.
He felt that he could not go wrong with his decision.
The captain merely chuckled and looked mockingly at him.
“I suggest that you stay in a barbeque restaurant instead.”
“Because the food in barbeque restaurants is better?
There’s no need for that.
I’ll get a barbeque restaurant to send food to the bar every day...” Silva muttered.
“After this mission ends, I will definitely enjoy life—”
“What I meant is that you won’t get any girls even if you were to stay in a bar.” The captain swallowed the beef in his mouth and shook his head as he said, “Isn’t Doctor Ling having some beef too?
Should we reserve some rump for him?”
“Doctor Ling prefers ribs.” The head chef flashed a respectful expression.
“I’ve reserved the best ones for him.”
The captain could not help but pout and laugh out loud.
“I thought that you guys would leave the best for the guests.”
“We didn’t expect there to be guests.” The head chef’s voice was neither soft nor loud, and he sounded a little glum.
The captain was stunned.
He then said, a little pleased with himself, “But we did come, didn’t we?”
“You’re right.
We should thank you.” The head chef raised the meat in his hand.
“We should be having some beer at a time like this.”
“Doctor Ling banned alcohol.”
“Alright, then.” The captain did not intend to challenge Doctor Ling’s authority right now.
It was no small feat for him to be able to maintain order in a place he was not familiar with, and the mercenaries wanted to keep it that way too.
They would just stay quiet for a few days before going home with pocketfuls of cash.
That would definitely be the happiest thing in the world.
They finished the meal.
The captain glanced at his watch.
He then rose and said, “Doctor Ling is probably done operating on the patient, isn’t he?
I would like to meet him.”
“I’ll take you there.” The head chef put down the knife in his hand.
He was rather full of enthusiasm as he led the way.
The captain gestured at the rest of the mercenaries with his eyes, and his team members immediately tightened their grips on their guns.
They then got into formation and left the cafeteria.
They were actually guarding the cafeteria just now so that they could understand the situation.
Of course, they did it because they were preparing for the worst.
Right now, the mercenaries were merely acting on their stress response.
First of all, this place was isolated from the outside world, after all, and it would bring no harm to be vigilant.
Moreover, the mercenaries found the situation in the hospital a little strange too.
A few hundred people were stranded in a place where there was no contact with the outside world and supply was scarce.
Moreover, more than a hundred of them were patients.
It was quite surprising that not a single person died after a few days.
The captain made speculations as he walked to the main hall.
The moment he arrived at the main hall on the first floor, he saw that Ling Ran who was wearing a large white coat was bending down and examining a patient who was lying down.
Guozheng Charity Hospital had an excellent consultation system, and consultation, as well as simple treatments, could be carried out in private rooms.
However, to uplift everyone’s spirits, Ling Ran decided to examine patients in the main hall.
Of course, this was more in tune with the habits of doctors in China.
With a group of patients crowding around them, doctors would feel more in control and had a greater sense of accomplishment.
At the same time, the patients who were waiting for their turns would also feel more at ease.
While patients were waiting for their turns, the sight of a doctor made a world of difference.
“Doctor Ling,” the captain greeted him.
He had seen Ling Ran in the operating theater too when they first arrived at the hospital.
However, at that time, he was chased out.
Ling Ran turned to look at them.
He then nodded at the mercenaries and said, “Thank you for bringing us the satellite phone.
You guys came just at the right time.”
“There’s no need to thank us.
It’s our job.” When the captain heard Selena’s translation, he immediately gave a polite reply.
The purpose of his trip here was to protect this doctor, so he was naturally polite to Ling Ran.
“Have the roads been cleared yet?
Can supplies be sent in?” This was Ling Ran’s greatest concern.
Guozheng Charity Hospital looked pretty big, to the point that it was almost as huge as Yun Hua Hospital.
However, in reality, it only housed around thirty doctors.
Moreover, half of those doctors were from auxiliary departments.
Coupled with the fact that Brazilian working hours were short, the hospital treated fewer patients than the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery of Yun Hua Hospital in a year.
Hence, the number of drugs they had in their storage was truly inadequate.
Truth be told, even if the hospital were to operate normally since more than a hundred patients who were wounded to varying degrees had been treated, it was time to replenish their supplies.
This was especially true when it came to bags of blood and drugs used to resuscitate patients.
The hospital had very little of them left, and Ling Ran did not dare to finish them.
The captain could not help but flash a wan smile when he heard that.
“With the weather now, the only way to assess this hospital is by using assault boats like what we did.
But it’s too dangerous, and I don’t even suggest that you leave the hospital using this method.
Unless there’s a landslide, it would be safer for you to stay in the hospital.”
“So, we can’t even evacuate those who are seriously wounded?” Ling Ran confirmed again.

Before the captain could say anything, Silva, the Portuguese who had studied in the United Kingdom said in English, “Even if a patient is only slightly wounded, after he is evacuated using an assault boat, he would become seriously wounded.
Seriously wounded patients might become dead bodies if they were to be evacuated using assault boats.
During our journey here, our boats overturned a few times.”
When Ling Ran heard that, he immediately sized Silva and the rest of the mercenaries up.
To be more exact, he performed a visual inspection.
“Can you pull your shirt up for me to take a look?” Ling Ran pointed at Silva’s waist.
“It’s just a minor injury.” Silva pulled up his shirt nonchalantly and revealed his bandage wound.
There was a small stain on the bandage.
He did not seem to be affected at all as he said, “I probably got scratched by a stone or a tree branch.
It’s no big deal.
Happens all the time.”
Ling Ran nodded.
“If you are at a hospital with adequate supplies, it would indeed be no big deal.”
“Hm?
What do you mean?” Silva was a little dumbfounded.

“Your wound is infected, but I don’t know what type of pathogen it is.” Ling Ran pointed at the stain which came from the wound and continued, “We don’t have a lot of antibiotics left, and we don’t have every single kind of antibiotics here.”
Silva’s heart skipped a bit.
“Then... what do we do now?”
Ling Ran thought about the problem from a surgeon’s point of view for a moment.
“Can you remove the bandage?
If it’s possible, we’ll have to remove your flesh first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 764: Are We Done With Our Mission
paragraphs: Even though Silva looked as calm as an Englishman on the outside, he was as agitated as a Brazilian on the inside.
But when he watched Ma Yanlin remove his bandage, the calmness on his face faded faster than the calmness crumbling in soldiers when they participated in World War Two.

“Is the infection serious?” Silva was a mercenary, and he knew the dangers of having an infected wound very clearly. This was especially true when a person was in an environment that lacked adequate medical care and drugs. Even though an infection did not sound serious, it could be life-threatening under these circumstances.

A person could grasp how serious wound infections could be just by looking at the death rate of the American Civil War. Without adequate drugs, wound infections had an extremely high possibility of causing death.
Ma Yanlin’s expression was extremely solemn, and he shook his head a little.
‘Am I going to die?’

As Silva looked at Ma Yanlin, he suddenly had a mental breakdown. His expression became as agitated as that of a Brazillian’s, and he said in a burst of explosive rage, “I was only scratched by a stone.”
“The infection isn’t serious. It just needs a bit of treatment.” Ma Yanlin gave a simple reply, and Selena translated it.
After Silva heard what Selena said, he had another mental breakdown. “If it’s not serious, why did you shake your head!?”
Ma Yanlin raised his head and saw that Silva was almost in tears. He said with a puzzled expression, “It’s habitual for us Chinese. Whenever we are about to say no, we’ll shake our heads first.”
“Is there such a thing in China?” Silva looked at Ling Ran with a dumbfounded expression.

Ling Ran was too lazy to pay any heed to their sociolinguistic misunderstanding. He said in a straightforward manner, “I’ll need to debride and suture your wound right now. Because your wound was not debrided right after you got injured, the foreign substances in the wound caused an infection. You’ve probably eaten some antibiotics, haven’t you?”
Silva nodded furiously and said, “I used a first aid kit.”

The captain, who was standing beside Silva, said, “We get injured all the time, and usually treat ourselves with the supplies inside the first aid kit. Our wounds aren’t usually infected when we head to the hospital after that.”
Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgment and nodded.

Ma Yanlin, who was standing beside Ling Ran, explained, “It might be because Brazil is a tropical country. Moreover, there’s a lot of microbes in the floodwater. Fatigue might also cause your immune system to weaken. There’re plenty of reasons that might have caused the infection.”
“Are you saying that it depends on a person’s luck?” Silva asked.

“Infection is a game of luck, anyway.” Ma Yanlin shrugged. “If you were stabbed by a needle that was used by an AIDS patient, there is a one out of three hundred chance of getting infected. Moreover, the success rate of a condom is only 85%...”
“Huh? The success rate of condoms is only 85%!?” The expressions of both the captain and Silva changed.
If you were to compare the look on their faces, Silva’s change in expression was more drastic.

Like a community doctor, Ma Yanlin smiled and said, “You don’t have to be too worried. If the condom is used correctly, the success rate will go up to 98%. The main reason for the 85% success rate right now is many people are using them wrongly.”
“How should we use it?” Silva no longer had time to pay any heed to the wound on his waist.

“Don’t move.” Ling Ran put on a pair of gloves and placed his hand on Silva’s wound. He even moved his hand up and down a few times as he got a feel of the wound, and he looked like he was giving a handjob.
Selena translated what Ling Ran said.
Silva almost went crazy. “So, I shouldn’t move when I’m f*cking!?”

Selena’s cheeks reddened. She glanced at Ling Ran and did not translate what he said. She merely replied, “What Doctor Ling meant was that if you were to move around now, he might need to remove your kidney.”
Silva immediately went stiff.
Ling Ran poked Silva’s wound a few times.

Silva gritted his teeth and maintained his composure. He had used up all the life experiences and determination he gathered after being a mercenary for five years, being in university for four years and being a soldier for three years to stop himself from moving.
Ling Ran raised his head in astonishment and glanced at Silva. He muttered to himself, “He seems tough.”
Ma Yanlin did not understand the conversation between Silva and Selena either. He praised Silva in English. “Tough guy!”
Silva flashed an indecipherable smile.

When Ma Yanlin saw that, he said, “His neural processing should be relatively slow. Can we use a lesser amount of anesthetics later and save them for when we really need it? We don’t have many drugs left.”
“Hm...” Ling Ran could not help but consider Ma Yanlin’s suggestion.

“They’re here to deliver drugs to us. So if one of the mercenaries were to use up a lot of drugs the moment he arrived, he would have a guilty conscience, wouldn’t he? Of course, the main reason I made this suggestion is because of his physique. He doesn’t look like he needs a lot of anesthetics. He may even suffer from side effects if we were to administer too much.” Ma Yanlin came out with a conclusion that sounded pretty logical. He then started preparing to administer anesthetics.

There were no anesthetists presence, and even though Ling Ran possessed Master Level Regional Infiltration Anesthesia, it was merely a subskill. Since he did not have any equipment to aid his judgment, it was hard for him to come out with any conclusion by only observing the wound with his naked eye.
“I’ll carry out local debridement first before administering anesthetics.” Ling Ran notified Silva before he started debriding the wound.

When debriding and suturing a wound, debridement had to be carried out before anesthetics were administered to prevent further infection. This was because the bacteria on the surface of the needles might enter the wounds.

Since Silva had been a mercenary for quite a few years, he had gone through this process many times and understood the reason behind it. He had no choice but to watch with gritted teeth as Ling Ran cleaned the skin around his wound with a soft-bristled brush and washed it with saline.
Ling Ran debrided the wound carefully with a smile on his face.

Ling Ran had stayed in Guozheng Charity Hospital for three days. More than a hundred patients were sent on the first day he was there, and he had operated on all the patients who needed surgery. Even if a patient was badly wounded, Ling Ran treated them as best as he could and ensured their survival.
Hence, there were not any patients left in the hospital who required surgery.

Fortunately, the mercenaries came injured. For example, Silva had already treated his wound while he was on his way. By night time, the disease progression of the wound was just right and it was an appropriate time for surgery.
“Can you bring me more saline solution?” Even though Ling Ran was trying to use less saline, one basin was definitely not enough.

If a person were to judge Silva’s wound in relation to wounds sustained in battlefields, it was not serious. However, in reality, the skin on the right side of his abdomen was full of abrasions, and a few of the wounds were muscle-deep. Aside from this, some of the wounds were filled with pus due to infection. Ling Ran had to clean all of them.

Compared to other kinds of drugs, Guozheng Charity Hospital was equipped with enough saline. The nurse quickly brought another bottle of saline over. She squatted on the ground and poured the saline into a basin.
Ling Ran removed a few large fragments of tree branches using a pair of forceps. He then applied pressure to a few small bleeding points to stop the bleeding.
After he was done, Ling Raid said, “The wound is relatively deep. Do send him to the operating theater.”
“Is there going to be a surgery?” The mercenaries became anxious again.
“Debridement and suturing is a minor surgery,” Selena answered right away without waiting for Ling Ran to say anything.

“The operating theater is cleaner, so the chances of the wound getting infected there is lower.” Ling Ran paused for a moment and continued, “We don’t have enough drugs on our hands right now, and we can only use generic broad-spectrum antibiotics. We’ll have our hands tied if your wound is infected by some troublesome bacteria.”
Silva was extremely shocked, and he no longer dared to refute. His gaze was empty as he was wheeled into the operating theater.
The captain and the other mercenaries were not allowed inside the operating theater, and they could only stare at the light on top of the door of the operating theater in a daze.
An injection was given.
The infected flesh was sliced off.
The wound was debrided again.
The wound was bandaged.
Soon, Silva was wheeled out of the operating theater.
The mercenaries crowded around Silva as he was wheeled into the ward.
They then stood around him in a daze.
One of the mercenaries said in a soft voice, “Captain... Are we done with our mission?”
“I guess so...” The captain looked around, and the place was full of bored patients and their family members. There was no hell, and they could not be of any help here.
“What do we do next?”
“What do you want to do?”
“I want to go fishing.”
“Go ahead.”

chapters.title: Chapter 765: Fish
paragraphs: Early in the morning, the mercenary captain was topless, revealing his strong left shoulder, which was wrapped in bandages. He had a cool smile on his face.

After debriding and suturing Silva last night, the wound on the captain’s left shoulder was also treated by Ma Yanlin. His shoulder was bruised when he stopped the assault boat, which was lighter than Silva’s injury, but since he did not treat it at all, there were signs of swelling and inflammation.

Next to him was the dynamiter with a thigh injury. The dynamiter also had his thighs exposed, and his bulging muscles were wrapped tightly with white bandages. He took off his military trousers and put on a pair of Hawaiian shorts. If anyone just looked at his lower body, he will just look like an unlucky beach guest.
To the left of the mercenary captain was Silva, who was relieved from all his nervousness.

Silva had a bandage around his waist and looked as if he was shot. A nonchalant smile was on his face. He looked at the rising sun and said with a smile, “Captain, since it’s a free day, why don’t we open up the roads to Cuba Town?”
“How do we open up the roads?” The captain squinted as he looked at the wide water and the mud around him. He acted so cordially that it was as if he was attending a kindergarten parent meeting.

Silva looked at the river which was several hundred meters wide and had no idea. He just licked his lips and said, “Well, this is worth hundreds of thousands of dollars. It’s a shame to not get it, considering it’s money we can get without firing a single shot.”

“After the river is a valley, and now, it’s all muddy. It may collapse all of a sudden. There is also the risk of mudflows. Even if we can pass through it, it’s still not considered opening the road.” The captain looked at the direction of Cuba Town and calmly said, “The original highway was destroyed, and there will be a lot of natural blockades. There’s only just a few of us. If we want to clear a few miles long mountain road, the risk would be no less than firing a gun.”
“That’s too wasteful,” Silva sighed and said a little reluctantly, “I thought the commission for this trip could be doubled.”

“We have arrived at the scheduled location. If we continue to protect Doctor Ling, the money would be enough for you to enjoy life for several months. Let’s protect our lives.” The captain did not by any means want to risk any lives. Although the distance between Cuba Town and Guozheng Charity Hospital was close, after the torrential rain, flood, and mudflows, the smooth journey that only required a few minutes of driving had become a dangerous area that was difficult to pass. Under the circumstances where there was no help from a construction vehicle, he did not think it was possible to open up a road.
Perhaps the team that was going to Cuba Town to borrow some manpower and equipment would have a plan, but the captain had no intention of opening up the road.
It was precisely because the hospital was dangerous and the chances of getting the reward were small that the captain took the initiative to come to the hospital.
As the manager of the team, he planned the entire operation carefully, and fortunately, the results were good. The hospital was also more comfortable than expected.
“It’s almost time, I’m going to cook some fish.” The dynamiter looked at his watch, took a deep breath, and a smile inevitably appeared on his face. “Today’s weather is not bad.”

The captain and Silva looked out at the same time. The rain seemed to be a little lighter than yesterday, but that just meant that it had regressed from a storm to heavy rain. Moreover, since it was a sunshower, the air was abnormally hot and humid.
However, the smile on the dynamiter’s face was very genuine.
“The last time I saw him laugh like this was when there were three burning tank cars in front of him.” Silva shook his head. “He won’t burn up the kitchen, right?”
The captain laughed. “Don’t worry, the thing that the boy does best is use fire. When he was fourteen, he burned the neighbor’s barn and put it out before the fire could get to his own house.”
“How did he do that?”
“He bought something at the border, and when the fire came over, he blew it out with an explosion. It was said that no fire extinguisher was used. As for this, I think he’s exaggerating things.”
Silva was surprised. “He’s very quiet when he fishes, I never imagined that he would have such a childhood.”
“It’s presumably because waiting for the enemy to step on mines is similar to fishing.”
Silva thought about it and nodded in approval.
Early in the morning, Ling Ran took Ma Yanlin along to do the ward rounds. When they finished, the restaurant was already packed full of food.

Brazil was a country with abundant resources and lived up to its name as a land rich with resources. As a result, their dining tables had always been filled with plenty of food, and even when they were trapped in a hospital, the restaurant still offered buffets.
However, the dishes served today were still mainly fish and beef.
Based on the weight of the Zebu, it was still impossible to finish eating the one slaughtered the day before, and the fish were all freshly caught.

In truth, not only did the mercenaries like fishing, those who stayed in the hospital also liked fishing. In the absence of communication with the outside world, lack of electricity, and the fact that they could not go out to play, many people thought of ways to look for fishing gear. Some fished with a pole, some threw nets, and some went fishing with net cages.
Ling Ran, who had only slept for two hours, still looked healthy, energetic, and handsome. When he entered the room, he flashed a smile and took a plate to pick some food.
Ma Yanlin was a little bit sluggish, feeble, and weak, but also felt hungry as he followed closely behind Ling Ran.

The dynamiter in the mercenary team had been waiting in the restaurant. When Ling Ran appeared, he quickly came up to say hello, and with broken English, he said, “Doctor Ling, I made fish Chinese like, must try, please.”
“Okay.” Ling Ran did not object to this. Under the guidance of the dynamiter, he picked up a four-fingered wide, golden-colored fried fish steak.
“Try. Sprinkle some salt.” The dynamiter helped to grind some sea salt on the fish steak.
Ma Yanlin followed behind him and also took a small fish steak.
Ling Ran was not in a hurry to pick up other food. He just sat down with his plate and tasted the fish steak first.

The thick fish meat that was deep fried was golden and crispy on the outside, while the meat inside was very supple and somewhat firm when he bit down. At first glance, it looked like cod meat, but it was chewier. It was a texture that was a mix of fish and meat. Not only was it special, but also extremely delicious.
Ling Ran took two mouthfuls and asked, “What kind of fish is this?”
“Water-monkey,” the dynamiter answered with the name that was not quite commonly used for this fish.
“Monkey fish?” Ling Ran translated it to the name that was even more commonly used and asked, “Why would you say it’s a fish that Chinese like?”
“Because it’s a water monkey, I know Chinese people like this fish very much.” The dynamiter scratched his head like a mountain orang-utan, “I’ve been to Hong Kong twice, and they all like it.”
“Is it similar to humpback grouper or brown-marbled grouper?” Ma Yanlin’s brain was still functional.

“Arowana?” Ma Yanlin’s eyes widened in surprise.

“Like the golden arowana and silver arowana,” Selena said. “Brazilians don’t like to eat them very much. They feel that there are too many bones in them. They often only take fish fillets and discard the sides.”
Ma Yanlin said suddenly, “Ah... the Feng Shui fish.”
“That’s right.” Selena nodded.

The dynamiter listened to them speak in Mandarin and was even more anxious. He asked, “What are you guys saying?”
Selena thought for a while and said to the dynamiter, “This is a fish that the Chinese pray to for good luck.”

“A fish that the Chinese pray to for good luck? If Doctor Ling believes it, we should also have a piece.”
“The fish that a sage likes would definitely bring good luck.”
“I caught a water monkey yesterday but chopped it into pieces to use as bait. But, it’s okay. I should still be able to catch another.”
“Let’s go fishing together.”

After debriding and suturing Silva last night, the wound on the captain’s left shoulder was also treated by Ma Yanlin.
His shoulder was bruised when he stopped the assault boat, which was lighter than Silva’s injury, but since he did not treat it at all, there were signs of swelling and inflammation.
Next to him was the dynamiter with a thigh injury.
The dynamiter also had his thighs exposed, and his bulging muscles were wrapped tightly with white bandages.
He took off his military trousers and put on a pair of Hawaiian shorts.

To the left of the mercenary captain was Silva, who was relieved from all his nervousness.

He just licked his lips and said, “Well, this is worth hundreds of thousands of dollars.

It may collapse all of a sudden.
There is also the risk of mudflows.

chapters.title: Chapter 766: Service Industry
paragraphs: “Yes, I will definitely protect Doctor Ling well. Yes, I have not even lost a strand of hair... Yes... Okay...” After the captain promised repeatedly, he quickly hung up the satellite phone and breathed a sigh of relief. He said to Silva, who was in the seat next to him. “This time, the task is not difficult, but the employer’s requirements are high.”
Silva said with the disdainful sneer the English usually had and said, “If you don’t like it, why did you still agree to it in such a humble way?”
“Who said I don’t like it? I like employers who raise the requirements and pay more.” The captain broke into a smile as he spoke.
Silva sighed helplessly and said, “You are a mercenary captain, shouldn’t you be more imposing?”
“Silva.” The captain’s expression turned a little more serious. He looked at his teammate and said, “Are you out to be a mercenary because being mercenaries are cool or because they can make money?”
“Of course it’s because they can make money.” Silva paused for a moment before he said, “But it’s not bad to be cool.”

“If you’re able to make money, you will naturally become cooler.” The captain lifted the satellite phone, waved it twice, and patted his own gun before he said, “Remember, although we carry guns on our bodies, what we’re actually doing is something akin to the lines of the service industry.”
Silva, who had been a mercenary for five years, was stunned. “What we’re doing now is along the lines of the service industry?”
“Of course. The standard service industry,” the captain said earnestly, “So, pay attention to your attitude. Waiters with bad attitudes are always the ones who earn the least.”
Silva shrugged and spread his arms again. “Well, what sort of service are we providing this time?”
“Give the satellite phone to Doctor Ling and wait for Doctor Ling to finish the call.” The captain also shrugged. Then, he crossed the corridor and came to the hall.
Ling Ran was still in a white coat and was diagnosing and treating patients as handsomely as ever.

Besides the few patients who only received simple treatment even though they were badly injured, there were currently nearly twenty patients in Guozheng Charity Hospital, and their injuries were of moderate severity. From time to time, they must change their dressing or have a follow-up treatment.
If this were Yun Hua Hospital, Ling Ran would have given these tasks to his staff.
But in Guozheng Charity Hospital, Ling Ran was naturally reluctant to hand over the patients to Ma Yanlin ...

The happiness of a senior doctor lied in being able to choose the job he wanted to do. Of course, as a doctor, it was impossible to not work, and it was difficult to try and not stay up past midnight. At most, they could choose to work in the first half or second half of the night.
Ma Yanlin was still sitting next to Ling Ran with a laptop in front of him as he filled up medical records with all his energy and strength.

Ma Yanlin and Ling Ran did not know if Brazilians checked their medical records. But if they were managing more than a hundred patients of different degrees of injuries, it would be catastrophic if there were no medical records.
“Doctor Ling, Miss Tian Qi called.” Once the captain was certain that Ling Ran was not busy at work, he connected the satellite phone and respectfully passed the phone over with both hands.
Silva was studying by the side, and she nodded secretly. ‘Indeed, that’s service at the level of a service industry line.’
“Ling Ran!” Tian Qi heard the voice through the phone and immediately shouted happily.
“Tian Qi.” Ling Ran also straightened up. Working for hours was, after all, very tiring. He looked at the heavy rain outside and asked, “How is the situation in Cuba Town?”

Tian Qi’s voice quivered with some excitement and said, “It’s getting better. I have opened a road for the residents of the town. We now have a total of 1,256 people who can work and more than forty excavator cranes as well as trucks. And there are thousands of cows... You didn’t see how these cows looked like when they were first fit into the halters. They’ve never worked before, so when we first asked them to work, every one of them looked so dumb...”
Ling Ran was surprised. “How can there be more than forty construction vehicles?”
“There is a car dealer in Cuba Town who sells these things, and I requisitioned them.” Tian Qi’s voice was filled with pride.
“Does requisition mean you purchased them?”

“Of course not, this is for the public interest, there’s no need to pay.” Tian Qi’s voice was filled with even more pride and excitement. For her, it was also a rare experience. Independently managing a town and initiating a self-rescue, as well as managing a company were two concepts.
Ling Ran did not know too much about this. He nodded silently, and after realizing that the other side could not see him, he said, “Pay attention to safety. Do you guys have a doctor?”
“There is a general practitioner and two pharmacists. There are very few patients in the town. The seriously injured patients were sent to the hospital. Is the hospital alright?”
“There’s no big problem...” Ling Ran briefly introduced the situation and said, “The mercenaries you sent are very good.”
“Really? Actually, I don’t want them to be useful... Wait, are the mercenaries dispatched? Are you in danger?”
“No, a mercenary caught an arowana and fried it with hot oil. It was delicious...”
Tian Qi could not help laughing, but felt that the tension in her had disappeared.
Presently at the headquarter, reporters eagerly tried to squeeze their microphones into the mouth of the person in charge at the scene.
“Mister Lucio, are you sure there were no dead people at the disaster site?”
“Mister Lucio, did you conceal anything at the disaster site? Is there security at the scene?”
“How do you evaluate your ability to control the situation? Do you think your orders can be correctly delivered to the scene?”
Reporters’ questions came one after another like a rainstorm.

Lucio smiled on the outside, but was cursing internally as he answered the questions one by one. He had always been a politician, anyway. He was not someone who could do things well, but he was very skilled at answering questions, making up answers, and so on.
Journalist Naldo stared at Lucio and asked several questions in succession. He did not get the answers he wanted, but he was not discouraged.

On the contrary, he still had a slight smile on his face. When he returned to his seat, he even deliberately asked the cameraman who accompanied him, “I just asked if there was any dead person, did you film his answer?”
“It was all filmed.”
“Good job.” Naldo patted his fat belly and said, “So, let’s wait till we take a picture of a body at the disaster site, and poor Lucio will need to step down.”
“A body at the scene?” The cameraman’s thick lips trembled. Why would there be a body at the scene?

“Because there will be people who are bound to die at a disaster site. Is this your first day working? In such rainstorms, car accidents will increase, houses will collapse, cows will go crazy, and people will also go crazy. There will be people falling sick every day in a small town with thousands of people, and in an environment that cannot provide medical treatment, these people are likely to die, understand? So, when Lucio said that no one died at the scene, I knew he was telling lies!” Naldo answered with absolute certainty.
The cameraman’s hands started shaking, “Don’t tell me that you’re thinking of going to the disaster scene?”

“Let’s go to the scene!” Naldo pointed to himself and the cameraman. With a genuine smile, he said, “I’ll go and tell the editor. As long as we can take a photo of a body, we would be national heroes!”
“How do we both get there?”

“There were a few police and fire brigade volunteers who can send us there,” Naldo said with a smile, and he continued to encourage the cameraman, “Don’t worry, they all have experience in disaster relief in floods. We would just follow them to the scene. The best place would be the hospital there, and we will become media heroes. We will be the battlefield reporters of battlefield reporters! We’ll be hero reporters!”
Naldo waved his arms as he spoke excitedly, so much so that his saliva flew.
The cameraman gulped and said hesitatingly, “Police and firefighters went, but we are heroes? The public would like them better I think.”

“Public?” Naldo sneered. “The public is just pasture of the media. We decide who will eat them. If the people who’re coming along are sensible, I will let them show their faces on TV, but in the end, this time, You and I should be the ones who will be praised!”
“Is it?”
“Yes, as long as a body is found. We will definitely find a body.” Naldo’s tone was firm. “How can we call it a disaster without a sea of corpses?”

chapters.title: Chapter 767: I Am Here
paragraphs: The rain was obviously smaller.
When looking upward from the ground, it felt like a group of Cupids were peeing from the sky.
One day ago, the heavy storm was like Spartan warriors peeing. When the rain hit a person on the face, not only was it painful, but there was also a strong temperament in it.

The boss of the s*x toy shop in Cuba Town had a raincoat on while he hid under a canopy and smoked on the last cigarette that he had without wasting any of it. He stood up in a despondent mood, turned around, and asked the boss of the pet shop beside him, “Tamron, I’ll use a box of Jissbon in exchange for one of your cigarettes.”

The 70-year-old Tamron was cooking soup in the middle of the space under the canopy. He used the spoon to stir the liquid inside the stainless pot and said scornfully, “You want my life, right? I’ll save the cigarette for myself.”
“The rain is going to stop soon, and the road is almost repaired. The cigarette you have left may not be worth anything by then.” The boss of the s*x toy shop threatened Tamron.

“Don’t tell me that you can finish that box of Jissbon before the rain stops?” Tamron chuckled. “I’m willing to use this cigarette in exchange for a cow, or maybe a few calves, which I can sell as pets. Think carefully, what else can you sell?”

In Cuba Town, cigarettes were the most precious items at the moment, and the price of cows had dropped the most. The town did not just lack sufficient feed, but also space for cows to rest and move around. Even the carcasses of the dead cows became very troublesome.

Tamron used to have a habit to stock up on many things. When he got older, he could not be like other town residents, who could go for a grocery haul once every week or every two weeks. He usually asked others to get things for him, or sometimes, he would go out to buy necessary with a pickup truck.
Before the flood, Tamron had just finished a major transfer of resources. So, now, he was probably the richest man in Cuba Town.

“I’ll take a silicone reverse mold doll in exchange for your cigarettes. It’s a new one, but I want two cigarettes!” the boss said while gritting his teeth. There were few people who wanted to exchange cigarettes in the town and even fewer people who wanted to exchange goods with him.
Tamron was a little tempted. He thought about it and asked, “Whose reverse mold is it? By the way, I want a thicker one with and a lot of materials inside.”
“Which type?” The boss frowned.
“Just like the sloppy field in front. The type that is abandoned.” Tamron pointed ahead of him.
The boss rubbed his eyes and looked over. A few seconds later, he cursed angrily and said, “Who will get such a thick silicone doll? That’s a real woman, idiot!”
He did not have the time to say anything else, he cleared his throat and shouted, “Help, help, somebody had an accident...”

chapters.title: Chapter 768: Wait Until the End
paragraphs: *Vroom vroom vroom.*
The international machine factory made really loud noises as they were making roads in the mountains.
And there were a bunch of dumbfounded cows working diligently behind them.

Naldo had half of his body covered in bandages, but even then, he still boldly snapped pictures with a camera. What he wanted to shoot was actually the picture of a corpse, but after missing three toes, he could only snap pictures according to where the lady pushing his wheelchair pushed him to, and Naldo could not make any decisions about it.
“Mariana, Mariana!” Naldo snapped a few photos, and he began to feel bored. He could not help but shout.
“Please be seated for a little longer.” Mariana was in her forties and had a small farm at home, so she was strong. Not to mention, she had wide hips.
All the residents of the town were called into action.
Those who could drive heavy-duty vehicles were the main force. In addition, cowboys would try to drive the cattle and do some transportation work.
A woman like Mariana was called as a ‘strong woman’ by Tian Guozheng, and she was also included in the team. The hard labor she had to do was no less than a man’s.

Of course, in this town of more than a thousand people, there was not much labor to do. Some of the work included transporting the injured insurance agent, and pushing his wheelchair around was considered one of her tasks.

However, while the mayor and the others cared about him, Mariana did not. After pushing his wheelchair around for the day, she lost her patience for the fat man who only knew how to shout while holding his mobile phone. At this moment, Mariana was more willing to chat with the owner of the adult s*x toy store rather than pushing the fat man around.
Naldo also felt bored after he yelled for some time. So, he held up his camera and took more pictures of the cattle.

Once upon a time, Brazil also used animal labor for construction. But that was a really long time ago. Even with Naldo’s age, he had never seen a group of cattle working hard in the field of construction.
Especially the expensive Zebu.

The only reason ranchers paid so much money for good cattle breeds and put in so much effort to produce their feed was so that they would get some delicious beef. It had been a long time since the people were willing to let their cows work hard.

The people looked for a high proportion of fat and the so-called marbling in today’s beef. To achieve such an effect, one must let the cattle be raised in a very ideal lifestyle. Not only did they have to eat comfortably, but they also had to exercise in an appropriate amount. In fact, they could not even undergo any sort of mental pressure.

A good quality Zebu should live like a middle-aged man in a small town. It should eat more and eat seriously. It did not need to care too meticulously about its life, but could not be too crude either. I practically did not need to exercise, but could not completely remain still. It would be best for it to take a walk after its daily activities, pretending to keep its body fit as it slowly accumulated fat. In terms of its mental condition, it should also give priority to relaxation, and occasionally be a little tense, perhaps at the level of people being tense in a karaoke session.

For Zebu, who lived in modern ranches, the idea of working and sweating was like an ancient story which only existed in their memories because the story was passed down through oral form, just like how a middle-aged man in a small town was remembered.
*Click click click*
*Click click*
Naldo held on the shutter and took a bunch of photos. He turned and took another bunch of photos. He then turned again...
Naldo saw Tian Qi.
Tian Qi was tall and beautiful, and she was dressed in tight-fitting working clothes.
She stood there proudly on a hillock with a yellow safety helmet. There were a few interim engineers behind her. They also had two satellite phones with them.

Naldo knew that Tian Qi communicated with designers and engineers from many countries in China and Europe through the satellite phones every day to maintain swift progress and also to modify the plan in time.

Even if it was to open up a channel for the town, there were still some people who would be lazy, try to slack off, or use plausible excuses for them to slack off. Whenever this happened, they would need to face with world-class engineers and senior technical workers and be held accountable.

Workers who failed in the debate often had to talk for a long period of time with the review team composed of Tian Guozheng’s mayor and its residents. When they returned to their posts, they would usually be able to bring out unimaginable power.
*Click click*
Naldo adjusted the focus and took dozens of Tian Qi’s photos in one go.
Naldo could not help but sigh as he lowered his camera.
“It’s through!”
Somewhere at the front, an excited exclamation suddenly sounded, and it gradually became louder.
Naldo’s reporter instinct was activated in a flash, and he hurriedly shouted, “What’s through? Is the road cleared?”
“Of course the road is clear.” The strong Mariana came up, stepped on Naldo’s wheelchair brake, and said, “Let’s go to the front.”
Then, she transported Naldo to her MPV.

Mariana’s MPV was also the reason why she was given the task of transporting the reporter. Only a few town residents bought this kind of business car because they preferred pickup trucks. However, Mariana had four children. Now, with Tian Qi working together with her, Mariana’s children were sent to the town’s nursery so that Mariana had more time to participate in the construction.
“Is the road repaired?” Naldo asked again.
Mariana nodded. “China’s road repairing skills are very impressive.”
“The road was built by the people in your town, why do you say that the Chinese are great?” Naldo was unhappy.
Marina grinned. “Aren’t you a Brazilian? Haven’t you seen a Brazilian project before?”
Naldo kept quiet.
“Bring the insurance agent over.” A man in a black bodysuit and had a walkie-talkie in his hands ran toward them briskly.
Naldo held onto his camera and suddenly felt a little nervous. “What do you want?”
“To suture your toes.” The man in the black bodysuit stuck his head into the car, glanced at Naldo, and said, “There is a doctor in Guozheng Charity Hospital who can suture your toes.”
Naldo’s expression tensed up. He could not help but remember his own toes being cut off yesterday.
He also remembered that general practitioner who was obviously a little bonkers.
“I want to go to Rio de Janeiro for surgery.” Naldo quickly stated his stance on the matter.

“It’s up to you.” The man who came to inform them was not bothered. He turned his head around and put his rain hat over his head. Then he said, “I heard that it’s hard to suture toes after a day it was severed. The passageway between Cuba and the outside world hasn’t been opened yet.”
“Wait...” Naldo called out to the other person. “I want to go to the hospital to consult a doctor.”
He comforted himself. ‘There must be a corpse in the hospital for me to take a picture.’
An hour later, Naldo’s car arrived at Guozheng Charity Hospital.
Just like Cuba Town, Guozheng Charity Hospital was surrounded by water, sludge, and garbage.
The difference was that there were a few plumes of smoke rising from the hospital, and there were faint laughter and music coming from it.
After that, he could smell the strong scent of roasted beef.
“It’s like a party.” Mariana, who was driving, smelled the scent and smiled. “A ranch owner’s party. I hope there are still rib eyes left.”
“They might also be burning bodies and covering them up with the taste of beef.” Naldo looked out of the window, but he was not calm at all. He risked his life to come here. This was his last hope.

Mariana did not even look at Naldo’s expression. She smiled and shook her head. “They can’t be burning corpses. When you burn corpses, it doesn’t smell like this, and when you burn it together with beef, it won’t produce such a smell.”
Naldo trembled and stared at the rancher lady.
“Alright, I sent you to the hospital. Go get your toes reconnected.” Mariana found a place to park and sashayed toward the direction where the music came from.
Naldo was a few seconds late. He did not even have time to call her.
After a long time, two care workers came over slowly.
“Severed toes?” the care worker asked.
Naldo nodded vigorously.
“Did you bring the toes?”
“Yes, yes.” Mariana already prepared it for Naldo, who quickly took out his toes out of the incubator.
“Alright, go for your surgery.” The care workers pushed Naldo away.
Naldo quickly craned his neck like a duck in a cage while he looked left and right.
Compared to the chaos outside the hospital, the inside of the hospital could be said to be very clean and tidy.
There were patients waiting to get their medicine in the hall, patients who were receiving rehabilitation, and patients taking a stroll.
Patients’ families either moved about between the hall and corridors, took care of patients, or chatted while they helped out.
The peaceful atmosphere in the hospital made Naldo frown in a troubled manner.
Then, he met the Ling My-Middle-Name-Is-Tall-Handsome-And-Stylish Ran.
*Click click*
Naldo could not help but lifted his camera and took eight shots of Ling Ran in one go.
“Put the camera away,” Ling Ran whispered, “Take all the bandages off and clean the wound.”
“We’re being so wasteful?” Ma Yanlin looked at Naldo and whispered, “He’ll be wasting bandages.”

“Cuba Town has a pharmacy. We have bandages and disinfectants now,” Ling Ran said. He then said with a hint of relief, “Clean and disinfect the operating theater, ward, recovery room, corridors, and all other places.”
Ma Yanlin was in shock. He then said, “We only have a few people...”
“You can ask for Cuba Town’s aid,” Ling Ran exhaled again, looked at Naldo, who was next to him and said, “Five hours. After five hours, bring the patient to me.”
Naldo looked up and was well-behaved.

“Wait...” Naldo called out to the other person.
“I want to go to the hospital to consult a doctor.”
He comforted himself.
‘There must be a corpse in the hospital for me to take a picture.’
An hour later, Naldo’s car arrived at Guozheng Charity Hospital.
Just like Cuba Town, Guozheng Charity Hospital was surrounded by water, sludge, and garbage.
The difference was that there were a few plumes of smoke rising from the hospital, and there were faint laughter and music coming from it.
After that, he could smell the strong scent of roasted beef.
“It’s like a party.” Mariana, who was driving, smelled the scent and smiled.
“A ranch owner’s party.
I hope there are still rib eyes left.”
“They might also be burning bodies and covering them up with the taste of beef.” Naldo looked out of the window, but he was not calm at all.
He risked his life to come here.
This was his last hope.
Mariana did not even look at Naldo’s expression.
She smiled and shook her head.
“They can’t be burning corpses.
When you burn corpses, it doesn’t smell like this, and when you burn it together with beef, it won’t produce such a smell.”
Naldo trembled and stared at the rancher lady.
“Alright, I sent you to the hospital.
Go get your toes reconnected.” Mariana found a place to park and sashayed toward the direction where the music came from.
Naldo was a few seconds late.
He did not even have time to call her.
After a long time, two care workers came over slowly.
“Severed toes?” the care worker asked.
Naldo nodded vigorously.
“Did you bring the toes?”
“Yes, yes.” Mariana already prepared it for Naldo, who quickly took out his toes out of the incubator.
“Alright, go for your surgery.” The care workers pushed Naldo away.
Naldo quickly craned his neck like a duck in a cage while he looked left and right.
Compared to the chaos outside the hospital, the inside of the hospital could be said to be very clean and tidy.
There were patients waiting to get their medicine in the hall, patients who were receiving rehabilitation, and patients taking a stroll.
Patients’ families either moved about between the hall and corridors, took care of patients, or chatted while they helped out.
The peaceful atmosphere in the hospital made Naldo frown in a troubled manner.
Then, he met the Ling My-Middle-Name-Is-Tall-Handsome-And-Stylish Ran.
*Click click*
Naldo could not help but lifted his camera and took eight shots of Ling Ran in one go.
“Put the camera away,” Ling Ran whispered, “Take all the bandages off and clean the wound.”
“We’re being so wasteful?” Ma Yanlin looked at Naldo and whispered, “He’ll be wasting bandages.”
“Cuba Town has a pharmacy.
We have bandages and disinfectants now,” Ling Ran said.
He then said with a hint of relief, “Clean and disinfect the operating theater, ward, recovery room, corridors, and all other places.”
Ma Yanlin was in shock.
He then said, “We only have a few people...”
“You can ask for Cuba Town’s aid,” Ling Ran exhaled again, looked at Naldo, who was next to him and said, “Five hours.
After five hours, bring the patient to me.”
Naldo looked up and was well-behaved.

chapters.title: Chapter 769: Defective Products
paragraphs: “Don’t move around. I’m not skilled. I’m telling you this in advance so if you get hemiplegia from moving around so much, don’t blame me,” Ma Yanlin mumbled at the operating bed.

Ling Ran was more interested in the operation itself than anesthesia. As the only licensed doctor in Guozheng Charity Hospital, Ma Yanlin had to take over the work and became the chief surgeon’s anesthetist in the hospital.
Selena was also forced to be a temporary nurse for several days. At that moment, while she helped out, she asked, “Should I translate what you said to the patient?”

“Of course, why not?” Ma Yanlin was fitting in a needle while his body was turned to the side. He turned around like an evil doctor and said, “Explain the risks to him. We can have a talk if he really doesn’t want to do the surgery.”
“If it were for me and I know you didn’t know how to give anesthesia, I would not want to receive surgery.” Selena pouted.
“It’s up to him. If he doesn’t want to do it, all three of his toes will have to go,” Ma Yanlin shrugged as he said, “Let him sign the pre-operation consent form. The English version is over there.”
Selena shrugged, turned around, and translated the conversation just now to Naldo.
Naldo looked down at his feet, and he was dumbfounded. “Aren’t there any anesthetists? Why don’t you have an anesthetist? I’m going to sue your hospital. ”
“The anesthetist left,” Selena said helplessly, “You can either sue the anesthetist, or you can wait for the passageway to be open to do the surgery.”

“After the passageway is opened, I don’t need the surgery anymore, right?” Naldo laughed self-deprecatingly, and his expression changed. “How can you treat more than a hundred patients with such standards? And you claim that there weren’t any deaths?”
Selena translated the question.
Ma Yanlin thought for a moment and said, “It’s either a doctor’s skill or luck.”
Ma Yanlin did not flatter Ling Ran so much since Ling Ran was not around.
For Naldo, of course, he thought it was just luck. His expression changed again.
But he could not bring himself to tell that he did not want to do the surgery.
There were three toes, and one of them was even the hallux. If he lost them, forget about carrying around weight when he walked around in the future, he might even have trouble walking.

“I’m about to receive the anesthesia now. Tell me the truth, how many people have died in the hospital recently? Let me make a judgment myself.” Naldo’s gaze was full of sincerity. He really wanted to know, and it was not only for the sake of his surgery, but also for information for his news.

“So far, not yet,” Ma Yanlin replied indifferently and said to Selena, who was translating to Naldo, “Ask him if he wants to sign the form. If he doesn’t want to sign it, I will go see other patients.”
Naldo hesitated for a moment, he had to sign the form. In his current situation, he really could not act tough.
Ma Yanlin immediately began to inject the anesthetics.

Compared to his initial skills, he had become much better in this. After all, now that he had a satellite phone, he could also make a phone call to consult a real anesthetist, which was not similar to how he learned it through reading books with Ling Ran.
After a few minutes, Naldo became unconscious.

A regional anesthesia was enough for a normal toe replantation. However, on the one hand, Ling Ran preferred general anesthesia. On the other hand, Ma Yanlin already had a hard time learning how to do a venous anesthesia. It was even harder to learn regional anesthesia on the spot.

“A patient with three severed toes... tsk... it’s basically like a celebratory gift...” Ma Yanlin said, and he inevitably paused for a moment, he whispered to Selena doubtfully, “This man is not a gift from Miss Tian Qi to Doctor Ling, right?”

“How can Miss Tian Qi give a person as a gift?” Selena smiled, and in a flash, she thought of something and asked, “By the way, I remember that in traditional Chinese culture, there is a dowry system for girls?”
“I have never heard of there being a system for dowry.” Ma Yanlin shook his head. “You can call Doctor Ling to perform the surgery.”
The moment Selena heard the words “Doctor Ling”, she could not be bothered to talk to Ma Yanlin anymore. She immediately went to get her walkie-talkie.
After fifteen minutes, Ling Ran was dressed neatly and walked into the operating theater.
After the construction of the passageway between Cuba Town and Guozheng Charity Hospital, the first thing they had to bear was the increase of a large number of patients.

The general practitioner in Cuba Town was inferior compared to other general practitioners. His ability to deal with diseases was not even comparable to Australian doctors. After all, Australian doctors could use Google proficiently, but the mother tongue of the general practitioner of Cuba Town was Portuguese.

The patients who had been ill or injured over the past few days received either anti-inflammatory pills, painkillers, antipyretics, or the most basic debridement. Of course, on the bright side, this general practitioner was a doctor, no matter what. Although his treatment level was poor, there was no big mistake done. For example, if Naldo’s toes were not resolutely amputated, then it would be more difficult to replant it now.
Moreover, the preservation of the severed toes by the general practitioner was quite remarkable.

He wrapped the severed toes with clean gauze, then packed it in a plastic bag and sealed it tightly, then placed it in the only small refrigerator in the clinic. He kept the refrigerator at a constant low temperature. In the process of transportation, the severed toes were placed in an incubator to ensure the condition of the toes was good.
It could be said that severed toes like these still had a great probability of being replanted even after another twenty-four hours.

In fact, if Naldo were lucky, the severed toes could be stored for a week and still could be replanted successfully. In terms of prognosis, naturally, it could not be compared with severed toes that had only been stored for a day. It was very difficult to get a good result. However, it was not an easy feat to make sure the severed toes survived.
The best toe replantation needed to be done within twenty-four hours. Naldo’s time had exceeded the ideal time, but with excellent preservation conditions, he could still get rather good results.
The key word being “rather”.

“He needs to have bone atrophy.” Under the 10X microscope, Ling Ran observed Naldo’s severed toe for a moment, looked at the severed end of the foot, shook his head slightly, and said, “The tissue of the severed end should be completely removed from the lifeless and contaminated tissues. After that, hand me some of Andover’s gauze and 10-0 nylon thread, then mark the blood vessels and nerves...”
Ling Ran had more issues to consider over here compared to when he was at Yun Hua Hospital’s operating theater.
This meant that the difficulty of the surgery had increased dramatically.
Ma Yanlin, as an assistant, was also busy in the corner. In fact, the nurses’ skills in the operating theater were not up to standard.
However, the imperfect surgery still needed to be carried out in the end.
At the end of the day, most surgeries were imperfect anyway, and that was just the world Ling Ran was familiar with.
“Clean this severed end.” Ma Yanlin was so busy that he broke out in sweat. When his sweat was wiped off roughly by a middle-aged part timer next to him, he felt as if his skin would fall off.
“Loosen the tourniquet,” Ling Ran commanded. When he noticed the active bleeding, he let out a sigh of relief. “Fasten the tourniquet. Wipe my sweat.”
Selena only translated the parts concerning the tourniquet. She then picked up the gauze herself, then dabbed it gently and carefully against Ling Ran’s forehead.

chapters.title: Chapter 770: The Skill Book Stands Arrogantly
paragraphs: “Prepare some 3-0 thread, and look for 5-0 silk suture to suture the nail bed.”
“Fix the bone fragments.”
“The bone should shrink around 0.4 inches.”
It had been some time since Ling Ran last performed a finger replantation. He felt excited and high-spirited, as if there was a tidal wave in him. He might appear normal, but he was full of energy.

Ma Yanlin operated in a flurry and corrected his own movements from time to time. It took him some time to enter the mood. He craned his neck and whispered, “The medical case today can be considered as a special case, right? The toes have been severed for three hours, and that is if we don’t consider the time he was unconscious. The wound has also gone through serious contamination. We don’t have enough drugs either... It’s a waste that Yu Yuan is not around, otherwise she could have written an article on this.”
“I’ll leave it to you,” Ling Ran said calmly.
Ma Yanlin blinked and instantly regretted his words. ‘Why did I speak so much? Doctor Ling prefers his surgeries to be quiet...’
“Doctor Ling, I’m not good at writing articles.” Ma Yanlin wanted to resist a little.
Ling Ran continued to operate the 10X microscope without looking at Ma Yanlin and said, “You can treat it as practice... Hmm, write an English article. Strive hard to publish a good article.”
This time round, Ma Yanlin’s orbicularis oculi muscle and levator muscle became stiff. ‘I really talked too much.’
During the time for surgery, the operating theater became very silent.
Aside from Ling Ran occasionally giving instructions, only the praises from the nurses and part-time nurses could be heard.
“Doctor Ling’s movements are so handsome.”
“Doctor Ling is so handsome.”
“Doctor Ling, are you tired?”

Ma Yanlin had heard similar compliments a lot, so he automatically translated them into cheers. In his heart, Ma Yanlin was even hoping that if he became the chief surgeon, became successful, and became a department director one day, there would also be young nurses praising him by the side and saying that he was incredibly handsome.
“Knee joint area. Try anatomical reduction.” Ling Ran ordered Ma Yanlin and continued to do his work.

Three severed toes. If this happened at Yun Hua Hospital, Ling Ran should be able to finish it within two to three hours, and that was if he had a perfect team, a complete set of instruments, and also a complete set of drugs and consumables.

Naturally, Guozheng Charity Hospital could not have such conditions. Forget about the fact that they had their supplies cut off during the storm, even without the storm, Guozheng Charity Hospital did not plan to provide the facilities to provide finger replantation for patients.

Small places like Cuba Town did not even have a proper industrial area within a circular area of a few hundred miles. The main reason for them to have any of their fingers or toes severed would be due to agricultural production, and some even got their fingers bitten off by horses or cows. The number of severed fingers or toes in a year was very little. For those who were injured, their subconscious would also make them run to a big city in order to save their fingers.
Most importantly, the doctors in Guozheng Charity Hospital usually did not want to perform finger replantation.

Regardless of whether it was orthopedists or other specialists, finger replantation did not require many skills. However, finger replantation was ranked among the top when it came to high workload and surgery difficulty.

When compared to hip replacement surgery, which also lasted for three hours, that surgery was like solving an ingenious mathematics question. Even though there were many calculations involved, the sense of achievement was greater.
On the other hand, three hours of finger replantation could hardly give a normal doctor a sense of achievement. It was just like answering a mathematics questions with a lot of stupid calculations.
In countries like Brazil, a country with commercialized medical services, the doctors would sense that difficulty even more.

The cost of a three-hour length finger replantation was only slightly higher than finger amputation, yet the workload was much higher. So, not many surgeons would volunteer to ask for finger replantations.
Regardless of which hospital the patients went to, that hospital would be the unlucky one. The young doctors in the small hospital did not even want to bear this responsibility.

Tian Guozheng might be rich enough to build the hospital, but he would not be able to manage the hospital business right down to the details. There were a total of around thirty medical staff in Guozheng Charity Hospital, and it would be impossible for them to explore all fields in the medical profession. The doctors would casually choose what they wanted or did not want to do.
If it were not because vascular sutures and nerve anastomosis was something that many medical fields required, Ling Ran might not even find a suitable microscope.
Naldo severed three toes, and Ling Ran nearly used four hours before he finished suturing all of them, and it could be considered as one of his slower surgeries.
However, after coming out of the operating theater, Ling Ran looked happy. Afterall, a four hour surgery was like letting him play for four hours. In some sense, it had a high cost-performance ratio.

Of course, purposely delaying the surgery could not be counted as a joy. This was just like playing a game. Only when a person chose challenges with high difficulty that the game was fun. If the person had to repeat the same simple moves, the person will soon lose interest in the game.

“Storm, please end soon. I’m tired.” Ma Yanlin did not care whether he enjoyed it or not. He was not a man who could persist for long. Otherwise, his wife would not constantly feel sad when she came back.
Ling Ran smiled while listening. “It will be better if the storm can stop earlier.”
“Doctor Ling, you also agree?” Ma Yanlin gazed at Ling Ran in surprise.

“Since we are out for so long, the hospital beds at Yun Hua Hospital should be empty... After the storm, we can go back to Yun Hua Hospital to perform surgeries. In comparison, I’m still more familiar with Chinese anatomy...” Ling Ran answered Ma Yanlin in a logical manner.
Ma Yanlin gulped and said, “After the storm, it’s obvious that we will have to rest for a few days.”
“You can rest for two days if you need. I do not need that.” Ling Ran did his work by drinking Energy Serums, and resting was usually placed very low on his priority list.
Selena trailed behind them. She followed both of them and whispered to Ma Yanlin at that moment, “Are you surprised?”
Ma Yanlin glanced at her. “After the storm, we can go back to China, do you have a visa?”
Selena’s expression changed a little bit. She snorted and ignored him.

“I’ll take a look at the main hall and go for a ward round. Ma Yanlin, please go to the recovery room.” Ling Ran was used to the storm at Guozheng Charity Hospital. After he performed a major surgery, he walked slowly to the main hall to perform minor surgeries while doing some minor maneuvers like changing the dressing, then went to wander around the ward.

Guozheng Charity Hospital stopped its operations as many medical staff went away. But before the storm, all wards remained functioning normally, so even after the storm, the accommodations at Guozheng Charity Hospital became better. If it were not due to the lack of nurses and care workers and everyone treated the rooms as normal lodges, even if one person took up one room, there will still be extra rooms left.
While Ling Ran did his ward round, he soon received seven Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chests.

‘Open them.’ Ling Ran had received hundreds of Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chests over the past few days. Almost every patient had given him a Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chest. Even if they gave these Treasure Chests to him one after another, the ratio was the highest among what Ling Ran had ever encountered.
The only thing he found regretful was that he did not obtain any skills.
The current situation did not allow Ling Ran to accumulate Treasure Chests quietly too. So, he would open all Treasure Chests right when he received a batch.
He turned around and saw a skill book standing arrogantly in blue light.
Ling Ran could not help but stood in the corridor, waved his hands, and opened this prideful skill book. He saw a line of words on its cover page.
[Single Skill Book: Milligan-Morgan Skill (Perfect Level)]

[Description: The most commonly used hemorrhoid ligation and resection skill at the current age. There are some improvements on this technique, such as segmenting jugged ligation, semi-open suture, retaining the dentate line, and so on.]

Only when a person chose challenges with high difficulty that the game was fun.
If the person had to repeat the same simple moves, the person will soon lose interest in the game.
“Storm, please end soon.
I’m tired.” Ma Yanlin did not care whether he enjoyed it or not.
He was not a man who could persist for long.
Otherwise, his wife would not constantly feel sad when she came back.
Ling Ran smiled while listening.
“It will be better if the storm can stop earlier.”
“Doctor Ling, you also agree?” Ma Yanlin gazed at Ling Ran in surprise.
“Since we are out for so long, the hospital beds at Yun Hua Hospital should be empty...
After the storm, we can go back to Yun Hua Hospital to perform surgeries.
In comparison, I’m still more familiar with Chinese anatomy...” Ling Ran answered Ma Yanlin in a logical manner.
Ma Yanlin gulped and said, “After the storm, it’s obvious that we will have to rest for a few days.”
“You can rest for two days if you need.
I do not need that.” Ling Ran did his work by drinking Energy Serums, and resting was usually placed very low on his priority list.
Selena trailed behind them.
She followed both of them and whispered to Ma Yanlin at that moment, “Are you surprised?”
Ma Yanlin glanced at her.
“After the storm, we can go back to China, do you have a visa?”
Selena’s expression changed a little bit.
She snorted and ignored him.
“I’ll take a look at the main hall and go for a ward round.
Ma Yanlin, please go to the recovery room.” Ling Ran was used to the storm at Guozheng Charity Hospital.
After he performed a major surgery, he walked slowly to the main hall to perform minor surgeries while doing some minor maneuvers like changing the dressing, then went to wander around the ward.
Guozheng Charity Hospital stopped its operations as many medical staff went away.
But before the storm, all wards remained functioning normally, so even after the storm, the accommodations at Guozheng Charity Hospital became better.
If it were not due to the lack of nurses and care workers and everyone treated the rooms as normal lodges, even if one person took up one room, there will still be extra rooms left.
While Ling Ran did his ward round, he soon received seven Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chests.
‘Open them.’ Ling Ran had received hundreds of Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chests over the past few days.
Almost every patient had given him a Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chest.
Even if they gave these Treasure Chests to him one after another, the ratio was the highest among what Ling Ran had ever encountered.
The only thing he found regretful was that he did not obtain any skills.
The current situation did not allow Ling Ran to accumulate Treasure Chests quietly too.
So, he would open all Treasure Chests right when he received a batch.
He turned around and saw a skill book standing arrogantly in blue light.
Ling Ran could not help but stood in the corridor, waved his hands, and opened this prideful skill book.
He saw a line of words on its cover page.
[Single Skill Book: Milligan-Morgan Skill (Perfect Level)]
[Description: The most commonly used hemorrhoid ligation and resection skill at the current age.
There are some improvements on this technique, such as segmenting jugged ligation, semi-open suture, retaining the dentate line, and so on.]

chapters.title: Chapter 771: Haha
paragraphs: Ling Ran looked at the smug-looking skill book in front of him and did not tap it even after a long period of time had passed.
As a doctor, Ling Ran had dissected and treated intestines multiple times. Although he did not like it, he did not mind doing that.
In his life, he disliked many things. Thus, he did not care whether the things he had more or fewer things he disliked.

However, for Ling Ran, hemorrhoid surgery was kind of meaningless. It was mainly because the skills required were lesser, and it was obvious based on the level of the skill provided by the system. For skills which required more techniques like hepatectomy, a Basic Treasure Chest can only give him Master Level, while for skills which required less techniques, if he opened a Basic Treasure Chest, he could get a Perfect Level for them.
Among all kinds of low level skills, hemorrhoid surgery, particularly traditional hemorrhoid surgery, used even fewer skills.
Of course, when a doctor had a craftsmanship spirit, they would still be able to perform any procedure in fine detail. But from Ling Ran’s perspective, the meaning was different.

First of all, hemorrhoid surgery itself could not resolve the problem of hemorrhoids. This greatly reduced the purpose of carrying out hemorrhoid surgery. After all, hemorrhoid surgery was a mature surgery, yet its nature was not mature at all.
So, after learning hemorrhoid surgery, did he still need to start farming hemorrhoid surgeries?

Ling Ran shook his head and patted the arrogant skill book with the attitude that he might as well get it, since he did not know how to perform the surgery previously, and he was considered to have learned the skill.
‘Mastering skills will allow me to do whatever I want.’ That was the attitude Ling Ran used to treat it.
“Doctor Ling, Naldo has woken up.” Ma Yanlin snuck over.
Ling Ran stared at him. “Who’s that?”
“That plump man... The patient who had three toes severed is awake now.” Ma Yanlin explained with a little guiltily
Ling Ran frowned. “Why is he awake so soon?”

Ma Yanlin was even more guilty. “Maybe during the anesthesia, the dose given was a little less. Hmm...the patient is heavier, and he might have used other anesthetic drugs in private, and the surgery was also long.”
“Is there any awareness with recall?” Ling Ran asked.

“I asked. Should be no. It’s just that he woke up faster...” Ma Yanlin immediately shook his head and said, “I prepared the dose according to the anesthesia teaching material in our country. Perhaps South Americans need a higher dose...”

Ling Ran stared at Ma Yanlin and did not continue to blame him. Anesthesia resistance was kind of troublesome for all anesthetists. That was because no one would ever know the patients’ resistance levels, and since there was no exact data in this area to rely on, the doctors could only rely on experience. Ma Yanlin and him did not have any experience with anesthesia.

On the other hand, it would not be better to increase the dose in order to prevent anesthesia resistance. If the patient had a lower anesthesia resistance or lower tolerance level, a four-hour surgery could already make the patient die on the operating table.

Ling Ran turned and walked forward before he said, “Go and check on the patient first. If he woke up normally, make a record of that. Then, we won’t be administering anesthesia in the following surgery.”
“What should we do?”
“Can the satellite phone be used now? Let Brazil send a professional anesthetist, and we’ll communicate through the phone.”
“I’m afraid that the doctors from Brazil do not want to bear the responsibility.” Ma Yanlin did not trust this.
Ling Ran walked while saying, “Then, we’ll just reduce the surgery volume. We won’t be performing any surgery unless it’s necessary.”

Ma Yanlin complained with a low voice, “Who knows when the storm will stop? What we do are all compulsory surgeries. The current environment is still okay, since we still have disinfectant solutions from Cuba Town. If the wounds of the previous patients were not handled well, they could be suppurated and be infected, and let’s not forget about those with more serious injuries. We even have to be careful when we use antibiotics.”
Ling Ran refused to give any comments.

The surgeons’ work was always about balancing the advantages and drawbacks in their actions. Even surgeries like cholelithiasis also required a balance between treatment through surgery and conservative treatment. Naturally, the surgeon will also need to consider the risk of external injuries and anesthesia on the patient.

Even if the patients suffered through the same injuries, as surgeons, their basis of judgment would be different for the patients who came to them during the earlier stage of the floor and those who came to them now.
Ma Yanlin did know about this, but he just could not help grumbling about it a little.
When Ma Yanlin reached the recovery room, Ma Yanlin changed his expression and became serious.
“How do you feel?” Ling Ran asked the routine questions like a normal ward round.
Naldo opened his eyes wide and stared at Ling Ran for a while without any focus in his eyes. Then, he slowly focused his gaze, sighed, and said, “Are you an angel?”
“No. Your surgery just ended.” Ling Ran said calmly.

“That’s not right... I feel myself floating...” It was clear that Naldo had not regained his consciousness entirely. If he were in the Department of Anesthesiology right now, he will need to be placed under further observation.
“Except for floating, do you experience anything else?” Ling Ran continued to ask.
Naldo moved his head. “I want to fly... Where am I now?”
“This is the postanesthesia recovery unit. You just had surgery. Do you remember it?”
“Is it hemorrhoid surgery?”
Ling Ran frowned. “No.”
“Oh, then I can’t remember it.”
Ma Yanlin sighed in relief. Although intraoperative awareness could not be completely removed, in the current situation, they had avoided most risks.

Ling Ran looked at the display screen and made a few physical examinations to ensure there was no problem. Before he went out, he told Ma Yanlin, “Check on the patient and see if he has any issue with hemorrhoids.”

“Nine out of ten men will have hemorrhoids, since Brazil is so hot.” Ma Yanlin pursed his lips. “I checked him before you, and I already found it. He has been sitting on a wheelchair for a few days and was immersed in a flood before this. It’s not something strange even if his hemorrhoids burst.”
“Check again.” Ling Ran reminded him and continued doing his ward round.
Ma Yanlin shrugged, but was not unwilling to do so. If he added in his years as an intern, he had been working as a doctor for three years, and his tolerance level had increased a lot.
Thirty minutes later...

“Damn.” Ma Yanlin found Ling Ran, and his eyes were about to pop out of their sockets. He kept repeating himself, “The longer you live, the more things you see. The longer you live, the more things you see...”
Ling Ran stared at him quietly.

“As big as a duck egg... Have you seen hemorrhoids the size of a duck egg?” Ma Yanlin used his hands to illustrate what he saw, and he looked like he was stuffed with a duck egg. He sighed and said, “South America is rich in resources, and even their hemorrhoids are bigger than ours.”
“How’s the patient?”

“The anesthetic is about to wear off soon, and he has started to feel the pain. He looks like he wants to die from the pain now.” Ma Yanlin felt sorry for him and trembled. “He’s covered in lacerations, and he has three severed toes. Now, he also has a hemorrhoid the size of a duck egg. We can only let him lie sideways. Lying downwards will affect his toes, and lying on his back will affect the hemorrhoid... Ouch...”
Ma Yanlin looked like he wanted to laugh, but he knew it would not be appropriate if he laughed out loud, so he could only try to not laugh.
Ling Ran hesitated for a few seconds, sighed, and said, “Then, ask him whether he wants to perform hemorrhoid surgery. If he wants it, I’ll do that for him.”
“Huh, you know how to carry out hemorrhoid surgery as well?” Ma Yanlin looked at Ling Ran and said, “None of us know it.”
Ling Ran felt uninterested as he looked at Ma Yanlin and said, “You’ll still be the assistant. Try your best to learn it.”
Ma Yanlin had a thought in his mind. “Doctor Zuo must need this. Once I master it, haha...”
