chapters.title: Chapter 772: Color Changed
paragraphs: It was early in the morning.
The sky started to become bright.
Cheers could be heard constantly from the courtyard of Guozheng Charity Hospital. Some people shouted loudly in Portuguese and English, while laughter and screaming were also heard.
Ling Ran rubbed his eyes while walking out of the waiting room. Then, he took a look at the weather outside and could not help but feel relieved.
The rain stopped.

“I heard that the southern region is still raining, but there should be a short period where there is no rain.” A Chinese girl who came from Cuba Town was sitting in the corridor. When she saw Ling Ran coming out, she quickly stood up and told him about the situation as she observed Ling Ran’s facial expression.
Ling Ran nodded and asked, “Will there be any helicopters coming over?”

“I heard that we will need at least two hours of no rain before the helicopter can come, so the earliest will be tomorrow,” the girl quickly answered before she asked, “Doctor Ling, do you want to have your breakfast? You can eat in the restaurant, but if you want to, we can also deliver your meal here.”

Ling Ran touched his tummy; he was slightly hungry. Unlike the others who rested very early at night, even if Ling Ran did not have surgery at night, he was still willing to take an Energy Serum and quietly read a book or do something else.
A week was enough for him to know a little bit about anesthesiology. This alone allowed him to surpass most surgeons.
However, this habit also made Ling Ran have his breakfast very early, and he would eat a lot.
“I’ll eat on the balcony.” Ling Ran had not seen the sun for a few days, so he was quite happy when he saw the sun.
“Sure.” She did not ask anything else, but just spoke into the walkie talkie for a while. Then, some people ran up to set things up on the balcony.
Soon, when Tian Qi came up to the floor, a small square table with eight dishes, one sauce, and two bowls of soup were placed there.
Ling Ran and Tian Qi sat across each other. They looked at the sun beside them, and they both felt good.
“It’s still better when the sun is around.” Tian Qi put on a blue hat and wore a tailor-made dress. She looked a little mischievous and elegant.

Ling Ran still wore a rather crude-looking scrub. He naturally spread fruit jam on the bread. Even though the passage in Cuba Town was opened, only trucks can somewhat pass through it, so the food in the hospital was not that much better.
A breakfast with eight dishes almost covered most of the types of food.

Ling Ran passed a slice of bread with well-spread jam to Tian Qi and said, “If helicopters come tomorrow, you can go back first. Three seriously wounded patients need to undergo surgery as soon as possible, but the helicopter can still be fitted with a few more people.”

Tian Qi took the slice of bread, smiled sweetly, and said, “I’m not in a hurry to go back. The hospital is very safe, and the resources here are also sufficient. In fact, it’s not very safe for the helicopter if it needs to go back and forth during the period where there is no rain.”
Her reason was very sufficient. Tian Qi also did not try to convince Ling Ran to let her stay.

There were at least one hundred patients in Guozheng Charity Hospital now. Their injuries varied in degrees of severity, but they could not completely leave Ling Ran. Meanwhile, just as Tian Qi mentioned, coming back and forth with the helicopter was not completely safe.

Flight during the period with no rain was in itself a risk. It was not very dangerous, but there were still risks involved. If they were not in a hurry to leave, they should just stay for a few days more and wait for the storm to stop. At that time, even if the land transportation was still not convenient, taking the helicopter to come back and forth was still safer and more comfortable.

Guozheng Charity Hospital had taken in consideration of storms and deluge when it was first designed. The location did not face the risk of mudflows, and it was just slightly inconvenient for them to carry out their daily activities if they stayed here.
Ling Ran did not think too much about it. He just nodded and said, “Then, just stay in the hospital and contact those you need through the satellite phone.”
“Okay.” Tian Qi nodded repeatedly. She then bit down gently on the slice of bread with fruit jam and smiled with satisfaction.

Ling Ran continued to spread fruit jam on a slice of bread for himself. The method he used was similar to him spreading bio-gel after a hepatectomy. He could easily check whether it was even as well, and it was simple and brought him great comfort.
His only regret was that bread covered in fruit jam did not taste good enough.

In the afternoon, the people who stayed in the hospital and Cuba Town started to discuss about who should leave first. The atmosphere during the discussion was not very tense. After all, the carrying capacity of a helicopter was limited, and they had few helicopters, so most of the people could only leave after the roads on land were opened.
For the residents of Cuba Town who were made to stay here, they would still be homeless even if they left with the helicopter, so they would just wait for the rain to stop.

It was different for Naldo, who had three toes amputated and had his hemorrhoid rupture. He shouted in pain in the ward, and when he saw Ling Ran coming for a ward round, he screeched even more, “I can’t make it anymore, hurry up and send me to Rio de Janeiro...”
“If your emotions are not stable, it’ll be very easy for your toes to go through necrosis.” Ling Ran first reminded him of this before he came forward to perform a physical examination.
In just a few days, the number of physical examinations that Ling Ran performed reached the number he performed in the previous month.

When he was in Yun Hua Hospital or performed freelance surgeries in other hospitals, if the patient required an examination in the ward, they would get the instruments like ECG monitor to help them, and they did not even need to consider problems like electricity supply.
However, Guozheng Charity Hospital was in the midst of a flood, and it was only natural that it did not have such facilities.
Things including the measuring of blood pressure were done by the medical staff, and the number of medical staff in Guozheng Charity Hospital was much smaller compared to Yun Hua Hospital.
There were many times where Ling Ran needed to perform a physical examination before he could judge the patient’s condition.
Naldo was eager to get down the bed when he shouted, but when Ling Ran checked him, he instantly became quiet as he was also worried that his body will suffer through necrosis.
After Ling Ran performed a simple physical examination, Naldo then shouted again, “I want to go to Rio de Janeiro...”
“If you queue up now, you’ll probably wait until the day after tomorrow before you can go.” Ling Ran did not oppose it.

While Selena translated, she also helped explain the situation to Naldo, “There’s only one helicopter coming back and forth today. There will be two helicopters tomorrow, but we’re not sure if they can make two rounds or not.”
“Two helicopters, and it’s still not my turn?” Naldo shouted.
“Your toes have already been connected, so now you only have the problem with your hemorrhoid. You’re queued at around thirty.” Ling Ran reported the order to him in a straightforward manner.
Naldo felt like he was sitting on a cactus plant. He raised his head and looked at Ling Ran. “I’m only ranked at around thirty with this condition? What should I do to make it to the front?”
“You’ll need two more finger amputations or an perform orchiectomy.” Ling Ran directly answered Naldo’s question.
Naldo was furious, “I’m in so much pain, and I still can’t go yet?”
Ling Ran nodded. “Even if you leave Guozheng Charity Hospital, when you reach Rio de Janeiro, you will still be in pain.”
“I can undergo surgery when I reach Rio de Janeiro!” Naldo almost went crazy.
Ling Ran calmly said, “You can still get surgery in Guozheng Charity Hospital.”

Even though Ling Ran did not want to perform hemorrhoid surgery for Naldo, he would also not mind it if the patient requested it. After all, it was still a surgery. Although there was slight discrimination against it because of its lack of class, he could not regard it with too much discrimination.
Naldo wanted to say he could persevere through the pain, but the ‘goose egg’ at the bottom part of his body did not agree to it.

“Perform the surgery for me, please. I can’t wait for three days.” Naldo knew that even if he had a hemorrhoid, he could not just get his surgery done because he wanted it when he reached Rio de Janeiro.

When he reached a place where he could get surgery, the Emergency Department will be the only place that will allow him to jump queue if he were in a life or death situation. Aside from that one department, the patients could only keep queuing up for surgery.

The medical system in Brazil implemented the westerners’ doctor cultivation system, which meant doctors were rare resources. To cover up for the shortage of doctors, Brazil needed to spend money to “buy” the favor of about twenty thousand Cuban doctors to help them every year.
For a reporter like Naldo, he could not afford a private doctor, so when he got to a big city, he could only wait in pain. Therefore, he should just get his surgery done here.
However, after the hemorrhoid surgery, he might not be able to have the chance to loiter around and take pictures in Guozheng Charity Hospital.
Naldo stared at the white ceiling, and his desire to move up his career seemed to change like the blood in his stool.

At that time, even if the land transportation was still not convenient, taking the helicopter to come back and forth was still safer and more comfortable.
Guozheng Charity Hospital had taken in consideration of storms and deluge when it was first designed.
The location did not face the risk of mudflows, and it was just slightly inconvenient for them to carry out their daily activities if they stayed here.
Ling Ran did not think too much about it.
He just nodded and said, “Then, just stay in the hospital and contact those you need through the satellite phone.”
“Okay.” Tian Qi nodded repeatedly.
She then bit down gently on the slice of bread with fruit jam and smiled with satisfaction.
Ling Ran continued to spread fruit jam on a slice of bread for himself.
The method he used was similar to him spreading bio-gel after a hepatectomy.
He could easily check whether it was even as well, and it was simple and brought him great comfort.
His only regret was that bread covered in fruit jam did not taste good enough.
In the afternoon, the people who stayed in the hospital and Cuba Town started to discuss about who should leave first.
The atmosphere during the discussion was not very tense.
After all, the carrying capacity of a helicopter was limited, and they had few helicopters, so most of the people could only leave after the roads on land were opened.
For the residents of Cuba Town who were made to stay here, they would still be homeless even if they left with the helicopter, so they would just wait for the rain to stop.
It was different for Naldo, who had three toes amputated and had his hemorrhoid rupture.
He shouted in pain in the ward, and when he saw Ling Ran coming for a ward round, he screeched even more, “I can’t make it anymore, hurry up and send me to Rio de Janeiro...”
“If your emotions are not stable, it’ll be very easy for your toes to go through necrosis.” Ling Ran first reminded him of this before he came forward to perform a physical examination.
In just a few days, the number of physical examinations that Ling Ran performed reached the number he performed in the previous month.

When he was in Yun Hua Hospital or performed freelance surgeries in other hospitals, if the patient required an examination in the ward, they would get the instruments like ECG monitor to help them, and they did not even need to consider problems like electricity supply.
However, Guozheng Charity Hospital was in the midst of a flood, and it was only natural that it did not have such facilities.
Things including the measuring of blood pressure were done by the medical staff, and the number of medical staff in Guozheng Charity Hospital was much smaller compared to Yun Hua Hospital.
There were many times where Ling Ran needed to perform a physical examination before he could judge the patient’s condition.
Naldo was eager to get down the bed when he shouted, but when Ling Ran checked him, he instantly became quiet as he was also worried that his body will suffer through necrosis.
After Ling Ran performed a simple physical examination, Naldo then shouted again, “I want to go to Rio de Janeiro...”
“If you queue up now, you’ll probably wait until the day after tomorrow before you can go.” Ling Ran did not oppose it.
While Selena translated, she also helped explain the situation to Naldo, “There’s only one helicopter coming back and forth today.
There will be two helicopters tomorrow, but we’re not sure if they can make two rounds or not.”
“Two helicopters, and it’s still not my turn?” Naldo shouted.
“Your toes have already been connected, so now you only have the problem with your hemorrhoid.
You’re queued at around thirty.” Ling Ran reported the order to him in a straightforward manner.
Naldo felt like he was sitting on a cactus plant.
He raised his head and looked at Ling Ran.
“I’m only ranked at around thirty with this condition?
What should I do to make it to the front?”
“You’ll need two more finger amputations or an perform orchiectomy.” Ling Ran directly answered Naldo’s question.
Naldo was furious, “I’m in so much pain, and I still can’t go yet?”
Ling Ran nodded.
“Even if you leave Guozheng Charity Hospital, when you reach Rio de Janeiro, you will still be in pain.”
“I can undergo surgery when I reach Rio de Janeiro!” Naldo almost went crazy.
Ling Ran calmly said, “You can still get surgery in Guozheng Charity Hospital.”
Even though Ling Ran did not want to perform hemorrhoid surgery for Naldo, he would also not mind it if the patient requested it.
After all, it was still a surgery.
Although there was slight discrimination against it because of its lack of class, he could not regard it with too much discrimination.
Naldo wanted to say he could persevere through the pain, but the ‘goose egg’ at the bottom part of his body did not agree to it.
“Perform the surgery for me, please.
I can’t wait for three days.” Naldo knew that even if he had a hemorrhoid, he could not just get his surgery done because he wanted it when he reached Rio de Janeiro.
When he reached a place where he could get surgery, the Emergency Department will be the only place that will allow him to jump queue if he were in a life or death situation.
Aside from that one department, the patients could only keep queuing up for surgery.
The medical system in Brazil implemented the westerners’ doctor cultivation system, which meant doctors were rare resources.
To cover up for the shortage of doctors, Brazil needed to spend money to “buy” the favor of about twenty thousand Cuban doctors to help them every year.
For a reporter like Naldo, he could not afford a private doctor, so when he got to a big city, he could only wait in pain.
Therefore, he should just get his surgery done here.
However, after the hemorrhoid surgery, he might not be able to have the chance to loiter around and take pictures in Guozheng Charity Hospital.
Naldo stared at the white ceiling, and his desire to move up his career seemed to change like the blood in his stool.

chapters.title: Chapter 773: A Common Illness
paragraphs: The ECG monitor looked a little bit like traditional light boxes in karaokes.
The German-made anesthesia ventilator was cast aside. No one was using it at all.

There was a catheter inserted into Naldo’s body, and his breathing was hurried as he looked at the floor. Even though he was lying face-down, his hips were raised as the second half of the operating bed was elevated. This made him look like a folding knife.
Whenever the hips and legs of a person lying face-down were elevated, he would look like a folding knife.

Ling Ran walked around the operating bed and looked around. He inspected the clothes that were wrapped around Naldo’s limbs to prevent him from getting scalded by the endotherm knife during the surgery,
After he inspected everything carefully, Ling Ran ordered, “Go ahead and administer anesthetics.”
Ma Yanlin stepped forward with a solemn expression.
Meanwhile, Ling Ran grabbed the patient’s examination slip, unfolded it, and started reading it.

The examination slip had been translated and handwritten. Basic tests such as kidney function test, urine test, and stool analysis were performed. The samples were sent outside via a helicopter, and they got the results through the satellite phone.

Before this, due to the circumstances, Ling Ran had no choice but to make do with what he had. Right now, the rain had stopped for a while. Even though the span of time was not enough for them to evacuate all the patients, they could send quite a lot of samples to get tested in laboratories outside.
Such was Ling Ran’s habit. Even if it was only a hemorrhoid surgery, he would like to have as many tests done as possible.
“Let’s get started.” Ling Ran glanced at the figures on the ECG monitor. He did not bother to confirm things with Ma Yanlin.
Both the doctors were self-trained and rookie anesthetists, and there was no point in them confirming things with each other.
Ling Ran turned and pointed at the stainless steel plate. “Large-curved hemostatic forceps.”
“Okay.” The nurse immediately handed the pair of hemostatic forceps to Ling Ran.

Under normal circumstances, doctors did not need to provide guidance to the nurse, and they might not even need to name the instruments they needed. When it came to common surgeries, the nurses might even know the instruments better than the doctors.

However, the doctors did not have this privilege as they worked in Guozheng Charity Hospital, and the only nurse left did not even speak their language. Moreover, the nurse had never participated in a hemorrhoid surgery before. Guozheng Charity Hospital offered a very limited number of surgical programmes, and this was why the nurse had not participated in many kinds of surgeries before.
Ling Ran clamped the internal hemorrhoid forcefully with the forceps.
As Ma Yanlin saw how grotesque the internal hemorrhoid was, which was as large as a goose’s egg looked, he could not help but tremble a little. “It’s really shocking to the eyes.”

“7-0 surgical thread.” Ling Ran was not swayed, and he had no intention of chatting with Ma Yanlin. He grabbed the thick surgical thread which had been inserted into a needle. He then quickly made a figure-8 loop on the hemorrhoid on top of where the forceps were clamped. Next, he made a knot.

“Scalpel.” Ling Ran asked for a scalpel and cut open the patient’s skin at the position below where the large-curved hemostatic forceps was clamped. He then made a large V-shaped incision along the line he had drawn before this...
Ling Ran had never favoured small incisions.
Whenever he carried out surgeries, Ling Ran took a lot of things into consideration, and he was a careful person. Because of this, he had always preferred to make large incisions.
And because the internal hemorrhoid was as large as a goose’s egg, it was impossible for Ling Ran to make a small incision even if he wanted to.
“Scissors.” Ling Ran tossed the scalpel aside and raised his left hand to ask for a pair of scissors. He raised the hemostatic forceps in his left hand and pulled up the body of the hemorrhoid.
In short, right now, what Ling Ran had to do was to remove a sarcoma which was as large as a goose egg from the patient’s anus and try his best not to hurt any surrounding tissues.

There were actually many similar surgeries. This was how facial acne and cysts were removed too. The difference was that hemorrhoids were often larger, and it was not like the patient could see it in the mirror. Hence, they often were not aware of how large the hemorrhoid had become.
For doctors, the removal of hemorrhoids, acne, and cysts were basically the same. It was just that the incidence rate of hemorrhoids was higher.

After the internal hemorrhoid which was as large as a goose’s egg was removed, Ling Ran made a figure-eight loop at where it was. The surgery was almost done. Next, he carefully removed the rest of the internal hemorrhoids... Ma Yanlin did not really have anything to do, and his gaze kept drifting towards the large hemorrhoid the size of a goose’s egg that had been removed.
“I’ll leave the rest to you.” Ling Ran did not have the intention to finish up the surgery.
Hemorrhoids surgery was one of the most basic surgeries, and this patient’s hemorrhoids were not located at a fatal position. Hence, from a surgeon’s perspective, this surgery was a piece of cake.
If it were not for the fact that a lot of people suffer from hemorrhoids, most large hospitals would not even bother to offer this surgical method.
In Ling Ran’s opinion, though, hemorrhoid surgery was an extremely suitable kind of surgery to put in some practice.

In Ling Treatment Group, Ma Yanlin’s abilities were slightly inferior to those of Lu Wenbin and Zhang Anmin. However, this was mainly because he did not have enough experience. At the end of the day, all three of them were considered an ordinary elite doctor. Tertiary Grade A hospitals were full of resident doctors and attending physicians like them. As long as they received careful guidance and had enough opportunity to put in some practice, they would fare well. However, if they did not have enough chances to improve themselves, they would turn out to become mediocre doctors.
However, there was also competition within their treatment group.

Since Ma Yanlin was the weakest skill-wise, he received the least opportunities. Because he was often relegated to second assistant or third assistant, he did not have many chances to train his judgment.
Hence, simple surgeries like hemorrhoids surgery was just the right kind of surgery for Ma Yanlin to put in some practice right now.
This applied to Yu Yuan too...
Ling Ran made way for Ma Yanlin and started thinking about how to go about things.
A little not used to being in the spotlight, Ma Yanlin stepped forward and started cutting the ends of the hemorrhoids that had been tied. He then trimmed the incision and stopped the bleeding...
Ma Yanlin was drenched in cold sweat. There was no telling if it was because he was tired or scared.
Ling Ran watched the surgery and guided Ma Yanlin. When he saw that the nurse had passed Ma Yanlin a vaseline gauze for drainage, he left feeling at ease.
In a show of sharp-wit and alertness, Selena left together with Ling Ran.
The corridor of Guozheng Charity Hospital was quiet and peaceful.
Outside the window, it was raining cats and dogs again. However, those in the hospitals were feeling a lot more at peace.

Even though the rain had only stopped for two hours and the helicopter that was going back and forth had only evacuated three patients and two elderly and weak people, the people in the hospital were feeling a lot more hopeful after having their troubles come to an end.
The atmosphere in the hospital was so cheery that it was as if everyone was having a party.
Since death was no longer a treat, the place had become a lot livelier, and everyone’s will to live had become a lot stronger.
“Doctor Ling, you’re done with the surgery, aren’t you? Was it a success?” One of the patient’s family members staggered over.
Ling Ran nodded. “It was a success.”
“Hm... after the hemorrhoids are removed, there won’t be any pain anymore, right?”

“For postsurgical pain, you just need to take painkillers. Usually, there will be noticeable improvements after 48 hours.” Ling Ran thought about it and continued, “We encourage the patient to only defecate 24 hours later, and for the catheter to remain for 48 hours...” Ling Ran explained the situation and Selena translated what he was saying.
The patient’s family member became a little hesitant after he heard that.
Selena got anxious when she saw that and said, “Just spill the beans if you have anything to say. Doctor Ling is very busy...”

“My hemorrhoids have been giving me trouble too.” The patient’s family member sighed and said. “It’s because I’ve been sitting down too much. You know, it’s been raining for the past few days, and I had nothing else to do...”
“Do you want to receive surgery?” Ling Ran had not really been paying attention to how the patients’ family members were doing. He could not help but furrow his eyebrows.
“Can I?”

“We’ll have to look at the disease progression of your hemorrhoids.” Ling Ran paused for a moment and continued, “Or you can wait until the roads are cleared and head to a proper hospital for surgery.”

The patient’s family member shook his head furiously. “I put in my name at the hospital last year, but they did not allocate me a slot even after I waited for two months. I don’t want to wait anymore. Doctor Ling, can you please take a look at my condition...”
He then continued in a hushed tone, “I have a few friends who are suffering from hemorrhoids too.”
Three men dawdled over from another corridor as they coughed softly. They were walking in a weird manner due to the pain from their hemorrhoids.
Ling Ran nodded slightly. He then turned and said to Selena, “Ask Ma Yanlin to come over and take a look at their condition.”

chapters.title: Chapter 774: Limited Edition
paragraphs: The storm was long past.
Three helicopters, each producing a beam of golden light, landed in the distance, one after another. Then, people and resources started alighting.
Lucio, the person in charge of the site, was stepping onto the land of Cuba Town for the first time ever.
He was accompanied by four reporters. They took up the space of one and a half helicopters, causing the resources delivered this time to be fewer than those from the previous helicopters.

However, with the storm gone, it was no longer as dangerous, or dire. Without storms, the helicopters had a window of clear skies for at least five hours, more than enough to save Cuba Town, which only had about one thousand people. But now, the people no longer felt like leaving, and were less worried about their shortage of supplies.
After all, Cuba Town had always been remote.
At that moment, all residents surrounded the reporters and made their own statements.
“Many of our cows died, and it’s mostly because of insufficient feed. This is very cruel. We hope that the government can provide us with emergency feed—”

“Many houses collapsed, and the remaining houses are no longer safe. There’s also the issue with cleaning. There’s so much sludge around, and if we have to clean it ourselves, we’ll be working until the rainy season next year—”
“My fish pond is flooded, and the fish are gone... Yes, they’re all valuable fish...”
“There’re even more people who are sick now. We’re all relying on Doctor Ling from China to treat us. We need more doctors.”
When Lucio faced the public, he showed a smile on his face. The seemingly overwhelming demands did not seem to faze him one bit.
In Brazil, farming was still an occupation that occupied a moral high ground. Even though the ranchers and farmers made ridiculous requests, they were still easily forgiven.
The attitude of a politician was most important in this sort of situation, not the empty promises he made.
After all, then out of his ten promises would never be fulfilled.

After Ma Yanlin listened for a few minutes and experienced the political situation in Brazil, he followed a few nurses as they moved patients into the helicopter at the corner, where the cameras had their backs turned to.

The severely wounded patients were all sent away, but there were still patients who had undergone surgery and were not out of the woods yet. Some of the elderly were wracked with multiple underlying diseases. Guozheng Charity Hospital lacked doctors and medicine, so the patients’ conditions could not be stabilized.
A tiny shadow silently enveloped Ma Yanlin. “Those who don’t know will assume all of you operated on every patient.”
“Yu Yuan! I mean... Doctor Yu, you’re back?” Ma Yanlin was really surprised. He turned around twice before he saw Yu Yuan.
Yu Yuan put her hands behind her small calves. Her short height made her body seem full of energy.
Yu Yuan looked up to Houseman Ma Yanlin as a chief resident and asked in a whisper, “I heard that... you’ve performed seven hemorrhoid surgeries?”

Ma Yanlin laughed. “We even performed more than one hundred other surgeries, and they’re of different types. You don’t know this, but on the days when there was flood, this place was like the Emergency Department with only two people. We don’t even have an anesthetist. Doctor Ling and I did the anesthesia by looking through books...”
“And on top of that, you performed two intestinal obstruction repairs?”

“Only one, the other one was diagnosed as appendicitis later on. The facilities in the hospital are so bad that even the Pathology Department can’t operate. It was so intense at that time, because it meant we had to perform a laparotomy to check the patient. Before we let the patient sign, we just said it was slightly serious. After all, intestinal obstruction is more serious, right...?”
“You succeeded in all of them?”
“Yes. Oh yes, you went to Amazon rainforest, right? Is the view good? It’s the Lungs of the Earth, you know? It’s amazing...”

“I didn’t manage to go.” Yu Yuan had a sour expression and said, “When I just arrived, it was raining heavily. So we postponed for two days, but the rain was too heavy, so we had to come back,” Yu Yuan calmly said, “At the end, the only wildlife I really got to experience were the mosquitoes.”

Ma Yanlin felt inexplicably guilty. Then, he looked at Yu Yuan’s face before he said awkwardly, “I don’t see any mosquito bites... But, the mosquitoes in the tropical region are pretty awesome. Previously, the Yellow Fever was transmitted through mosquitoes...”

“I heard you also became a chief surgeon? Ling Ran had you do the last three of the seven hemorrhoid surgeries on your own, right?” Yu Yuan did not want to further discuss why she was not bitten by mosquitoes.
For her, this trip to Amazon had made her lose hundreds of chances to perform surgeries.
And if she had Ling Ran’s guidance for these hundreds of surgeries, she would have been able to become familiar with a new surgical style.

She did not need to perform the same surgery every time. There were always similarities between surgeries, and different surgeries will also employ the same techniques at certain moments. This was also one of the ways for junior doctors to practice their skills.

After all, junior doctors lacked basic skills. For example, the purse-string suture used in hemorrhoid surgery was applied in gastrectomy as well, and it was quite commonly seen in colorectal surgery.
In comparison, getting an opportunity to receive guidance from a senior doctor like Ling Ran was far more important.

Hemorrhoid surgery was even rarer. Yu Yuan could almost be certain that when Ling Ran left Brazil or before he left Brazil, if they were relieved of their current tension in the situation, Ling Ran may never perform hemorrhoid surgeries again.
In other words, what Ma Yanlin obtained was probably the Ling limited edition hemorrhoid surgery!
Yu Yuan’s face as she stared at Ma Yanlin was like a wild arowana staring at a loach.

Ma Yanlin stuttered, “It’s very hard to make an appointment for a surgery in a Brazilian hospital, but many people get hemorrhoids. Think about this, the weather is so hot and damp, and they always eat barbeque. When they sit for too long, they will easily get hemorrhoids... We are also solving the patient’s pain for them...”
“Then, you became the chief surgeon?” Yu Yuan asked.
“I watched Doctor Ling perform a few surgeries before I had the opportunity to be the chief surgeon,” Ma Yanlin answered in a low voice, “Hemorrhoid surgery is simple, you know that, right...?”
“I don’t know... I haven’t done many before...” Yu Yuan answered wistfully.
Ma Yanlin scratched his ears and cheeks while he looked around before he suddenly said, “The patients are here. Perfect timing, you can talk to the patients.”
When she looked over, a few patients walked over slowly like zombies.
The reporters were slightly stunned before they surged to them in the next moment.
“Hi, are you injured?”
“Hi, why are you injured?”
“We heard that working in the heavy rain was very hard, were you injured when you saved yourselves?”
The reporters caught on the topic of “injury” and eagerly asked questions.

Naldo’s lips trembled when he walked in the crowd. He said before the one who stood in front of him mentioned the word hemorrhoids, “That’s right, we’re all injured because of our jobs, and we were injured when we were in trouble.”
“Ah, can you explain in greater detail?” The reporters immediately passed the microphones over.

Naldo calmly wiggled his butt and moved 19 inches forward before he said, “Perhaps you might not be able to imagine it, but the most dangerous thing in Cuba Town is not the storm and mudflows, but the stressful environment, moist weather, and the rampant diseases...”

Lucio, the person in charge of the site, was stepping onto the land of Cuba Town for the first time ever.
He was accompanied by four reporters.
They took up the space of one and a half helicopters, causing the resources delivered this time to be fewer than those from the previous helicopters.
However, with the storm gone, it was no longer as dangerous, or dire.
Without storms, the helicopters had a window of clear skies for at least five hours, more than enough to save Cuba Town, which only had about one thousand people.
But now, the people no longer felt like leaving, and were less worried about their shortage of supplies.
After all, Cuba Town had always been remote.
At that moment, all residents surrounded the reporters and made their own statements.
“Many of our cows died, and it’s mostly because of insufficient feed.
This is very cruel.
We hope that the government can provide us with emergency feed—”
“Many houses collapsed, and the remaining houses are no longer safe.
There’s also the issue with cleaning.
There’s so much sludge around, and if we have to clean it ourselves, we’ll be working until the rainy season next year—”
“My fish pond is flooded, and the fish are gone...
Yes, they’re all valuable fish...”
“There’re even more people who are sick now.
We’re all relying on Doctor Ling from China to treat us.
We need more doctors.”
When Lucio faced the public, he showed a smile on his face.
The seemingly overwhelming demands did not seem to faze him one bit.
In Brazil, farming was still an occupation that occupied a moral high ground.
Even though the ranchers and farmers made ridiculous requests, they were still easily forgiven.
The attitude of a politician was most important in this sort of situation, not the empty promises he made.
After all, then out of his ten promises would never be fulfilled.

After Ma Yanlin listened for a few minutes and experienced the political situation in Brazil, he followed a few nurses as they moved patients into the helicopter at the corner, where the cameras had their backs turned to.
The severely wounded patients were all sent away, but there were still patients who had undergone surgery and were not out of the woods yet.
Some of the elderly were wracked with multiple underlying diseases.
Guozheng Charity Hospital lacked doctors and medicine, so the patients’ conditions could not be stabilized.
A tiny shadow silently enveloped Ma Yanlin.
“Those who don’t know will assume all of you operated on every patient.”
“Yu Yuan!
I mean...
Doctor Yu, you’re back?” Ma Yanlin was really surprised.
He turned around twice before he saw Yu Yuan.
Yu Yuan put her hands behind her small calves.
Her short height made her body seem full of energy.
Yu Yuan looked up to Houseman Ma Yanlin as a chief resident and asked in a whisper, “I heard that... you’ve performed seven hemorrhoid surgeries?”
Ma Yanlin laughed.
“We even performed more than one hundred other surgeries, and they’re of different types.
You don’t know this, but on the days when there was flood, this place was like the Emergency Department with only two people.
We don’t even have an anesthetist.
Doctor Ling and I did the anesthesia by looking through books...”
“And on top of that, you performed two intestinal obstruction repairs?”
“Only one, the other one was diagnosed as appendicitis later on.
The facilities in the hospital are so bad that even the Pathology Department can’t operate.
It was so intense at that time, because it meant we had to perform a laparotomy to check the patient.
Before we let the patient sign, we just said it was slightly serious.
After all, intestinal obstruction is more serious, right...?”
“You succeeded in all of them?”
“Yes.
Oh yes, you went to Amazon rainforest, right?
Is the view good?
It’s the Lungs of the Earth, you know?
It’s amazing...”
“I didn’t manage to go.” Yu Yuan had a sour expression and said, “When I just arrived, it was raining heavily.
So we postponed for two days, but the rain was too heavy, so we had to come back,” Yu Yuan calmly said, “At the end, the only wildlife I really got to experience were the mosquitoes.”
Ma Yanlin felt inexplicably guilty.
Then, he looked at Yu Yuan’s face before he said awkwardly, “I don’t see any mosquito bites...
But, the mosquitoes in the tropical region are pretty awesome.
Previously, the Yellow Fever was transmitted through mosquitoes...”
“I heard you also became a chief surgeon?
Ling Ran had you do the last three of the seven hemorrhoid surgeries on your own, right?” Yu Yuan did not want to further discuss why she was not bitten by mosquitoes.
For her, this trip to Amazon had made her lose hundreds of chances to perform surgeries.
And if she had Ling Ran’s guidance for these hundreds of surgeries, she would have been able to become familiar with a new surgical style.
She did not need to perform the same surgery every time.
There were always similarities between surgeries, and different surgeries will also employ the same techniques at certain moments.
This was also one of the ways for junior doctors to practice their skills.
After all, junior doctors lacked basic skills.
For example, the purse-string suture used in hemorrhoid surgery was applied in gastrectomy as well, and it was quite commonly seen in colorectal surgery.
In comparison, getting an opportunity to receive guidance from a senior doctor like Ling Ran was far more important.
Hemorrhoid surgery was even rarer.

Yu Yuan could almost be certain that when Ling Ran left Brazil or before he left Brazil, if they were relieved of their current tension in the situation, Ling Ran may never perform hemorrhoid surgeries again.
In other words, what Ma Yanlin obtained was probably the Ling limited edition hemorrhoid surgery!
Yu Yuan’s face as she stared at Ma Yanlin was like a wild arowana staring at a loach.
Ma Yanlin stuttered, “It’s very hard to make an appointment for a surgery in a Brazilian hospital, but many people get hemorrhoids.
Think about this, the weather is so hot and damp, and they always eat barbeque.
When they sit for too long, they will easily get hemorrhoids...
We are also solving the patient’s pain for them...”
“Then, you became the chief surgeon?” Yu Yuan asked.
“I watched Doctor Ling perform a few surgeries before I had the opportunity to be the chief surgeon,” Ma Yanlin answered in a low voice, “Hemorrhoid surgery is simple, you know that, right...?”
“I don’t know...
I haven’t done many before...” Yu Yuan answered wistfully.
Ma Yanlin scratched his ears and cheeks while he looked around before he suddenly said, “The patients are here.
Perfect timing, you can talk to the patients.”
When she looked over, a few patients walked over slowly like zombies.
The reporters were slightly stunned before they surged to them in the next moment.
“Hi, are you injured?”
“Hi, why are you injured?”
“We heard that working in the heavy rain was very hard, were you injured when you saved yourselves?”
The reporters caught on the topic of “injury” and eagerly asked questions.
Naldo’s lips trembled when he walked in the crowd.
He said before the one who stood in front of him mentioned the word hemorrhoids, “That’s right, we’re all injured because of our jobs, and we were injured when we were in trouble.”
“Ah, can you explain in greater detail?” The reporters immediately passed the microphones over.

Naldo calmly wiggled his butt and moved 19 inches forward before he said, “Perhaps you might not be able to imagine it, but the most dangerous thing in Cuba Town is not the storm and mudflows, but the stressful environment, moist weather, and the rampant diseases...”

chapters.title: Chapter 775: Chinese Style
paragraphs: “We were forced to accept the surgery.”

“There were only basic disinfection measures in the operating theater. Without a qualified anesthetist, we were forced to undergo surgery in a dangerous environment. Luckily, all of us received treatment.”
“The informed consent forms stated that the surgeries we received would be very dangerous, and the main version was the Chinese version. The two doctors from China performed the surgeries on us.”

Naldo did not find any corpses. In fact, he did not even leave the ward area. The ladies from Cuba Town did not want to push him far away. After he underwent the hemorrhoid surgery, Naldo’s posture of lying down was even adjusted properly.
In this kind of environment, Naldo did not have any other choice except making himself sound worse off than he really was.

The reporters started to feel excited. Some people saw Ma Yanlin, who was dressed in a white coat, and they immediately brought their cameramen over before they shouted, “Doctor, could you please comment anything regarding the surgical environment during the disaster that they mentioned just now?”
An official interpreter translated the Portuguese into English.

Ma Yanlin had a hard time understanding what the interpreter said, and he said, “The severely wounded patients have been sent to the helicopter. We saved some lives, and we’ve also appeased some patients. That’s the general gist of what happened.”
The South Americans were already used to hyperboles, and hence, Ma Yanlin’s explanation was very plain.
A reporter was still not satisfied, and he continued asking, “How many severely wounded patients were there, and how were their conditions?”

“Traumatic injuries were the more severe parts of injuries the patients suffered. Besides, there’s a patient who might be suffering from PTSD, so his mental state is not stable. We’ve put in a lot of time and effort to treat him...” Ma Yanlin slowly answered.
He was still acting in the style of China, and the main direction of his conversation was about the difficult surgeries that he worked for recently.
But the reporters did not like to hear about this, so they kept asking, “How about these men? How would you comment on Mister Naldo’s condition?”
“It’s just a small problem.” Ma Yanlin recalled for a while before he remembered Naldo.
“Just a small problem? We heard he had three toes severed.” The reporter still kept asking relentlessly.
At this time, Selena tugged Ma Yanlin and said, “Doctor Ma, you may leave for work. I will answer the questions from the reporters.”

As she spoke, Selena moved to the front desk and said, “For surgeons, treating severed toes is considered a small problem, and they also find that Mister Naldo’s severed toes are just a small problem as well.”
“Mister Naldo doesn’t just have an injury to his toes, right?” The reporters looked at Naldo, who was supported by a crutch.
“Yes.”
“What exactly is it?”
Selena shook her head and said, “I can only say that it’s a common disease among men.”
Selena turned around and left once she finished speaking.
Naldo had just sighed in relief before he immediately found the situation off, so he immediately said, “It’s not what all of you are thinking!”
The reporters’ imagination had gone wild.
“Disasters are really serious.”
“Some patients have gotten some strange diseases?”
“Chinese doctors have saved many patients!”

A few reporters gathered together and started brainstorming. They came from different media stations, but all of them were the obedient sort. At least, they were much better than a reporter like Naldo.
A few of them, who could come to the spot through the helicopter as soon as they could, even obtained permission from their superiors and informants.
At this moment, they were staring at the situation, recording, and making stories.
“Best rescue in history!” This was the compliment for the overall situation!
“Best doctor in history!” This was the response to the investor.
“Zero casualties from the disaster. Story of the flood in Cuba Town!” This was the reply to the local government, and also the second response to the investor.
Naldo supported himself with a crutch and acted as an insurance agent. He walked around the reporters and government officers, listened to their discussions, and showed a scornful look on his face.

“Zero casualties? Did you really know what happened in the hospital?” Naldo remembered what he saw in the hospital a few days ago... Although he did not see any corpses, how could there be no people who died?
After hanging around for a little while, Naldo could no longer hold it. He quietly took out his camera, looked for the signboards, and walked toward the mortuary in the hospital.
A faint aroma drifted over from the lobby in the hospital.

It was still drizzling outside, so the Brazilians who loved barbeque moved their barbeque equipment into the room. Nobody cared whether the barbeque would spoil the white paint over the walls or leave a smell.
All of them cared more about fresh seafood and river food.

Brazil occupied the best part of the Amazon River, so the richness of the aquatic products was beyond all doubt. Deluge brought over not only sludge and danger but also fish that did not fit into the realms of logic. Among them were arowanas, which Ling Ran was slowly getting familiar with, normal piranhas, catfish, and also squid...
They were all caught by the fishing squad, and most of their catch contained fish named “I’m not sure what they’re called, but they’re not poisonous, and they taste pretty good.”
Just like their name, these fish, whose name had been shortened to “Not Bad” had a pretty good taste when they were just roasted with a little salt added.
The new reporters and officers became less tense, and the atmosphere of the party gradually started getting livelier.
Although it was a slightly serious barbeque party, it still made people feel relaxed a little.
It was only at this moment that Ling Ran appeared.
He did not like noisy environments, but an organized barbeque activity was still something Ling Ran could tolerate.
Ling Ran tasted a few pieces of Not Bad before he went to the barbeque pit with beef and waited there quietly.
When it came to authentic Brazilian barbeque, not only must the cow chosen be fresh, the barbeque was also more delicious when the meat was fresher.
Barbequed beef tasted the best when it sparkled with oil and was eaten right after it was taken off the barbeque pit.
“Doctor Ling, this piece is for you.” The chef who was responsible for barbeque took a skewer of beef that he thought was barbequed to perfection.
Ling Ran welcomed himself to it.
The officers and reporters by the side stared at this eagerly, and they could only criticize in their hearts. ‘What’s so great about being good looking?!’
A few patients whose bodies were still wrapped in bandages started to talk.
“Saint, you also worked hard today.”
“Doctor Ling, did you just end your ward round? Eat more meat.”
“Doctor Ling, my mom has just arrived at the hospital. Thank you very much.”

Everyone held a skewer of grilled meat and came forward to speak softly. They knew that Ling Ran did not like to talk, so they chose the same time to talk to him as if they had agreed on a time in advance.
The reporters and officers secretly pondered over it, but they did not speak rashly.
At this time, somebody suddenly said, “I still want to interview the patient with the severed toes, why haven’t I seen him?”

“Don’t bother about him if you can’t meet him. Anyhow, you can still meet him afterward,” someone answered. Then, their attention was immediately directed to Ling Ran. “Doctor Ling, you seem to have built a high level of trust with the patients, right?”
Ling Ran took a bite of the juicy grilled meat. To show that he was busy, he waved his hand, but the reporters and officers around could not help but guess what he meant blindly again.
“This is a sign of humility for the Chinese.” Some Brazilians in the room were already familiar with Chinese culture.
The reporter quickly said, “Then, can I have an interview with you? It’s about China and about yourself.”
“I don’t do interviews.” Ling Ran swallowed the grilled meat and answered happily.
“Doctor Ling is a good doctor who does not pursue popularity,” a Brazilian who cradled his arm answered sincerely.

chapters.title: Chapter 776: Eyeing With Greed
paragraphs: “Doctor Ma!”
“Doctor Ma Yanlin.”
“Doctor, say something.”

As the weather became sunny, more reporters rushed into Cuba Town. There were the mainstream media with political backgrounds, mainstream and non-mainstream media with investor backgrounds, and also different local and foreign media. These people did not only bring business to the local catering and accommodation industries, but also surrounded various people, took photos, and interviewed different people. Among these people, the most popular person was Ma Yanlin.
“Why did all of them find me?” Ma Yanlin had another interview. He happily stepped out of the door, and he could not help but show off to Yu Yuan.
Yu Yuan had just changed the dressing for a patient. She wiped her hands with alcohol-based hand sanitizer while she said, “Because Doctor Ling is not willing to get interviewed.”
“Hey, hey, this answer is too direct.” Ma Yanlin was not happy and said, “We’re foreigners in this foreign country, so can’t we just boast about each other a little? Can’t you just talk properly?”
Yu Yuan chuckled. “Now, you’re different after being the chief surgeon in surgery.”
Ma Yanlin quickly pulled a long face, “Doctor Yu, I’ve just performed a few surgeries...”
“How many?”
Ma Yanlin lowered his head. “Not many.”
Yu Yuan stared straight into Ma Yanlin’s eyes.
Ma Yanlin immediately raised his head and avoided Chief Resident Yu Yuan’s gaze.
Yu Yuan then chuckled. “Not bad. You can now proudly raise your head. As expected of a man who can complete hemorrhoid surgeries alone!”

Houseman Ma Yanlin almost wanted to cry, but he changed his mind. “I’ll get you some hemorrhoid surgeries. We are now quite famous in Cuba Town, so we can make an advertisement during the last three days to do some debridement or hemorrhoids...”
“We don’t have professional qualification in Brazil, and the flood is already gone.”
“Then, when we go back, I’ll throw aside my dignity and get a few from the General Surgery Department.”
“Hemorrhoid surgeries are slightly on the low-end on the list of hard surgeries...” Yu Yuan nodded, turned around, and left.

“Even under extremely difficult conditions, Doctor Ling insisted on staying in the hospital, and he provided treatment for the patients in Brazil. This shows the spirit of internationalism, and it also lets us see the highly-skilled doctors from China and their excellent quality...”
The governor of Mato Grosso stood on the stage and read the script. He spoke in measured tones, and his voice was clear.
The reporters stood in front of him like they were watching the monkey king giving birth. They filmed him while they exchanged gazes with each other.

Tian Guozheng sat in the first row with his injured leg while he laughed like the gorilla at the next mountain. He looked at the governor calmly. He occasionally nodded lightly and even used his hands to set a beat.

He had glanced through the governor’s speech. Even though not many amendments needed to be done, Tian Guozheng still expressed his opinions. This point alone proved that his status in the local area was constantly increasing.
Tian Guozheng was very satisfied with this, and his expression when he looked at Ling Ran was also full of smiles.
Ling Ran sat by the side without any facial expression.

He did not like such meetings. He was dragged over by Tian Guozheng, and there was no longer any surgery that he could perform in the hospital. Even if he was not here, he could only play Kings of Glory via the internet. Naturally, the game was even more fun. Besides, Tian Guozheng had given him a Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chest. Ling Ran did not think he was someone talented enough that he could give Ling Ran two Treasure Chests.
“Doctor Ling, do you really not want to say something on the stage? This is a rare opportunity,” Tian Guozheng whispered into Ling Ran’s ear.
Ling Ran shook his head.
“Alright, I can spread the news here back to China. You’re a doctor, so you don’t have to show up,” Tian Guozheng said some simple words, and loud clapping sounds were heard around him.

Tian Guozheng crossed his legs and stood up with the support of his crutch. He received a smile and a greeting from the governor. The greeting was something the governor would usually not give to others.
Ling Ran frowned. “Your knee should be able to withstand some force now.”
“It’s rare that I get to receive surgery, so I want to enjoy the benefits it brings.” Tian Guozheng chuckled. He walked with a limp to go on stage and start his speech.
During luncheon. the people from the state, the area, and the capital gathered together.
Tian Guozheng sat in a wheelchair happily like an eighty-year-old child. He held a cocktail in one hand, with another two glasses beside his wheelchair.

“Wheelchairs are so convenient,” Tian Guozheng said his opening words for the eighth time. Then, he chuckled and said, “It’s just slightly inconvenient when I need to get up the saddle from a wheelchair. Luckily I don’t have to stay on the farm these days.”
“Your ranch is still alright, right?” A man with nothing special about his face sent his regards.

“We still have the insurance company as a backup.” Tian Guozheng smiled faintly and said, “We didn’t suffer any losses in our cow herd, and Zebo Four, as well as the others, are also very healthy. I’m glad to see that the herd is healthy.”
“The price of beef has increased recently. Zheng’s Farm might be able to get a higher income.”

“Running a ranch is based on belief, passion, and idealization. If you want to earn money, investing in a newly emerging industry will earn more. ” Tian Guozheng never admitted that his ranch brought him profit. At that moment, he smiled and said, “If we talk about earning money, banking and insurance are the real profitable industries.”
“Banks are vampires!”
“Insurance companies are also vampires!”
“We have compensated you this time, right?”
“But my insurance fee has also increased.”

The local owners of the ranches and farms were very worked up. Compared to the city operators, the rural operators dealt more often with banks, and they were suppressed more by the banks, so when they started to scold the banks, they had no fear.

Tian Guozheng smiled as he listened. He was a shareholder in these banks and insurance companies, but during public occasions, Tian Guozheng always acted as an owner of a ranch, which was a politically correct move in Brazil.
“Oh yes, Ling Ran, I have prepared some gifts. When you leave, make sure to keep them properly.” Tian Guozheng turned around and whispered to Ling Ran.
“What gifts?” Ling Ran naturally looked over.

“Some cows and Chef Zhu. You are quite familiar with him, right? Let him accompany you. When you want to, you can let him make some Brazilian barbeque for you.” Tian Guozheng then pointed at his phone and said, “I’ll ask someone to email you about the exact details. At that time, the cows will be delivered to Yun Hua. I have asked the company in China to handle all quarantine and inspection procedures, so the cows will be sent directly to the ranch in Yun Hua to be stored there for the time being.”
“Ranch in Yun Hua?”

“Tian Qi should have a small ranch in Yun Hua, and it’s not very far from town,” Tian Guozheng answered, “That ranch is mainly for the temporary storage of herds. I’ve asked about it. There’s no issue from them.”
Ling Ran slowly nodded and said, “Just a few will be alright.”

“You don’t have to take care of them. Just take this as my freelance surgery fee.” Tian Guozheng took on all expenditures for his gift. Then, he said with a smile, “But if you can say something good about me later, I will be more grateful.”
“What good things?”
Tian Guozheng’s heart skipped a beat. He remembered the warning from his butler, so he immediately said, “You don’t have to say anything, just nod and smile.”

As he spoke, Tian Guozheng pulled Ling Ran and moved his big wheelchair dozens of feet away. He tugged at an old man who looked like a cowboy, smiled, and said, “Delano, remember the deal of the ranch that we spoke before?”
Delano cast a glance at Tian Guozheng. Then, he looked at Ling Ran, who was beside him and wore a faint smile. “Hi, Doctor Ling. Thank you for taking care of my niece.”
Ling Ran smiled faintly and nodded, just like how he faced other patients’ family members.

Tian Guozheng was very happy in his heart. He had always wanted to buy some ranches and farms. Brazil was currently the world’s top beef exporter, and with the current development in China, the speed in which consumers bought beef would definitely increase to a shocking level...

However, compared to the bankers and entrepreneurs in Rio de Janeiro, the local ranch owners and farmers in Brazil were extremely conservative. Sometimes, they preferred selling beef to other white men.
Tian Guozheng had been busy for a few years before he owned the current Zheng’s Farm, and he had been eyeing the land around him with greed.
When Tian Guozheng could not hold back his smile anymore, Delano turned around and said, “I have decided to sell my pasture in Cuba to your niece, Miss Tian Qi.”
Tian Guozheng could not help but be stunned.

“My niece said your niece was helping out in the hospital, and she also organized people to open up the road between the town and hospital. I’ve asked my workers, and they are more willing to work for Miss Tian Qi.” Delano nodded and lifted his glass to take a sip. Then, he nodded to Ling Ran before he turned around and left.

sentences.text: “Doctor Ma!”
“Doctor Ma Yanlin.”
“Doctor, say something.”
As the weather became sunny, more reporters rushed into Cuba Town.
There were the mainstream media with political backgrounds, mainstream and non-mainstream media with investor backgrounds, and also different local and foreign media.
These people did not only bring business to the local catering and accommodation industries, but also surrounded various people, took photos, and interviewed different people.
Among these people, the most popular person was Ma Yanlin.
“Why did all of them find me?” Ma Yanlin had another interview.
He happily stepped out of the door, and he could not help but show off to Yu Yuan.
Yu Yuan had just changed the dressing for a patient.
She wiped her hands with alcohol-based hand sanitizer while she said, “Because Doctor Ling is not willing to get interviewed.”
“Hey, hey, this answer is too direct.” Ma Yanlin was not happy and said, “We’re foreigners in this foreign country, so can’t we just boast about each other a little?
Can’t you just talk properly?”
Yu Yuan chuckled.
“Now, you’re different after being the chief surgeon in surgery.”
Ma Yanlin quickly pulled a long face, “Doctor Yu, I’ve just performed a few surgeries...”
“How many?”
Ma Yanlin lowered his head.
“Not many.”
Yu Yuan stared straight into Ma Yanlin’s eyes.
Ma Yanlin immediately raised his head and avoided Chief Resident Yu Yuan’s gaze.
Yu Yuan then chuckled.
“Not bad.
You can now proudly raise your head.
As expected of a man who can complete hemorrhoid surgeries alone!”
Houseman Ma Yanlin almost wanted to cry, but he changed his mind.
“I’ll get you some hemorrhoid surgeries.
We are now quite famous in Cuba Town, so we can make an advertisement during the last three days to do some debridement or hemorrhoids...”
“We don’t have professional qualification in Brazil, and the flood is already gone.”
“Then, when we go back, I’ll throw aside my dignity and get a few from the General Surgery Department.”
“Hemorrhoid surgeries are slightly on the low-end on the list of hard surgeries...” Yu Yuan nodded, turned around, and left.
“Even under extremely difficult conditions, Doctor Ling insisted on staying in the hospital, and he provided treatment for the patients in Brazil.
This shows the spirit of internationalism, and it also lets us see the highly-skilled doctors from China and their excellent quality...”
The governor of Mato Grosso stood on the stage and read the script.
He spoke in measured tones, and his voice was clear.
The reporters stood in front of him like they were watching the monkey king giving birth.
They filmed him while they exchanged gazes with each other.
Tian Guozheng sat in the first row with his injured leg while he laughed like the gorilla at the next mountain.
He looked at the governor calmly.
He occasionally nodded lightly and even used his hands to set a beat.
He had glanced through the governor’s speech.
Even though not many amendments needed to be done, Tian Guozheng still expressed his opinions.
This point alone proved that his status in the local area was constantly increasing.
Tian Guozheng was very satisfied with this, and his expression when he looked at Ling Ran was also full of smiles.
Ling Ran sat by the side without any facial expression.
He did not like such meetings.
He was dragged over by Tian Guozheng, and there was no longer any surgery that he could perform in the hospital.
Even if he was not here, he could only play Kings of Glory via the internet.
Naturally, the game was even more fun.
Besides, Tian Guozheng had given him a Sincere Gratitude Basic Treasure Chest.
Ling Ran did not think he was someone talented enough that he could give Ling Ran two Treasure Chests.
“Doctor Ling, do you really not want to say something on the stage?
This is a rare opportunity,” Tian Guozheng whispered into Ling Ran’s ear.
Ling Ran shook his head.
“Alright, I can spread the news here back to China.
You’re a doctor, so you don’t have to show up,” Tian Guozheng said some simple words, and loud clapping sounds were heard around him.
Tian Guozheng crossed his legs and stood up with the support of his crutch.
He received a smile and a greeting from the governor.
The greeting was something the governor would usually not give to others.
Ling Ran frowned.
“Your knee should be able to withstand some force now.”
“It’s rare that I get to receive surgery, so I want to enjoy the benefits it brings.” Tian Guozheng chuckled.
He walked with a limp to go on stage and start his speech.
During luncheon. the people from the state, the area, and the capital gathered together.
Tian Guozheng sat in a wheelchair happily like an eighty-year-old child.
He held a cocktail in one hand, with another two glasses beside his wheelchair.
“Wheelchairs are so convenient,” Tian Guozheng said his opening words for the eighth time.
Then, he chuckled and said, “It’s just slightly inconvenient when I need to get up the saddle from a wheelchair.
Luckily I don’t have to stay on the farm these days.”
“Your ranch is still alright, right?” A man with nothing special about his face sent his regards.
“We still have the insurance company as a backup.” Tian Guozheng smiled faintly and said, “We didn’t suffer any losses in our cow herd, and Zebo Four, as well as the others, are also very healthy.
I’m glad to see that the herd is healthy.”
“The price of beef has increased recently.
Zheng’s Farm might be able to get a higher income.”
“Running a ranch is based on belief, passion, and idealization.
If you want to earn money, investing in a newly emerging industry will earn more. ” Tian Guozheng never admitted that his ranch brought him profit.
At that moment, he smiled and said, “If we talk about earning money, banking and insurance are the real profitable industries.”
“Banks are vampires!”
“Insurance companies are also vampires!”
“We have compensated you this time, right?”
“But my insurance fee has also increased.”
The local owners of the ranches and farms were very worked up.
Compared to the city operators, the rural operators dealt more often with banks, and they were suppressed more by the banks, so when they started to scold the banks, they had no fear.
Tian Guozheng smiled as he listened.
He was a shareholder in these banks and insurance companies, but during public occasions, Tian Guozheng always acted as an owner of a ranch, which was a politically correct move in Brazil.
“Oh yes, Ling Ran, I have prepared some gifts.
When you leave, make sure to keep them properly.” Tian Guozheng turned around and whispered to Ling Ran.
“What gifts?” Ling Ran naturally looked over.
“Some cows and Chef Zhu.
You are quite familiar with him, right?
Let him accompany you.
When you want to, you can let him make some Brazilian barbeque for you.” Tian Guozheng then pointed at his phone and said, “I’ll ask someone to email you about the exact details.
At that time, the cows will be delivered to Yun Hua.
I have asked the company in China to handle all quarantine and inspection procedures, so the cows will be sent directly to the ranch in Yun Hua to be stored there for the time being.”
“Ranch in Yun Hua?”
“Tian Qi should have a small ranch in Yun Hua, and it’s not very far from town,” Tian Guozheng answered, “That ranch is mainly for the temporary storage of herds.
I’ve asked about it.
There’s no issue from them.”
Ling Ran slowly nodded and said, “Just a few will be alright.”
“You don’t have to take care of them.
Just take this as my freelance surgery fee.” Tian Guozheng took on all expenditures for his gift.
Then, he said with a smile, “But if you can say something good about me later, I will be more grateful.”
“What good things?”
Tian Guozheng’s heart skipped a beat.
He remembered the warning from his butler, so he immediately said, “You don’t have to say anything, just nod and smile.”
As he spoke, Tian Guozheng pulled Ling Ran and moved his big wheelchair dozens of feet away.
He tugged at an old man who looked like a cowboy, smiled, and said, “Delano, remember the deal of the ranch that we spoke before?”
Delano cast a glance at Tian Guozheng.
Then, he looked at Ling Ran, who was beside him and wore a faint smile.
“Hi, Doctor Ling.
Thank you for taking care of my niece.”
Ling Ran smiled faintly and nodded, just like how he faced other patients’ family members.
Tian Guozheng was very happy in his heart.
He had always wanted to buy some ranches and farms.
Brazil was currently the world’s top beef exporter, and with the current development in China, the speed in which consumers bought beef would definitely increase to a shocking level...
However, compared to the bankers and entrepreneurs in Rio de Janeiro, the local ranch owners and farmers in Brazil were extremely conservative.
Sometimes, they preferred selling beef to other white men.
Tian Guozheng had been busy for a few years before he owned the current Zheng’s Farm, and he had been eyeing the land around him with greed.
When Tian Guozheng could not hold back his smile anymore, Delano turned around and said, “I have decided to sell my pasture in Cuba to your niece, Miss Tian Qi.”
Tian Guozheng could not help but be stunned.
“My niece said your niece was helping out in the hospital, and she also organized people to open up the road between the town and hospital.
I’ve asked my workers, and they are more willing to work for Miss Tian Qi.” Delano nodded and lifted his glass to take a sip.
Then, he nodded to Ling Ran before he turned around and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 777: Pick-up
paragraphs: At Yun Hua Airport, a row of young ladies in blouses and shorts waited as they chatted and laughed. That made travelers lift their cameras to take photos of them.
Doctor Zhou lay on the bench at the terminal in a sickly fashion, and he was so lazy that it was as if he had been beaten up to the point that his head was dizzy.

Normally, in the hospital, when Doctor Zhou put on his white coat, he could still receive some attention, so Doctor Zhou also paid attention to his personal image. However, when he changed to his casual clothes outside, no one would look at him, so Doctor Zhou could not be bothered to take care of his image anymore.
In fact, many doctors liked to stay in the hospital because of their white coat and because people would notice them.

If someone became a doctor and put on a white coat, then his sense of accomplishment in the hospital would be thousands of times higher than when he was in the outside world. This was especially so when a surgeon stood in the operating theater. He was a god by then, and when he stepped out of the operating theater, he also existed like an archangel who attracted countless gazes and solved numerous problems.

Many people said that the happiest time in a person’s life was when he or she became a parent, and it was especially so when the child knew how to call their parent father or mother. However, doctors did not normally go home, because when someone became a doctor, put on their white coat, and stood in the hospital, he was a father for many people.
However, when a doctor took off the white coat and stepped out of the hospital, the first feeling he had was relaxation, and it would be followed secretly by dejectedness.

This was like the doctor whose name was not remembered by people due to his normal looks and was currently sitting beside Doctor Zhou. When he did not wear his white coat, he was not a very eye-catching person. Even if he wanted to be a background board, he was not qualified.
“Doctor Ling is coming soon, right?” he grumbled in boredom before he asked, “Why are we needed to be here to welcome him? This should be done by the administration.”
“Will Department Director Huo be confident in passing him to the Medical Affairs Department?” Doctor Zhou asked lackadaisically, then he said, “And do you have anything to do?”

Yun Hua Hospital had upgraded its Emergency Department to an Emergency Medical Center, and its direct benefit was the increase in its authorized personnel and funding. They also had more allocated housemen and interns compared to the past. Although the number of patients increased, the doctors’ average pressure had been reduced as well.

However, it was impossible to say they were not busy. The doctor whose name was not remembered by people due to his normal looks was now a senior resident doctor. He snorted boldly and say, “Even if I’m not busy, I can also do something else and treat a few patients.”

“You should really treat a few more patients. When Ling Ran is back, he will sweep away all your patients in a few days. In the future, patients might become rare animals. ” As Doctor Zhou spoke, he laughed and before he said languidly, “I really miss the days when Ling Ran was in the hospital...”
The doctor whose name was not remembered by people due to his normal looks rolled his eyes, but he could not deny what Doctor Zhou had said was right.
In the next second, he said in a low voice, “I noticed that Doctor Ling’s sleeping time is getting shorter. Do you think there is anything wrong with him?”
Doctor Zhou pursed his lips. “Aren’t you a doctor? You can look out for him.”

“I’m not qualified.” The doctor whose name was not remembered by people due to his normal looks smiled an empty smile. “Nowadays, when I go for ward rounds, if the rooms are slightly crowded, I’ll even be scolded by the nurse, and they tell me that interns should stand at the back. They think I am a newcomer.”
Doctor Zhou was confused and said, “When there is a crowd, why would you stand in front of the hospital bed?”
“I was... j-just there for fun, okay!” The doctor whose name was not remembered by people due to his normal looks showed a face that he was unhappy, but nobody cared.

Zhao Leyi slowly walked over and interrupted both of them by saying, “I’ve asked the airport officers. They said if we want to pick up people, we can go to the front or go straight to the front of the runway.”
Doctor Zhou was impressed. He stood up and said, “Old Zhao, well done. You know so many people. It’s awesome.”

“They took a private jet over, so the place for pick-up is different than ours.” Zhao Leyi said in displeasure, “What is Old Huo thinking? Ling Ran is back, but why kick up a fuss and make us pick him up?”
It was the same question. The doctor whose name was not remembered by people due to his normal looks immediately turned around and looked at Doctor Zhou to see how he was going to answer.
Doctor Zhou ignored that gaze. He smiled and could not be bothered to reply.
He guessed Zhao Leyi understood Huo Congjun’s meaning.

Forget about why Ling Ran was out this time, what he encountered and his work in Brazil received many high praises and compliments after news of it was passed back to the country. So, Huo Congjun had to push Ling Ran up to a pedestal.
In the hospital, the status of a doctor was not only shown in their freedom and their positions but also the obedience of the junior doctors to the senior doctors.
Zhao Leyi used to be a senior doctor for Ling Ran for a short while. But now, it was the opposite. Having Zhao Leyi pick up Ling Ran could already be a rather new beginning.
Zhao Leyi himself would not ponder about this deeply and called out to his friends in the airport to join the pick up with him under his lead.
The nurses in casual wear gossiped and laughed. They discussed happily with an attitude of successfully winning a PVP match.
“If this is a private jet, then we won’t have a weight limit for our luggage when we buy things overseas, right?”
“Wow, I’m not sure what Doctor Ling will buy. What brands do you think Doctor Ling likes?”
“Doctor Ling is so handsome in scrubs. He wouldn’t need any branded clothes.”
“He still needs to wear some clothes, right? In the hospital, he needs to wear scrubs, but he can’t possibly be naked when he comes out, right?”
“Huh? Hmm...”
The small team was silent for half a minute.
A while later, the group of people reached the other side of the airport with the two small-sized shutter buses. Then, a transport aircraft landed, followed by a slim private jet.
“Two planes?” Everyone was confused.
The airport personnel who came to help frowned and looked for someone to ask questions.
But before he obtained his answer, the transport aircraft, which was the first to land, opened its door, and the transported items could be seen.
“Cows?”
“Are these the souvenirs Doctor Ling brought back from Brazil?”
“Maybe Doctor Ling thinks the beef he ate in Brazil was very delicious, so he bought... a lot of cows back.”
While the nurses talked, they took out their phones and started to take photos.
Zhao Leyi burst into laughter. “Ling Ran is so...”
“They’re coming down.” Doctor Zhou pointed to the front.
The private jet put down the stairs, and the first one who walked out was Ling Ran.
The young ladies in casual wear all put away their phones and started to perform the dance they had practiced for a long time.
Ling Ran was stunned when he walked down the private jet. He automatically waved at them and won the laughter from the young ladies.

The one who followed behind Ling Ran was Chef Zhu, and he could be considered a man who had seen grand occasions before, but never something like this. He felt dazed when he stood at the hanging stairs at that moment.
When Ling Ran saw that no one followed after him, he turned around and took a look. Then, he asked, “Is anyone not feeling well?”
Chef Zhu thought of making up a story, but, when he noticed Ling Ran’s expression, Chef Zhu thought of something and shook his head, “Nothing. I’m very comfortable.”
