chapters.title: Chapter 778: Ling Ran’s Celebration Party
paragraphs: At Yun Hua Hospital, the patients who came to seek doctors were so densely packed together at the bottom of a huge building that they were like a swarm of ants.
The Inpatient Department was quieter, but those inside it will still find it noisy.
The big white goose, Fragrance Yard, walked fretfully. When it saw the children coming over, it immediately ran to the pond so that it would not end up pecking them and being punished for it later.
The children surrounding it became more arrogant. They laughed loudly while using a pack of snacks that cost 10 RMB to attract Fragrance Yard.

Fragrance Yard was very lazy. It only ate a bit of the snack when the snacks were thrown in front of it. Its fame at Yun Hua Hospital had surpassed most of the associate department directors. Therefore, it would receive endless food thrown at it every day, and the children it met were more than the pharmaceutical sales representatives the associate department directors met. If it ate every food thrown at it by the children, how was it supposed to ask for extras at dinner?
Fragrance Yard raised its head and did not even bother to chase away the sparrow and pigeon that came and fight for food.

In the past, it would definitely guard its territory. It would even attack the creatures that ate its poop, much less the birds who came to eat its food. However, after gaining 3 pounds, Fragrance Yard abstained from all worldly desires.

It just flapped its wings and tried to symbolically scare away other birds. Some newcomers would fly away anxiously, but those old birds would not bother to even pretend flying unless Fragrance Yard came in front of them.
“Mom, I want to touch the big goose.” A child with a bandage on his head wanted to go near the fountain.
The parents immediately held him and said, “The big goose cannot be touched. It’s very fierce, and it will bite anyone who touches it.”
“Really?”
“Really. Your dad got bitten by one in the past.” The mother immediately raised an example.
The child looked at his father doubtfully. Suddenly, a small voice was heard from the other side of the fountain.
The big goose sensed something was not right. It only managed to honk, and its wings were pulled by someone.

“Fragrance Yard, how is your body? It’s been a while since we saw each other.” Yu Yuan grinned while greeting the goose, and she took a thermometer before she inserted it into Fragrance Yard’s rectum.
Fragrance Yard turned around, looked at Yu Yuan, honked, and lowered its head dejectedly.
It seemed to be fatter than before, and it could hardly run, so it surrendered to its fate even faster than before.

“The caretaker of the goose is here again.” The small child pointed at the small human who grabbed the goose and shouted. Then, he looked at his dad and mom and asked, “Dad, mom, look, the big goose is not fierce at all—”
The big goose raised its head and looked over. Then, it lowered its head again.
Yu Yuan held the big goose and walked proudly around the fountain, as though she was inspecting the territory.

“Whew... Yun Hua Hospital is still the best.” When Yu Yuan felt that the time was about right, she pulled out the thermometer and gave it a rough glance. Then, she washed it in tap water before she let go of the big goose.
“Doctor Yu, you’re back.” The cleaner who worked near the fountain and cleaned up the goose’s poop walked forward naturally.
Yu Yuan nodded and said, “I’m here to measure its body temperature.”
“I heard that you guys went to Brazil and even encountered a flood?”
“Yes. We were trapped at a Brazilian hospital for a few days.” Yu Yuan patted her stomach. “And became fatter.”
“You won’t suffer much when you go with Doctor Ling. I heard that you can earn a lot when you and operate on some patients with Doctor Ling. Is that true?” The cleaner took the chance to ask.
Yu Yuan smiled without answering. Performing freelance surgeries was something normal for high level doctors in the country, but it was not a suitable topic for gossip.

The cleaner got ready to leave since there was nothing worth gossipping. Before he left, he saw the thermometer in Yu Yuan’s hands and asked in puzzlement, “Now, isn’t there a thermometer that releases a beep after it measures a person’s temperature? You’re still using this kind of old fashioned thermometer?”
Yu Yuan flung the thermometer in her hand and smiled. “The old fashioned ones are more accurate.”
“Is it important to be accurate when it comes to measuring the goose’s temperature?”
*Honk*
The big goose, Fragrance Yard honked in the fountain and turned around to look.
In the operating theater, Huo Congjun stepped open the door and saw Ling Ran in dark green scrubs. He was busy cutting up the hepatic artery under the rib.
Huo Congjun could not help but sigh. “I mentioned that we’d be organizing a celebration party for you, and you came to the operating theater.”

Ling Ran glanced at Department Director Huo, who he had not seen for a long time, lowered his head, and said, “It’s been a long time since I last performed a major surgery. So, this is the celebration party.”

There was no certified anesthetist in Guozheng Charity Hospital, and they could only opt for preliminary treatment for even the patients with very severe wounds, and their main treatment method was conservative treatment. They could not even perform surgeries like hepatectomy.

Surgery was a skill that could represent a surgeon’s comprehensive abilities. A minor surgery could still be easily handled by one or two surgeons. But when it came to the major surgery, the requirements were stricter. When it came to surgeries at the level of hepatectomy, if the hardware in the hospital was not up to standard, management level was not up to standard, the anesthetist was not up to standard, and even the level of nurses was not up to standard, but the doctor still persisted in carrying out the surgery, then the patient will absolutely die.
When Ling Ran returned to the country, the first thing he did was to read up on the information of a patient, attend the preoperative preparation for the patient, and perform surgery for a big liver.

Huo Congjun only smiled and said, “Anyway, only old people like us like celebration parties, young people like all of you may not like it anymore. Ahem... Hmm, I will leave first, let’s have a meal later, and you can share with everyone your stories in Brazil.”
After Huo Congjun finished speaking, he pushed against his mask and left happily.
Lu Wenbin, who was the first assistant, trembled, sighed and said, “Department Director Huo was so fierce just a few days ago. Doctor Ling, since you are back, there are more smiles on his face.”

“We accumulated quite a lot of patients as well recently. Department Director Huo might be quite stressed too,” Zuo Cidian whispered and provided an explanation. He managed to grab the opportunity as the second assistant today, and for that, he had even secretly called Xiang Xueming and let Bazhaixiang hospital branch provide a few high paying freelance surgeries for Zhang Anmin.
Without Zhang Anmin as the first assistant, Zuo Cidian and Lu Wenbin could become the second and first assistant respectively. Then, they would have time to butter up Ling Ran immediately.

Zuo Cidian regarded this highly. He even said logically, “The current configuration in the Medical Emergency Center is based on the condition where Doctor Ling is around. Forget everything else, there are plenty of patients who come for hepatectomy every week, along with patients who are referred to us for Achilles tendon repair, M-Tang technique, or for meniscus repairs. In fact, this shows that Doctor Ling has long since become the main pillar of our Emergency Medical Center and Yun Hua Hospital.”
“Are there many patients admitted now?” Ling Ran was slightly tempted.

“Many patients with hepatolithiasis have been admitted. There are also many patients who need Achilles tendon repair as well. The patients who need M-Tang technique were taken by Young Lu,” Zuo Cidian said in envy.

“In terms of age, I should be the eldest disciple, right?” Zuo Cidian snorted. On his forty-three-year-old face, other than the mask, only wrinkles could be seen on him.
Ling Ran listened to their argument, yet his brain did not process any of it.
He quietly lifted up the patient’s liver, stood with his back straight, broke it off gently, and put it back just as gently in its original place.
The cold light in the operating theater was silent and bright, just like the current Ling Ran.

sentences.text: At Yun Hua Hospital, the patients who came to seek doctors were so densely packed together at the bottom of a huge building that they were like a swarm of ants.
The Inpatient Department was quieter, but those inside it will still find it noisy.
The big white goose, Fragrance Yard, walked fretfully.
When it saw the children coming over, it immediately ran to the pond so that it would not end up pecking them and being punished for it later.
The children surrounding it became more arrogant.
They laughed loudly while using a pack of snacks that cost 10 RMB to attract Fragrance Yard.
Fragrance Yard was very lazy.
It only ate a bit of the snack when the snacks were thrown in front of it.
Its fame at Yun Hua Hospital had surpassed most of the associate department directors.
Therefore, it would receive endless food thrown at it every day, and the children it met were more than the pharmaceutical sales representatives the associate department directors met.
If it ate every food thrown at it by the children, how was it supposed to ask for extras at dinner?
Fragrance Yard raised its head and did not even bother to chase away the sparrow and pigeon that came and fight for food.
In the past, it would definitely guard its territory.
It would even attack the creatures that ate its poop, much less the birds who came to eat its food.
However, after gaining 3 pounds, Fragrance Yard abstained from all worldly desires.
It just flapped its wings and tried to symbolically scare away other birds.
Some newcomers would fly away anxiously, but those old birds would not bother to even pretend flying unless Fragrance Yard came in front of them.
“Mom, I want to touch the big goose.” A child with a bandage on his head wanted to go near the fountain.
The parents immediately held him and said, “The big goose cannot be touched.
It’s very fierce, and it will bite anyone who touches it.”
“Really?”
“Really.
Your dad got bitten by one in the past.” The mother immediately raised an example.
The child looked at his father doubtfully.
Suddenly, a small voice was heard from the other side of the fountain.
The big goose sensed something was not right.
It only managed to honk, and its wings were pulled by someone.
“Fragrance Yard, how is your body?
It’s been a while since we saw each other.” Yu Yuan grinned while greeting the goose, and she took a thermometer before she inserted it into Fragrance Yard’s rectum.
Fragrance Yard turned around, looked at Yu Yuan, honked, and lowered its head dejectedly.
It seemed to be fatter than before, and it could hardly run, so it surrendered to its fate even faster than before.
“The caretaker of the goose is here again.” The small child pointed at the small human who grabbed the goose and shouted.
Then, he looked at his dad and mom and asked, “Dad, mom, look, the big goose is not fierce at all—”
The big goose raised its head and looked over.
Then, it lowered its head again.
Yu Yuan held the big goose and walked proudly around the fountain, as though she was inspecting the territory.
“Whew...
Yun Hua Hospital is still the best.” When Yu Yuan felt that the time was about right, she pulled out the thermometer and gave it a rough glance.
Then, she washed it in tap water before she let go of the big goose.
“Doctor Yu, you’re back.” The cleaner who worked near the fountain and cleaned up the goose’s poop walked forward naturally.
Yu Yuan nodded and said, “I’m here to measure its body temperature.”
“I heard that you guys went to Brazil and even encountered a flood?”
“Yes.
We were trapped at a Brazilian hospital for a few days.” Yu Yuan patted her stomach.
“And became fatter.”
“You won’t suffer much when you go with Doctor Ling.
I heard that you can earn a lot when you and operate on some patients with Doctor Ling.
Is that true?” The cleaner took the chance to ask.
Yu Yuan smiled without answering.
Performing freelance surgeries was something normal for high level doctors in the country, but it was not a suitable topic for gossip.
The cleaner got ready to leave since there was nothing worth gossipping.
Before he left, he saw the thermometer in Yu Yuan’s hands and asked in puzzlement, “Now, isn’t there a thermometer that releases a beep after it measures a person’s temperature?
You’re still using this kind of old fashioned thermometer?”
Yu Yuan flung the thermometer in her hand and smiled.
“The old fashioned ones are more accurate.”
“Is it important to be accurate when it comes to measuring the goose’s temperature?”
*Honk*
The big goose, Fragrance Yard honked in the fountain and turned around to look.

When Ling Ran returned to the country, the first thing he did was to read up on the information of a patient, attend the preoperative preparation for the patient, and perform surgery for a big liver.

Hmm, I will leave first, let’s have a meal later, and you can share with everyone your stories in Brazil.”

chapters.title: Chapter 779: Thoughts
paragraphs: “Everyone, please wait patiently. Doctor Ling is now in the operating theater.” Nurse Niu blocked the reporters and showed a proud smile on her face.
The nurse’s desk at the Emergency Medical Center of Yun Hua Hospital had been silent for some time already.

“We heard about the flood Doctor Ling encountered in Brazil, and how he saved hundreds of patients at the disaster site, are all those stories true?” One of the reporters could not hold back anymore and approached the nurse’s desk.
“I think that’s what happened.”
“We’re not too sure ourselves.”
“Doctor Ling is saving lives everyday.”
Before Ling Ran came back, the head nurse had given everyone a crash course on what to say. The answers they gave were a bit different, but the content was about the same.
It was only natural that the reporters were not satisfied with such answers. They tried to ask around since they could not get into the operating theater.

Some reporters ran directly to Department Director Huo and said with a threatening and malicious tone, “Department Director Huo, we’re already old friends right, and this news will shed a positive light to all of you. It’s quite difficult for us when the main character is not here.”

“Didn’t I send a press release to all of you? Why must you insist on an interview?” Huo Congjun shook his head. From the hospital’s perspective, they were really terrified of the mass media and reporters. However, Huo Congjun was more worried that Ling Ran would say something wrong in front of them. They would not even give him a chance to correct himself.
“I’ll only ask three questions. It’s not a show of responsibility when we publish an article without interviewing the person concerned, right?”
“Since when is the mass media ever responsible?” Huo Congjun retorted.

The reporter barked a laugh out, barely masking his annoyance, “Since you said that, I can’t do anything. Department Director Huo, are you hiding something we don’t know? The incident in Brazil seemed to be extraordinary, but you’re hiding him so fiercely that you refuse to even let us see him...”

“Reverse psychology won’t work on me.” Huo Congjun showed an impenetrable look. “Moreover, I’m not stopping you from interviewing him, right? Ling Ran is still in the operating theater, so you have to seek the agreement of the patient’s family members if you want me to pull him out.”
“We can have the interview in the operating theater...”
“No.”
“Why?”
“If one media company goes in, what should I do if other mass media companies wish to interview him as well?”
“You’re refusing everything we offer. When the papers come out later on, don’t blame us for going by sheer conjecture.”

This time round, Huo Congjun fell into deep thought. “Alright. But when it comes to the articles about Ling Ran, they must be checked by me first, and you must gain my agreement before publishing it.”
“This requirement seems to be a bit too much.”

“I’ll bring all of you to visit the operating theater and look at a live surgery from Ling Ran after his rescue mission in Brazil. This offer is not too bad, right?” Huo Congjun smirked, and he was not worried that the reporters would not do as he said.
The reporters pretended to act for a few seconds, turned around, and agreed with that.
They had planned to butter him up right from the start. The reporters would be more than happy with a better offer, since they could get an exclusive shot and so on.
Half an hour later, four reporters showed up in the visitation room of Operating Theater 1 in the Emergency Medical Center.
“Department Director Huo, you are like a girl with many husbands.” The reporters were not pleased. When they looked at each other, they turned around and smiled.
“It’s fine, since not many people read newspapers nowadays.”
“We’re still fine, since we’re working for the TV. However, that’s how news is. Only people who have been on the news are concerned with it.”

“However, Doctor Ling has immediately started to perform surgery after coming back from Brazil. Can his body take it?” The female reporter who asked this question was not someone who was new to interviewing Ling Ran. She gazed at Ling Ran affectionately.
Huo Congjun smiled. “Doctor Ling is always like this. He treats his hobby as his job. You should know that.”

A few people on the spot laughed. The female reporter even took out the camera and took two photos through the glass and said, “The visitation room you constructed is really nice. It’s so convenient for everyone.”

“The cost is quite high as well. When you guys go back and write your article, please remember to write something good about us.” When Huo Congjun saw that the reporters were not paying attention to him, he added earnestly, “Let me say something unpleasant, if you guys fall sick, you need to use medical insurance. At that time, the medical treatment resources you guys obtain will be at the level you place Yun Hua Hospital.”
The reporters trembled instantly.
In the operating theater, Ling Ran was very focused.
This was the third hepatectomy he performed today, and that was the third surgery he had that he performed to his hearts’ content.
“Be careful of the stripping of tendons.”
“Be careful of the blood vessels.”
“Blood pressure?”

Ling Ran performed the surgery following the steps. He made an order again. When it was almost time to sever the liver, he saw that the two assistants looked exhausted, and he said, “This is the last surgery for today. Let’s rest when we finish.”
Lu Wenbin and Zuo Cidian instantly became spirited.
Zuo Cidian smiled and said, “Doctor Ling, you should go back and rest. You don’t stay for long at home.”
“Yes. After finishing this surgery, I’ll go back and rest.” Ling Ran exercised his shoulders.

“Doctor Ling, you look like you’re massaging yourself when you perform a surgery.” Lu Wenbin was impressed and could totally understand it. When he braised the pork trotters, he did not feel like he was wasting his time or felt tired. Instead, he felt excited.
“Tomorrow will be an off day. Remember to go for a ward round. Once will do. Recover and watch yourselves.” Ling Ran said this not just for Lu Wenbin and Zuo Cidian, but also for himself.

During the time he was at Guozheng Charity Hospital, Ling Ran had opened all his Basic Treasure Chests, but did not open his and left his Treat the Wounded and Sick Intermediate Treasure Chests untouched, his rewards from his first mission. He had obtained that when he left the hospital.
Obviously, the requirement by the system to save thirty injured people did not just mean that he was to keep the patient alive, but to treat them to completion.
But because of it, it meant that the Intermediate Treasure Chest given from his mission could not be immediately used.
Ling Ran had not opened it until now.
Afterall, he was most familiar with hepatectomy, and the Intermediate Treasure Chest...
Ling Ran intended to earn a few of them.
After all, he might be able to get an entire set of skills if he accumulated a few of them.
Ling Ran thought about it while performing the surgery smoothly. At this time, the reporters in the visitation room started to ask, “Doctor Ling, can you tell us about the situation in Brazil?”
The mic in the visitation room had some voices coming out from it. It sounded a bit distorted, but was clear.
Ling Ran stopped for a while and looked at the visitation room before he said, “Brazillian Zebu is tasty, and the fish is quite nice as well, but the weather is not that good.”
The reporters were stunned for a few seconds and asked again, “How about the flood?”

“During the flood, we have the cows come for evacuation from the ranch. The patients and their family members went fishing together. So, the food is not too bad,” Ling Ran replied and said, “I want to continue the surgery.”

Zuo Cidian immediately said, “Dear reporters, we can have an interview later. Our current hepatectomy is still quite complicated. Actually, everyone, you can write out a list of questions to be asked, and we can answer in detail later on.”
After that, Zuo Cidian whispered, “Doctor Ling, they want to ask about the rescue during the flood, including the surgery, emergency treatment, and rescue members.”

Ling Ran’s mind immediately came up with the mercenaries who came as reinforcements “The surgeries for the rescue team members are usually simpler. They’re mainly debridement and orthopedic surgeries...”

chapters.title: Chapter 780: Gallstone
paragraphs: Ling Ran performed the surgery at breakneck speed. A hepatolithiasis and hepatectomy on the right lobe of the liver were completed within two hours.
The reporters knew too little to appreciate such a feat. Since they had taken satisfactory pictures, they left happily.

Huo Congjun encouraged the surgery group again. “Well done, everyone. Yes. Continue to complete your surgeries with high accuracy and show the capability of the Emergency Medical Center of Yun Hua Hospital. Now, everyone, you still need to keep up the hard work. Okay... Doctor Ling, please go back and rest early. Don’t burn yourself out.”
Ling Ran nodded. “I’m ready to go back.”

“Yes, yes, have a good rest. If you do not wish to come tomorrow, just give me a call or send me a message through WeChat.” Huo Congjun smiled. “It’s a long journey back from Brazil. The journey must be tiring, so don’t be in a hurry, okay? Come back again when you have enough rest.”
Everyone’s expression in the operating theater remained unchanged.
Huo Congjun nodded in satisfaction and went out.
Lu Wenbin quietly continued working on things like abdominal closures and so on. Ling Ran followed Zuo Cidian out, and found himself surrounded by a group of family members.
Ling Ran hastily mentioned a few words and looked to Zuo Cidian for an explanation.
The patients’ family members had too many questions, and to the doctors, most of their questions were boring and were born from ignorance.

The patients’ family members were usually like that. A patient might have understanding and knowledgeable family members, but there was always one or more family members who were ignorant. As long as a patient had many family members, they could always ask for the outrageous.

Most doctors could not be bothered to answer such questions. Only doctors like Zuo Cidian who came from town hospitals could bear these stupid questions. Zuo Cidian no longer avoided topics about his history in the town hospital. In truth, it was impossible for him to avoid that. The hospital was a small, closed off, and boring society. The transmission speed of a doctor’s qualifications would spread faster than gossip about men and women. After all, the stories about men and women gossip were not suitable for every occasion. However, the gossip related to qualifications could be spoken in lots of occasions.
However, Zuo Cidian could now describe his background at the town hospital as another experience.
He had grown patient with the family members.
Because that was the only capital Zuo Cidian had.

Zuo Cidian used around 15 minutes to calm down the family members. He took the opportunity and said, “Hurry up and go to the Intensive Care Unit. The patient will be sent there soon, and all of you still need to change to scrubs as well as do other matters.”
The dozen or so patients at the spot instantly became very busy.
Zuo Cidian pulled Ling Ran away and sighed. Then, he looked at Ling Ran again, smiled, and said, “Doctor Ling, how do you feel? I mean, how do you feel about the family members.”
“It seems the same as the previous ones.” Ling Ran observed the surroundings.

“How different can the hospital environment be? There won’t be any changes even if you didn’t come back after a year, much less a month. It’s the same day after day and year after year...” Zuo Cidian could not help but think about the town hospital he used to work for and said, “I’ve worked for almost twenty years, yet the town hospital did not change much as well. It looks exactly the same as the time I joined.”
“It’s good if it never changes.” Ling Ran said, judging that statement by his own standards.
Zuo Cidian said, “No changes means that there will be no updates in terms of devices, equipment, as well as the hospital beds.”
“I see, that’s no good.” Ling Ran immediately shook his head, frowned, and thought, “In this case, the devices and equipment in our department has not been updated for a few months.”

“Yes. But we don’t have that money, right?” Zuo Cidian chuckled. The Emergency Medical Center survived through grants. If the patients and prescription costs increased, the allocated grant would increase, and bonuses like cash rewards for doctors and nurses would increase as well. However, that could not be treated solely as profit, so it could not be used whenever they needed.
Ling Ran nodded slowly.
“Where are we going now?” Zuo Cidian saw that Ling Ran did not want to immediately leave.

“A ward round, and I’m off for today.” Ling Ran was ready to check the two patients who just had the surgery. The few hours after surgery were usually the time when complications will be at their most serious. Some hospitals would forcibly increase the frequency of ward rounds. For example, in a weaker hospital, surgeries like hepatectomy would need the chief surgeon to take care of the patients until the patients regained consciousness.

Of course, strong hospitals did not have to operate like this. The chief surgeons from the strong hospitals were more skillful, and they would usually send out doctors who were attending physicians and might even be better than an assistant lecturer from a weak hospital.

Ling Ran had his own surgery tempo and ward round schedule. Due to the fact that he had just returned to the country, Ling Ran wanted to check the patients he operated on today, and he will do so multiple times.
Besides, after coming back to the hospital, he did not visit the ICU at all, and he wanted to make sure their conditions were normal.
Zuo Cidian was stunned and muttered, “I’ve almost forgotten your style.”
“Huh?” Ling Ran looked over.
“No worries. It’s good to visit ICU as well and let others know that you’re back now. It’ll keep them on their toes.” Zuo Cidian naturally supported Ling Ran when it came to inspecting his territory.

Auxiliary departments like the ICU were like hyenas in the hospital. When they met strong lions, they would be as tame as dogs. Some hungry hyenas would occasionally fight for food, but they would be killed by the strong lions and eaten. However, if these hyenas were facing an old and weak lion, the hyenas would not be as tame. They would not even care about the cubs or lionesses.

They walked around like this for more than an hour. Zuo Cidian felt nostalgia as time passed while he sent Ling Ran to the carpark. He sighed in relief when he saw Ling Ran drive his own Jetta and left immediately.

At Lower Groove Clinic, the yard was filled with a soothing fragrance. A few pots of China Roses could be seen after entering the yard. Meanwhile, roses and sunflowers could be seen on the windowsill.
“Son!” Tao Ping sat by the tea table on the first floor and waved happily at her son.
A few neighbors sat together by the tea table. They also waved at Ling Ran. Among them, two of the ladies in the neighborhood waved incredibly excitedly.
“You’re back? Want to have some porridge?” Ling Jiezhou was busy in the kitchen on the ground floor. After renovation, Ling Jiezhou spent even more time in the kitchen.
“Sure. I’ll have some porridge.” Ling Ran also waved at the people on the first floor and sat at the courtyard at the ground floor. Then, he took out his phone.
The atmosphere in the house always gave off a feeling of laziness, which was different from the hospital.
“Want some beef?” Ling Jiezhou craned his head from the kitchen.
“I’m fine with it.”

“Then, I’ll add some in it. Do you want some salted vegetables as well? Also, we have some seafood left in the afternoon, swimming crab, greasyback shrimps, and tiger prawns, which one do you prefer?” Ling Jiezhou craned his head out of the kitchen again.
“Anything is fine.”
“Then, I’ll give you some salted vegetables. Eating seafood at night is bad for digestion,” Ling Jiezhou said before he went in.

“It’s still quite early until the sleeping time.” A neighbor walked down from the first floor, sat in front of the courtyard, smiled, and asked, “Ling Ran, I heard that you performed surgeries for Brazillians? What’s that called again... Foreign aid medical doctor?”
Ling Ran shook his head and replied in a concise manner, “That’s by chance.”
“But Ling Ran, when I asked around, I heard that you are now very skillful in performing surgery.” The neighbor continued to ask to probe for information.
Ling Ran replied, “Yes.”

The neighborhood did not mind. After staying so long at Lower Groove, everyone was now used to Ling Ran’s style. He looked at Ling Ran again and asked, “So, Ling Ran, my family members want to receive surgery as well. Can you take a look at them?”
“Which field is it?”
“Gallstone, over several decades. My uncle did not care too much about it. But it’s starting to get too painful, so he wants to cut it.”
Cholecystectomy was indeed within Ling Ran’s skill set. However, as one of the skills that he trained on his own, its level was the lowest among all.
Ling Ran nodded and said, “If he is truly diagnosed with gallstones, I can recommend a doctor for you.”

The neighbor had done enough research. He said persistently, “I heard from the doctors at Yun Hua Hospital that you’re the best in the hepatobiliary field? Ling Ran, please do this surgery for us. My uncle finally agreed to go for surgery. If it is delayed any further, he may change his mind again.”
Ling Ran said, “When it comes to cholecystectomy, there are doctors who are better than me.”
“We just want you!” The neighborhood thought that Ling Ran was just being humble and continued to request for his help.
Ling Ran saw his determination, so he did not reject anymore. He nodded and said, “Then, let him come for a physical examination during consultation days.”
“Okay, okay.” The neighbor was happy and felt that he had completed a major task.

sentences.text: Ling Ran performed the surgery at breakneck speed.
A hepatolithiasis and hepatectomy on the right lobe of the liver were completed within two hours.
The reporters knew too little to appreciate such a feat.
Since they had taken satisfactory pictures, they left happily.
Huo Congjun encouraged the surgery group again.
“Well done, everyone.
Yes.
Continue to complete your surgeries with high accuracy and show the capability of the Emergency Medical Center of Yun Hua Hospital.
Now, everyone, you still need to keep up the hard work.
Okay...
Doctor Ling, please go back and rest early.
Don’t burn yourself out.”
Ling Ran nodded.
“I’m ready to go back.”
“Yes, yes, have a good rest.
If you do not wish to come tomorrow, just give me a call or send me a message through WeChat.” Huo Congjun smiled.
“It’s a long journey back from Brazil.
The journey must be tiring, so don’t be in a hurry, okay?
Come back again when you have enough rest.”
Everyone’s expression in the operating theater remained unchanged.
Huo Congjun nodded in satisfaction and went out.
Lu Wenbin quietly continued working on things like abdominal closures and so on.
Ling Ran followed Zuo Cidian out, and found himself surrounded by a group of family members.
Ling Ran hastily mentioned a few words and looked to Zuo Cidian for an explanation.
The patients’ family members had too many questions, and to the doctors, most of their questions were boring and were born from ignorance.
The patients’ family members were usually like that.
A patient might have understanding and knowledgeable family members, but there was always one or more family members who were ignorant.
As long as a patient had many family members, they could always ask for the outrageous.
Most doctors could not be bothered to answer such questions.
Only doctors like Zuo Cidian who came from town hospitals could bear these stupid questions.
Zuo Cidian no longer avoided topics about his history in the town hospital.
In truth, it was impossible for him to avoid that.
The hospital was a small, closed off, and boring society.
The transmission speed of a doctor’s qualifications would spread faster than gossip about men and women.
After all, the stories about men and women gossip were not suitable for every occasion.
However, the gossip related to qualifications could be spoken in lots of occasions.
However, Zuo Cidian could now describe his background at the town hospital as another experience.
He had grown patient with the family members.
Because that was the only capital Zuo Cidian had.
Zuo Cidian used around 15 minutes to calm down the family members.
He took the opportunity and said, “Hurry up and go to the Intensive Care Unit.
The patient will be sent there soon, and all of you still need to change to scrubs as well as do other matters.”
The dozen or so patients at the spot instantly became very busy.
Zuo Cidian pulled Ling Ran away and sighed.
Then, he looked at Ling Ran again, smiled, and said, “Doctor Ling, how do you feel?
I mean, how do you feel about the family members.”
“It seems the same as the previous ones.” Ling Ran observed the surroundings.
“How different can the hospital environment be?
There won’t be any changes even if you didn’t come back after a year, much less a month.

It’s the same day after day and year after year...” Zuo Cidian could not help but think about the town hospital he used to work for and said, “I’ve worked for almost twenty years, yet the town hospital did not change much as well.
It looks exactly the same as the time I joined.”
“It’s good if it never changes.” Ling Ran said, judging that statement by his own standards.
Zuo Cidian said, “No changes means that there will be no updates in terms of devices, equipment, as well as the hospital beds.”
“I see, that’s no good.” Ling Ran immediately shook his head, frowned, and thought, “In this case, the devices and equipment in our department has not been updated for a few months.”
“Yes.
But we don’t have that money, right?” Zuo Cidian chuckled.
The Emergency Medical Center survived through grants.
If the patients and prescription costs increased, the allocated grant would increase, and bonuses like cash rewards for doctors and nurses would increase as well.
However, that could not be treated solely as profit, so it could not be used whenever they needed.
Ling Ran nodded slowly.
“Where are we going now?” Zuo Cidian saw that Ling Ran did not want to immediately leave.
“A ward round, and I’m off for today.” Ling Ran was ready to check the two patients who just had the surgery.
The few hours after surgery were usually the time when complications will be at their most serious.
Some hospitals would forcibly increase the frequency of ward rounds.
For example, in a weaker hospital, surgeries like hepatectomy would need the chief surgeon to take care of the patients until the patients regained consciousness.
Of course, strong hospitals did not have to operate like this.

The chief surgeons from the strong hospitals were more skillful, and they would usually send out doctors who were attending physicians and might even be better than an assistant lecturer from a weak hospital.
Ling Ran had his own surgery tempo and ward round schedule.
Due to the fact that he had just returned to the country, Ling Ran wanted to check the patients he operated on today, and he will do so multiple times.
Besides, after coming back to the hospital, he did not visit the ICU at all, and he wanted to make sure their conditions were normal.

“Huh?” Ling Ran looked over.

It’ll keep them on their toes.” Zuo Cidian naturally supported Ling Ran when it came to inspecting his territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 781: Pressed for Time, and Bothersome Task
paragraphs: On the following day, after Ling Ran had a good night’s sleep, he watered the flowers and plants that he had not seen for many days. By the time he was done, milky white clouds were already rising up the horizon.

Huang Maosheng, the pharmaceutical sales representative sent over a full set of breakfast comprising guo bian hu, deep-fried pancakes and dumplings in a show of attentiveness. He then helped out in Lower Groove Clinic by sweeping the courtyard and sprinkling some water on the ground to clean it. After he helped wash some rice and cook a pot of porridge, he left with a smile.

His main task right now was to get in touch with Ling Ran, and he had slowly gotten to know Ling Ran’s likes and dislikes. He knew that Ling Ran did not like it when other people followed him around all the time, and this made things even easier for him. The only inconvenience was that Ling Ran’s working hours were a little weird. But due to his lucrative monthly bonus, Huang Maosheng swallowed his dissatisfaction and went on with his task.
When Ling Jiezhou heard the commotion, he slipped on a singlet and went downstairs.

The singlet was a little old, and the fabric at the position of his shoulders had become a little yellowish. The hem has even become a little curled. Ling Jiezhou did not mind at all though. He knocked on his shoulders a few times to loosen his muscles and washed up in a leisurely manner. He then took a piece of rag and wiped down the railings as well as the tables and chairs. After he was done, he straightened his body and said, “Young people nowadays don’t know how to do chores. All they know how to do is to sweep the ground and sprinkle water on the ground. They have no idea that they need to use a rag to wipe down things at all. In my opinion, that pharmaceutical sales representative of yours is not meticulous when he does things.”
Ling Ran did not catch the main point that his father was trying to convey. He merely hummed in acknowledgment.
“What do you think? Should I talk to him on your behalf next time?” Ling Jiezhou suggested half-jokingly.
Ling Ran still did not realize what his father was trying to imply. “Why do you need the pharmaceutical sales representative to do all this?”
“Because I’m lazy.” Ling Jiezhou grinned.
Ling Ran nodded in agreement.

“I’m too lazy to do this sort of stuff, so I’ll have to take the initiative to talk to him. Get it?” Ling Jiezhou sighed in resignation, as he felt that he had just wasted his breath. However, he continued, “You should put that pharmaceutical sales representative of yours to good use. He’ll feel guilty anyway if you don’t assign tasks for him. And as time goes by, he’ll get used to doing nothing. In the end, he’ll be incapable of getting things done when you ask him to do something. Aren’t you turning him into a piece of trash this way? So, it is only reasonable for you to work your subordinates.”
Ling Ran threw Ling Jiezhou a suspicious glance and said, “This is what you used to say about a doctor working in this clinic, and in the end, the doctor resigned.”

“It’s because that doctor was immature. Take a look at Old Xiong, he has gotten used to being oppressed... No, I mean, isn’t he doing his job well now? Moreover, even if the pharmaceutical sales representative were to resign, the medical company will send someone else over. You don’t have to worry about this.”
Ling Ran hummed in acknowledgment again and started scooping porridge into his bowl.

Even though Ling Jiezhou was not a doctor, he was involved in the field of medicine. He was akin to a person who had seen a pig even though he had never eaten pork. Hence, he had a good understanding of the relationship between doctors and pharmaceutical sales representatives. Now that they were talking about medical companies and pharmaceutical sales representatives, Ling Jiezhou made it a point to give Ling Ran a reminder. “Companies like Changxi Medical Company mainly focus on selling drugs. Most of those drugs can be supplied by other companies too, and there isn’t much difference when it comes to the effectiveness of the drugs and other aspects. I know that you don’t like to bother yourself with too many things, so just take their after-sales customer service into consideration.”
“After-sales customer service?”

“If you have any requirements when it comes to the drugs they supply, you can raise those requirements to them. You can also ask for data and information from them. This way, you will be able to select medical companies that best suits your needs. Of course, you can carry on with companies like Changxi Medical Company that you have worked with for a while. But if you’re bringing in new drugs and stuff, you can go for the medical companies that are more professional.” Ling Jiezhou looked at his son. For some reason, he was a little pleased with himself. “This is especially true when you’re introducing a new surgical method, as cooperation from the medical companies plays a big role in this.”
Ling Ran nodded a little, and he was a little surprised as he looked at his father. He agreed with what his father said. “Makes sense.”

Ling Jiezhou placed his hand on his hips and laughed. “Right? Even though your dad isn’t a doctor, I know the happenings in the field of medicine like the back of my hand. Of course, I know nothing about things like surgeries. You’ve really outdone your dad in this. But when it comes to matters concerning hospital affairs and medical companies, you still have a lot to learn from me.”
*Creak*
The bedroom door on the first floor was pushed open.
Tao Ping’s voice rang out. “Don’t listen to your dad. He deliberately called someone to ask about this yesterday. He even talked to that person for a good few hours.”
Ling Jiezhou laughed so hard that he almost suffocated. “Wifey, I thought we agreed that we’re managing different aspects of the business?”
“Ah, I forgot.” Tao Ping sounded surprised.
Ling Jiezhou raised his head to glance at his wife. “Please wipe that smirk off your face.”
“I really forgot about that!” Tao Ping said good-naturedly.

Ling Ran quietly finished his bowl of porridge as well as eat some deep-fried pancakes and guo bian hu. He then gobbled down a bowl of dumplings, two eggs, and some salted egg yolk. By the time he finished a few grapes and a pear, the courtyard was silent once again.
“I’m off to work.” Ling Ran wiped his mouth and shouted. He then went to the backyard and started his car.

Ling Jiezhou massaged his round belly, which was becoming bigger by the day, and reminded Ling Ran from the first floor, “Old Chen will be bringing his uncle over for a consultation later. Don’t forget.”
“The one with cholecystitis?”
“Yes. Old Chen used to sell cakes. You liked his sesame cakes quite a lot.”
“Why isn’t he selling them anymore?”

“He probably used to have a contact in the food bureau and could get expired ingredients at low prices to make cakes. But after the reform, all the expired ingredients are used to make animal feed, so he couldn’t profit as much as he used to. I guess that’s why he decided to stop selling cakes.” Ling Jiezhou paused for a moment and continued, “He purchased houses with all the money he used to earn though, so he’s probably focusing on being a landlord right now.”
At the consultation area, Ling Ran listened to Zuo Cidian’s suggestion and only put up ten slots. He then sat in the comfort of the examination room and waited for the patients.

Right now, Ling Ran had become a fairly renowned surgeon. Not only had he received media coverage, but there were also other doctors who recommended patients to him. Since he was away from the country for over a month, there were quite a lot of patients slated to see him. If he were to put up too many slots, he would run out of time before he could see all the patients.
Soon after, the patients came in according to their slot numbers. Right after that, there were requests for Ling Ran to put up additional slots.
“Doctor Ling, I have come to you for a consultation before.”
“Doctor Ling, you have operated on me before.”
“Doctor Ling, Doctor Liu from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City recommended me to come over, but I wasn’t able to get a number...”

Since he expected all this, Zuo Cidian arranged the patients asking for additional slots according to the order whereby they came. He then took back the forms that those patients have filled in one by one. Whenever he encountered patients or patients’ family members who were escorted by a medical staff member, Zuo Cidian had no choice but to flash his brightest smile.
Ling Ran did not need to care about all this.

He talked to the patients one by one. There was no need for him to call the patients in by himself, and he did not need to arrange the order of patients coming in to meet him either. Things were pretty convenient for him.

Ling Ran possessed Master Level Physical Examination, and his success rate when it came to diagnosing ordinary illnesses that required surgery was extremely high. Aside from this, most of the patients who took up the additional slots had already been diagnosed, and they were mainly suffering from ailments related to the liver, knee joints, Achilles tendon, and flexor tendon. Even though the scope covered by Ling Ran was slightly bigger than ordinary specialists, compared to senior surgeons and surgeons from Europe as well as the United States, Ling Ran was not capable of treating many ailments.

Ling Ran admitted patients whom he was capable of treating into the Emergency Center and recommended other doctors to the rest of the patients. As for patients who required conservative treatment, Ling Ran prescribed drugs for them. Soon, the morning was almost over.
Old Chen from Lower Groove only gave Ling Ran a call at twelve. He then brought his thirty-eight-year-old uncle upstairs.

“I’m so sorry. My uncle works in an internet company, and he’s extremely busy. He can’t even get a full day of medical leave, so he had no choice but to leave an hour before lunch break so that he can see you during his lunch break.” Old Chen, who was a little over fifty years old, apologized profusely. He then dragged his uncle, who was young and a bit of a stiff person, over. “Even though he’s young, his health is seriously horrible. He’s not even forty years old yet but has suffered from cholecystitis for twelve or thirteen years.”

“It’s been twelve years. I got diagnosed during my second year working for this company.” Young Chen sat opposite Ling Ran and talked about his condition, “A few days ago, the pain got too much to bear. So I sneaked out while working overtime last night and got a fluid transfusion. It’s the only reason I don’t have a fever today. I’m thinking of receiving cholecystectomy.”
“Let me examine you.” Ling Ran put on a pair of gloves.

“I can only take a two-day leave. I’ll have two and a half days if you factor in the weekend. If two days are not enough, I’ll have no choice but to continue to receive conservative treatment.” Young Chen quickly conveyed his needs.

Zuo Cidian, who was sitting beside Ling Ran, could not help but say, “Even though cholecystectomy is a very common surgery, it’s still surgery. How can you expect to get operated on and recover within the span of two days? Your job is going to kill you one day.”

“I can’t help it. We’re racing against time to complete our project. If I were to take a break, the whole project team would have to stop and wait for me. I’ve done some research online, and there are comments that say that not only do Doctor Ling’s patients have good prognoses, but the recovery time is also short. Is that true?”
“But two days is still too short.” Ling Ran shook his head a little.
“How about two and a half days?” Young Chen tried to negotiate.

Ling Ran shook his head again. “Under normal circumstances, patients who underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy can only get discharged after three days, and can only get back to work normally after seven days.”

“I know, but I really can’t take more than two days of leave. The project I’m involved in is linked to the bullet train, and if I were to take a break, it’ll not only affect my team but other teams too. You know, there are even colleagues of mine who have been receiving conservative treatment for appendicitis for two or three years.

Old Chen who was sitting beside Young Chen said, “It’s really impossible for this uncle of mine to take a break. I don’t know anything about the project he’s involved in, but it’s an extremely important one. Ling Ran, please help to think of something.
Ling Ran could not help but glance at his Virtual Human. He could use it for another four hours and twenty-one minutes.

Truth be told, even though he possessed Specialist Level Cholecystectomy courtesy of his own practice, he was far less skillful in cholecystectomy compared to He Yuanzheng from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. However, if he were to make use of the Virtual Human, he could improve the patient’s prognosis by leaps and bounds.

After all, operating on a patient after practicing on the Virtual Human was akin to taking an open-book test using a book that had all its main points highlighted. It was definitely far easier compared to taking a closed book test with no idea about what was going on.
“Get onto the examination bed. I’ll take a look.” Ling Ran stood up.

He then gobbled down a bowl of dumplings, two eggs, and some salted egg yolk.
By the time he finished a few grapes and a pear, the courtyard was silent once again.
“I’m off to work.” Ling Ran wiped his mouth and shouted.
He then went to the backyard and started his car.
Ling Jiezhou massaged his round belly, which was becoming bigger by the day, and reminded Ling Ran from the first floor, “Old Chen will be bringing his uncle over for a consultation later.
Don’t forget.”
“The one with cholecystitis?”
“Yes.
Old Chen used to sell cakes.
You liked his sesame cakes quite a lot.”
“Why isn’t he selling them anymore?”
“He probably used to have a contact in the food bureau and could get expired ingredients at low prices to make cakes.
But after the reform, all the expired ingredients are used to make animal feed, so he couldn’t profit as much as he used to.

I guess that’s why he decided to stop selling cakes.” Ling Jiezhou paused for a moment and continued, “He purchased houses with all the money he used to earn though, so he’s probably focusing on being a landlord right now.”
At the consultation area, Ling Ran listened to Zuo Cidian’s suggestion and only put up ten slots.
He then sat in the comfort of the examination room and waited for the patients.
Right now, Ling Ran had become a fairly renowned surgeon.
Not only had he received media coverage, but there were also other doctors who recommended patients to him.
Since he was away from the country for over a month, there were quite a lot of patients slated to see him.
If he were to put up too many slots, he would run out of time before he could see all the patients.
Soon after, the patients came in according to their slot numbers.
Right after that, there were requests for Ling Ran to put up additional slots.
“Doctor Ling, I have come to you for a consultation before.”
“Doctor Ling, you have operated on me before.”
“Doctor Ling, Doctor Liu from the First People’s Hospital of Wuxin City recommended me to come over, but I wasn’t able to get a number...”
Since he expected all this, Zuo Cidian arranged the patients asking for additional slots according to the order whereby they came.
He then took back the forms that those patients have filled in one by one.
Whenever he encountered patients or patients’ family members who were escorted by a medical staff member, Zuo Cidian had no choice but to flash his brightest smile.
Ling Ran did not need to care about all this.
He talked to the patients one by one.
There was no need for him to call the patients in by himself, and he did not need to arrange the order of patients coming in to meet him either.
Things were pretty convenient for him.
Ling Ran possessed Master Level Physical Examination, and his success rate when it came to diagnosing ordinary illnesses that required surgery was extremely high.

Aside from this, most of the patients who took up the additional slots had already been diagnosed, and they were mainly suffering from ailments related to the liver, knee joints, Achilles tendon, and flexor tendon.

Even though the scope covered by Ling Ran was slightly bigger than ordinary specialists, compared to senior surgeons and surgeons from Europe as well as the United States, Ling Ran was not capable of treating many ailments.
Ling Ran admitted patients whom he was capable of treating into the Emergency Center and recommended other doctors to the rest of the patients.
As for patients who required conservative treatment, Ling Ran prescribed drugs for them.
Soon, the morning was almost over.
Old Chen from Lower Groove only gave Ling Ran a call at twelve.
He then brought his thirty-eight-year-old uncle upstairs.
“I’m so sorry.
My uncle works in an internet company, and he’s extremely busy.

He can’t even get a full day of medical leave, so he had no choice but to leave an hour before lunch break so that he can see you during his lunch break.” Old Chen, who was a little over fifty years old, apologized profusely.
He then dragged his uncle, who was young and a bit of a stiff person, over.
“Even though he’s young, his health is seriously horrible.
He’s not even forty years old yet but has suffered from cholecystitis for twelve or thirteen years.”
“It’s been twelve years.
I got diagnosed during my second year working for this company.” Young Chen sat opposite Ling Ran and talked about his condition, “A few days ago, the pain got too much to bear.
So I sneaked out while working overtime last night and got a fluid transfusion.
It’s the only reason I don’t have a fever today.
I’m thinking of receiving cholecystectomy.”
“Let me examine you.” Ling Ran put on a pair of gloves.
“I can only take a two-day leave.
I’ll have two and a half days if you factor in the weekend.
If two days are not enough, I’ll have no choice but to continue to receive conservative treatment.” Young Chen quickly conveyed his needs.
Zuo Cidian, who was sitting beside Ling Ran, could not help but say, “Even though cholecystectomy is a very common surgery, it’s still surgery.
How can you expect to get operated on and recover within the span of two days?
Your job is going to kill you one day.”
“I can’t help it.
We’re racing against time to complete our project.
If I were to take a break, the whole project team would have to stop and wait for me.
I’ve done some research online, and there are comments that say that not only do Doctor Ling’s patients have good prognoses, but the recovery time is also short.
Is that true?”
“But two days is still too short.” Ling Ran shook his head a little.
“How about two and a half days?” Young Chen tried to negotiate.
Ling Ran shook his head again.
“Under normal circumstances, patients who underwent laparoscopic cholecystectomy can only get discharged after three days, and can only get back to work normally after seven days.”
“I know, but I really can’t take more than two days of leave.
The project I’m involved in is linked to the bullet train, and if I were to take a break, it’ll not only affect my team but other teams too.
You know, there are even colleagues of mine who have been receiving conservative treatment for appendicitis for two or three years.
Old Chen who was sitting beside Young Chen said, “It’s really impossible for this uncle of mine to take a break.
I don’t know anything about the project he’s involved in, but it’s an extremely important one.
Ling Ran, please help to think of something.
Ling Ran could not help but glance at his Virtual Human.
He could use it for another four hours and twenty-one minutes.

Truth be told, even though he possessed Specialist Level Cholecystectomy courtesy of his own practice, he was far less skillful in cholecystectomy compared to He Yuanzheng from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
However, if he were to make use of the Virtual Human, he could improve the patient’s prognosis by leaps and bounds.
After all, operating on a patient after practicing on the Virtual Human was akin to taking an open-book test using a book that had all its main points highlighted.
It was definitely far easier compared to taking a closed book test with no idea about what was going on.
“Get onto the examination bed.
I’ll take a look.” Ling Ran stood up.

chapters.title: Chapter 782: Quick Recovery
paragraphs: Young Chen stared at Ling Ran helplessly, and he was pushed down so forcefully that he took sharp breaths.
However, after he saw how Ling Ran closed his eyes and pondered hard, Young Chen did not dare disturb him.

He was fed up with the pain caused by cholecystitis. The pain was a part of it. The frequency of how many times his back swelled up every day had also affected Chen Xiaowang, who worked in the IT field. In addition, the complications of chronic cholecystitis were even more worrying.

On the other hand, the big ongoing projects were far from being completed. In other words, no matter how much the projects progressed today unless the company fell into bankruptcy, there would always be new projects that were short of staff waiting in line for him.
“If you can take four days’ leaves, maybe your recovery process will be better.” After spending twenty seconds of briefly examining the Virtual Human, Ling Ran came out with a basic conclusion.
Chen Xiaowang shook his head vigorously. “Four days’ leave is impossible.”
Zuo Cidian could not understand it. He said, “It’s not like you’re going on a vacation. You’re sick, getting four days’ leaves in a year is not too much, right?”

“I really can’t,” Chen Xiaowang said in resignation, “You might say I’m bragging, but my company is now the leading Internet company in China. In general, the joint high-speed rail projects we took is related to the national economy and people’s livelihood. In small terms, hundreds of colleagues, thousands of migrant workers, and engineers are busy working for several months to strive for the early completion of the project. If I were to take four days’ leaves, I will delay the whole process, which will have a huge impact on the project. To be honest, I’m not that shameless to do so.”

Zuo Cidian was stunned, he then said in the tone of someone who was experienced in the workings of the world, “My generation works hard, but your generation definitely is working so much harder. You should know that your gallbladder is still a human organ. Although there’re minimally invasive techniques now, the whole gallbladder still has to be cut off. The harm it has on people is quite great. We’re really asking for the minimum number of days off by asking you to rest for four to five days.”
Chen Xiaowang hesitated a few seconds before saying, “If it’s really impossible, I’ll go for conservative treatment. I’ll come back for the surgery during Chinese New Year.”
Speechless, Zuo Cidian glanced at Ling Ran, then at Chen Xiaowang, and he said unhappily, “You’re just ruining your own body.”

“I know. I have no other choice.” Chen Xiaowang now sounded more persistent, but in an instant, his tone softened. “I’m not the only one like this in the company. If anything really happened, I will take a long leave. I will have to find someone to replace me. But if I have someone to replace me, I won’t be able to get my job back.”
“If you lost your health, you won’t be able to get it back.” Zuo Cidian nagged a little more and looked at Ling Ran again.
“You can only have two and a half days?” Ling Ran asked Chen Xiaowang.

Chen Xiaowang nodded. “I plan to leave work early at five o’clock on Friday afternoon and come to the hospital for surgery at six o’clock. Then, I can rest on Saturday and Sunda. Then, on Monday morning, I have to go to work earlier, so with this, I can have a total of sixty hours off. I might have to work overtime on Monday...”
Zuo Cidian sighed after he heard this. “Are you that busy?”
“Yes,” Chen Xiaowang replied concisely.
Old Chen, who was at the side, said, “My uncle is really busy. Isn’t the trend now to work for twelve hours a day, six days a week? He’s working twelve hours a day, six and a half days a week.”
Ling Ran pondered hard after he heard what Old Chen said.
To him, this was like another surgery in Cuba Town.
The conditions were so strict that some of them were unreasonable, but the constraints of reality forced them to search for a way to finish them.

From Ling Ran’s perspective, it was indeed irresponsible to only let your own body to recover from surgery with only two and a half days, but it would be extremely irresponsible for the patient’s own health if he chose conservative treatment before he went for surgery during Chinese New Year.
Ling Ran did not try to persuade or advise the patient otherwise like Zuo Cidian with words. The first thing Ling Ran did was try to think of a technique to solve this problem.

In order to recover quickly after surgery, the first consideration that should be taken was to reduce intraoperative injuries. Among them, the most common injuries were intraoperative injuries. Cholecystectomy itself was injuring the human body. During the operation, when they pushed the gallbladder upwards, it was necessary to consider whether the bile duct and the liver beside would be damaged as well. Secondly, after cholecystectomy, the bile duct must be sealed closed with titanium clips, and this was a key issue, because the surgeon had to take note of whether the bile duct was completely sealed, whether the titanium clips were loose, whether the clips touched and damaged the bile duct, whether there was too much force when the titanium clips were used, whether the clips shifted, and whether they were placed in such a manner that they formed a sharp angle...

If he were to continue to follow the sequence of the surgery, when it came to the part where he removed the gallbladder, he will need an endotherm knife or ultrasonic knife. When the knives “glowed” in the laparoscope, the damage caused by the thermoelectric effect also needed to be considered...

In addition, laparoscopic cholecystectomy and the complex anatomical relationship between the gallbladder and bile duct also determined the process of the surgery and the patient’s postoperative recovery.

A normal cholecystectomy with a laparoscope required the patient to be hospitalized for three days, then rest at home for three or four days. Due to physical differences in different individuals, it was normal for patients to be able to move around actively after only one or two days.
Moreover, there were many patients who only needed to be hospitalized for a day. However, most doctors could not predict which patient would recover faster.

This was because a patient’s recovery time did not just depend on their physique, but also due to doctors’ maneuvers during surgery. Usually, these factors would cause a patient’s recovery time to be completely randomized.
Ling Ran thought that if he could eliminate some of the plausible problems in the middle, two and a half days’ recovery time would turn out to be somewhat enough for the patient.

When he briefly recalled what he saw in the Virtual Human, Ling Ran finally made a decision and said, “Okay, go and complete the process for hospitalization and schedule a check-up. If everything goes well, you will have surgery at six in the evening on Friday.”
“So, can I go to work on Monday?” Young Chen widened his eyes.
Ling Ran nodded slowly and said, “You will have a seventy percent chance that you can go to work on Monday.”
“How about the thirty percent?”

Ling Ran said, “The common complications for cholecystectomy under a laparoscope include bile leakage, abdominal hemorrhage, bile duct injury, intraoperative nerve injury, blood vessel injury, and injury to adjacent organs during surgery. All have a certain probability of happening. In addition, if there is major bleeding during surgery, it could be life-threatening...”
“Doctor Ling, let me handle the preoperative conversation.” Zuo Cidian listened to Ling Ran talk about the risks of surgery in a stiff manner, and he could feel his hair rising.
Chen Xiaowang already had goosebumps. He was still young, after all.

Zuo Cidian coughed a couple of times. He then said, “Talks about intraoperative risk is mandatory, but the probability of occurrence is actually very small, especially in the case of intraoperative death. Ever since our hospital began providing cholecystectomy under the laparoscope, there has been no case of death due to major cholecystectomy hemorrhage. There was indeed hemorrhage before, but whether or not you will die because of hemorrhage also depends entirely on probability. You know, mathematics is really weird...”

Chen Xiaowang interrupted Zuo Cidian’s explanation and said, “I’m not afraid of a hemorrhage. If there is a major hemorrhage, then I don’t have to rush back to the company. I will just have to claim my insurance, resign, and rest at home. If I were to die in surgery, I don’t have to think about going to work, right?”
“I mean... seems like it,” Zuo Cidian felt as if he had been dragged into Chen Xiaowang’s rhythm in the conversation.
“Doctor Ling, I’ll leave my body to you.” Chen Xiaowang got up and shook hands with Ling Ran.

“Remember to do the examination,” Ling Ran and Chen Xiaowang gently shook hands. He then opened a bottle of alcohol-based hand sanitizer and switched on the Virtual Human. He wiped his hands with the sanitizer while he examined Chen Xiaowang’s virtual body through lavish use of the Virtual Human.
