chapters.title: Chapter 790: Older
paragraphs: In the light blue operating theater, a smile could be seen on Ma Yanlin’s face from time to time.
He smiled when he saw a young nurse. Then, he showed his smile again when he saw Ling Ran and the abdominal cavity of a patient.
Ling Ran did not care about what the doctors under him did, but Lu Wenbin felt really uncomfortable watching it.

Lu Wenbin saw a vermiform appendix being pulled out, and Ma Yanlin still showed a mysterious smile. He could not help but ask, “Young Ma, if you wish to eat braised pork intestine, I’ll get one for you later. This is human intestines, please don’t show your teeth while staring at it. It’s really creepy.”
“I don’t want your braised intestines. The treat is on me tonight. Boss Shao’s restaurant.” Ma Yanlin chuckled while holding a mirror.

A single appendectomy was performed with three doctors. Only the leader of a treatment group could have this special treatment. Now, when Ling Ran performed surgery, it was no longer just surgery. It also contained elements of teaching in it.

The interns who graduated from medical college or the housemen who had only been in the field for two or three years or residents doctors would not know how to perform surgery. If they did not have any cheating systems with them, they would have to learn everything again. Even surgeries like appendectomy could not be perfected without repeated practice. Before this, the doctors usually needed to learn through dissecting bodies and even dissect one or two dogs or rabbits to have a small foundation.
The Perfect Level Appendectomy mastered by Ling Ran contained even more information.

Lu Wenbin originally stared at Ling Ran, but he was distracted by Ma Yanlin. When he heard the term “treat”, he smoothed out the frown between his eyebrows and said, “I’ll forgive you if you treat me two bamboo rats.”

“You’re still jealous of me, right?” Ma Yanlin chuckled and said, “I’m only going to treat you to mutton skewers. Doctor Ling, are you going? If you’re going, I’ll treat all of you to tripes as well.”
Ling Ran’s eyes stared at the screen, his maneuvers never changed, and he asked, “Because of the letter of appointment?”

“Yes. Not everyone will get the offer, right?” Ma Yanlin said, smiled and added. “I’m different from you. Also, I’m previously from the Orthopedics Department, and it’s not easy for me to be transferred from the Orthopedics Department to the Emergency Medical Center, right?”

“How hard could it be to get the letter of appointment for a resident doctor?” Lu Wenbin chuckled and said, “But it’s interesting that you gave up on the Orthopedics Department. The kids down there must be very thankful for you. So many of them are fighting for this position.”

There were two different title promotional systems in the hospital. One of them was to participate and pass through the test before being recruited as resident doctors, attending physicians, assistant lecturers, and senior lecturers. Meanwhile, the other one required the hospital to offer a letter of appointment. Once the letter was obtained, the promotion could be counted as complete.

In a small hospital, many doctors did not manage to pass through the test, or their academic qualifications were not sufficient. There were always many letters of appointment for resident doctors or attending physicians. Some doctors just could not pass the test, and they had no choice but to be recognized internally by the hospital in the end.

In a big hospital, there were usually many doctors who excelled in their studies. Besides, those with PhDs and overseas experience would get a lot of points in their chances of being authorized. Usually, a large group of them would pass through the test, and they would have to queue up and wait for the letter of appointment.

Of course, regardless of which way it was, it was always easier for the resident doctors. The difficult part was always getting promoted to an attending physician, and it was the level that Lu Wenbin wanted to get promoted...

When Lu Wenbin saw that Ma Yanlin had received his letter of appointment in advance and made a firm decision to transfer to the Emergency Medical Center as well as giving up his post in the Orthopedics Department, it would be impossible that Lu Wenbin did not feel stressed.

In truth, in Ling Ran’s treatment group, Lu Wenbin and Ma Yanlin had the best surgery skill. Zhang Anmin’s skill was not too bad, but he was an authorized doctor in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. Therefore from this point alone, Lu Wenbin was the only outstanding candidate in Ling Ran’s treatment group, and he always acknowledged himself as the eldest disciple.

However, Ma Yanlin did not want to be the second disciple. He first snorted and buttered up to Ling Ran a little. “Forget about the Orthopedics Department or any other department, it means nothing if Doctor Ling is not there. Even if Doctor Ling goes to the Colorectal Department, I’ll follow too.”
Lu Wenbin was impressed. “That loyalty alone is worthy of the department treating us to dinner tonight, Doctor Ling.”
“Okay.” Ling Ran agreed and said, “Pocket.”
Lu Wenbin was stunned because he was actually joking.
Ma Yanlin could not help but laugh. “Okay. Let’s eat bamboo rats tonight. Doctor Ling, three bamboo rats?”
“Sure.” Ling Ran nodded and put the vermiform appendix in the pocket with the aid of a laparoscope before he dragged it out.
Lu Wenbin took over the vermiform appendix and quickly asked, “Um, Doctor Ling, why would you allow Ma Yanlin to treat us?”
“I thought you were the one who suggested it?” Ling Ran threw the question back at Lu Wenbin.
Lu Wenbin was stunned.
Then, he heard Ling Ran say, “The department is quite rich now, and Zuo Cidian suggests to spend some of it. It’s a perfect chance.”

Lu Wenbin could not deny that. He knew that the department was rich, and as a separate individual department of the hospital, their ratio of self-funded patients was the highest. The two-and-a-half-day leave company, the company next door, and the company next door to the company next door sent patients to them at an insane pace, and they practically funded their own stay in the hospital. Naturally, they helped the department accumulate a lot of bonuses.
This amount of money could not be given out completely. If too much bonus was given, not only would the higher-ups notice, other departments in the hospital would realize as well.

Lu Wenbin did not care too much about bonuses in the past, but now, he was no longer the young man who could use his salary to pay off his house and car loans daily. Right now, the house and car loans he owed could not be cleared with his salary...
“Who will continue the subsequent part?” Ling Ran gave up his position.
“Me!” Ma Yanlin was excited to fight for the position. Lu Wenbin hesitated for a while before he chose to be the assistant for Ma Yanlin.
Ma Yanlin grinned and said, “Thank you, Doctor Lu.”
“Treat it as a welcoming gift for your return from Brazil.” Lu Wenbin sighed. “I’ll bring you some braised food as side dishes later.”
“Oh, okay.” Ma Yanlin agreed. “Sorry for the expense.”
Lu Wenbin shook his head, “I’m not spending any money at all. Since the department is paying for it, I’ll just need to claim it from Old Zuo later on.”
Ling Ran no longer bothered himself with the operating theater that had lost its vermiform appendix patient. He went out and washed his hands before he headed to the next room.
“Doctor Ling, you’re here. Blue or green scrubs for today?” The young nurse, Su Mengxue smiled sweetly at Ling Ran.
“Blue.” Ling Ran chose a different color based on the draping of the operating table. After he put it on, he walked around the operating theater and inspected it.
Yu Yuan stepped on two stepping stools without moving. Besides, it was not convenient for her to move.
“The patient looks quite old. How old is he?” Ling Ran felt puzzled when he walked to the front.
Su Mengxue looked at the patient’s white hair, smiled, and said, “Is it because programmers age faster than others?”

Yu Yuan was the doctor in charge of the patient. She shook her head, “The patient is indeed fifty-five years old. From the conversation of the family members, he should be the father of a programmer. They wanted to receive the surgery as they said the recovery time for the patients you treated was short. The patient had chronic cholecystitis for more than ten years, and his gallbladder has lost its function...”

“The recovery ability of those at fifty-five is very slow.” Ling Ran did not mind the age of the patient. Over the past few days, he had performed surgery for a few patients who were around 40 years old as well. Their conditions were not any better than the fifty-five-year-old patient.

“Okay,” Yu Yuan replied and said, “I have talked to the patient’s family members. They did not request for the specific number of days needed for the recovery, but they hope that the surgery is properly done so that the recovery is faster and the patient would suffer less.”
Ling Ran nodded.

“Also self-funded. The family should have quite a good financial status.” Yu Yuan added. The drugs used would be different between those who funded their own stay and those who used medical insurance.
“I see, then let me think about it.” Ling Ran looked at the board from the system.
The requirements for The Way Forward was for him to perform fifty abdominal surgeries, and the recovery time must be shorter than sixty hours.
His current progress was 43/50.

Seven more patients were needed, but after Ling Ran made some calculations, including the appendectomy surgery he performed using a laparoscope just now, there were already six patients laying in the hospital ward. He just needed to perform one more, and theoretically speaking, he could obtain another Intermediate Treasure Chest after one to two days.
“We can still try for a short recovery surgery.” Ling Ran thought and said, “We’ll still go on with the established plan, and let’s be careful with the operation accuracy.”
Although Ling Ran seemed to be reminding Yu Yuan, he was actually reminding himself as well.

“You’re still jealous of me, right?” Ma Yanlin chuckled and said, “I’m only going to treat you to mutton skewers.
Doctor Ling, are you going?
If you’re going, I’ll treat all of you to tripes as well.”
Ling Ran’s eyes stared at the screen, his maneuvers never changed, and he asked, “Because of the letter of appointment?”
“Yes.
Not everyone will get the offer, right?” Ma Yanlin said, smiled and added.
“I’m different from you.
Also, I’m previously from the Orthopedics Department, and it’s not easy for me to be transferred from the Orthopedics Department to the Emergency Medical Center, right?”
“How hard could it be to get the letter of appointment for a resident doctor?” Lu Wenbin chuckled and said, “But it’s interesting that you gave up on the Orthopedics Department.
The kids down there must be very thankful for you.
So many of them are fighting for this position.”
There were two different title promotional systems in the hospital.
One of them was to participate and pass through the test before being recruited as resident doctors, attending physicians, assistant lecturers, and senior lecturers.
Meanwhile, the other one required the hospital to offer a letter of appointment.
Once the letter was obtained, the promotion could be counted as complete.
In a small hospital, many doctors did not manage to pass through the test, or their academic qualifications were not sufficient.
There were always many letters of appointment for resident doctors or attending physicians.
Some doctors just could not pass the test, and they had no choice but to be recognized internally by the hospital in the end.
In a big hospital, there were usually many doctors who excelled in their studies.
Besides, those with PhDs and overseas experience would get a lot of points in their chances of being authorized.
Usually, a large group of them would pass through the test, and they would have to queue up and wait for the letter of appointment.
Of course, regardless of which way it was, it was always easier for the resident doctors.
The difficult part was always getting promoted to an attending physician, and it was the level that Lu Wenbin wanted to get promoted...

When Lu Wenbin saw that Ma Yanlin had received his letter of appointment in advance and made a firm decision to transfer to the Emergency Medical Center as well as giving up his post in the Orthopedics Department, it would be impossible that Lu Wenbin did not feel stressed.
In truth, in Ling Ran’s treatment group, Lu Wenbin and Ma Yanlin had the best surgery skill.
Zhang Anmin’s skill was not too bad, but he was an authorized doctor in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
Therefore from this point alone, Lu Wenbin was the only outstanding candidate in Ling Ran’s treatment group, and he always acknowledged himself as the eldest disciple.
However, Ma Yanlin did not want to be the second disciple.
He first snorted and buttered up to Ling Ran a little.
“Forget about the Orthopedics Department or any other department, it means nothing if Doctor Ling is not there.
Even if Doctor Ling goes to the Colorectal Department, I’ll follow too.”
Lu Wenbin was impressed.
“That loyalty alone is worthy of the department treating us to dinner tonight, Doctor Ling.”
“Okay.” Ling Ran agreed and said, “Pocket.”
Lu Wenbin was stunned because he was actually joking.
Ma Yanlin could not help but laugh.
“Okay.
Let’s eat bamboo rats tonight.
Doctor Ling, three bamboo rats?”
“Sure.” Ling Ran nodded and put the vermiform appendix in the pocket with the aid of a laparoscope before he dragged it out.
Lu Wenbin took over the vermiform appendix and quickly asked, “Um, Doctor Ling, why would you allow Ma Yanlin to treat us?”
“I thought you were the one who suggested it?” Ling Ran threw the question back at Lu Wenbin.
Lu Wenbin was stunned.
Then, he heard Ling Ran say, “The department is quite rich now, and Zuo Cidian suggests to spend some of it.
It’s a perfect chance.”
Lu Wenbin could not deny that.
He knew that the department was rich, and as a separate individual department of the hospital, their ratio of self-funded patients was the highest.

The two-and-a-half-day leave company, the company next door, and the company next door to the company next door sent patients to them at an insane pace, and they practically funded their own stay in the hospital.
Naturally, they helped the department accumulate a lot of bonuses.
This amount of money could not be given out completely.
If too much bonus was given, not only would the higher-ups notice, other departments in the hospital would realize as well.
Lu Wenbin did not care too much about bonuses in the past, but now, he was no longer the young man who could use his salary to pay off his house and car loans daily.
Right now, the house and car loans he owed could not be cleared with his salary...
“Who will continue the subsequent part?” Ling Ran gave up his position.
“Me!” Ma Yanlin was excited to fight for the position.
Lu Wenbin hesitated for a while before he chose to be the assistant for Ma Yanlin.
Ma Yanlin grinned and said, “Thank you, Doctor Lu.”
“Treat it as a welcoming gift for your return from Brazil.” Lu Wenbin sighed.
“I’ll bring you some braised food as side dishes later.”
“Oh, okay.” Ma Yanlin agreed.
“Sorry for the expense.”
Lu Wenbin shook his head, “I’m not spending any money at all.
Since the department is paying for it, I’ll just need to claim it from Old Zuo later on.”
Ling Ran no longer bothered himself with the operating theater that had lost its vermiform appendix patient.
He went out and washed his hands before he headed to the next room.
“Doctor Ling, you’re here.
Blue or green scrubs for today?” The young nurse, Su Mengxue smiled sweetly at Ling Ran.
“Blue.” Ling Ran chose a different color based on the draping of the operating table.
After he put it on, he walked around the operating theater and inspected it.
Yu Yuan stepped on two stepping stools without moving.
Besides, it was not convenient for her to move.
“The patient looks quite old.
How old is he?” Ling Ran felt puzzled when he walked to the front.
Su Mengxue looked at the patient’s white hair, smiled, and said, “Is it because programmers age faster than others?”
Yu Yuan was the doctor in charge of the patient.
She shook her head, “The patient is indeed fifty-five years old.
From the conversation of the family members, he should be the father of a programmer.
They wanted to receive the surgery as they said the recovery time for the patients you treated was short.
The patient had chronic cholecystitis for more than ten years, and his gallbladder has lost its function...”
“The recovery ability of those at fifty-five is very slow.” Ling Ran did not mind the age of the patient.
Over the past few days, he had performed surgery for a few patients who were around 40 years old as well.
Their conditions were not any better than the fifty-five-year-old patient.
“Okay,” Yu Yuan replied and said, “I have talked to the patient’s family members.
They did not request for the specific number of days needed for the recovery, but they hope that the surgery is properly done so that the recovery is faster and the patient would suffer less.”
Ling Ran nodded.
“Also self-funded.
The family should have quite a good financial status.” Yu Yuan added.
The drugs used would be different between those who funded their own stay and those who used medical insurance.
“I see, then let me think about it.” Ling Ran looked at the board from the system.
The requirements for The Way Forward was for him to perform fifty abdominal surgeries, and the recovery time must be shorter than sixty hours.
His current progress was 43/50.

Seven more patients were needed, but after Ling Ran made some calculations, including the appendectomy surgery he performed using a laparoscope just now, there were already six patients laying in the hospital ward.
He just needed to perform one more, and theoretically speaking, he could obtain another Intermediate Treasure Chest after one to two days.
“We can still try for a short recovery surgery.” Ling Ran thought and said, “We’ll still go on with the established plan, and let’s be careful with the operation accuracy.”
Although Ling Ran seemed to be reminding Yu Yuan, he was actually reminding himself as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 Hey, Skill Book
paragraphs: *Thud thud thud thud*
At five in the morning, uniformed steps could be heard from the corridor of the Emergency Medical Center.
The patients and their family members who had already stayed in the hospital for a few days peeped around and started to rouse themselves.
Fifty-five-year-old Jin Manfen was shaken awake by his wife as well. He wiped his face as his mind remained muddled with sleep, and he heard the familiar complaints around him.

“Look at you, you just keep sleeping on and on. Didn’t our niece tell you to prepare the questions so that when Doctor Ling comes for his ward round later, you’ll be able to ask a few more questions than others?”
“Those who have a lot of free time in their hands will sleep like logs. Aren’t you embarrassed with yourself?”
“Open your eyes wider. Stop looking like you’ve worked overtime yesterday. You slept for the whole day yesterday.”
Jin Manfen was nagged by his wife and said helplessly, “It’s because I had my surgery yesterday that I slept for a day.”

“Who in the hospital has not undergone surgery? No one sleeps like you. I stayed awake for the whole night, and you did not even chat with me or do anything...” Jin Manfen’s wife stared at his wound, and she was very worried.
Jin Manfen said in resignation, “So, should I talk to you, or should I prepare questions?”

“Shut up. You’re using such things as excuses again.” After Jin Manfen’s wife saw him waking up, she sat aside and played with her phone. She said, “Doctor Ling only goes for ward rounds once every few days. If you have any questions, you must ask and make sure everything is answered in one go. Also, remember to check when you can be discharged. If you are discharged earlier, you will never see Doctor Ling again.”
“How are you sure it’ll be Doctor Ling?” Jin Manfen fought back a little.
“Your eldest niece said that. Only Doctor Ling produces such great momentum in the Emergency Medical Center when he comes out.”
“Okay,” Jin Manfen replied, and he did not try to retort. If the doctor was not great, he would not look for him as well.
After some time, a doctor wearing a white coat came in and informed them, “Doctor Ling is here for a ward round, please wake up the patients.”
“He’s already awake.” Jin Manfen immediately went and greeted the doctor.
Zuo Cidian nodded with a serious expression, then he saw Ling Ran enter the hospital ward.
“How do you feel?” Ling Ran was holding a bottle of alcohol-based hand sanitizer and spread the sanitizer on both of his hands.
Jin Manfen immediately said, “The wound is hurting me a little, and my stomach is growling...”
“I’ll help you perform a physical examination.” Ling Ran went forward and went straight with a physical examination.

He now had Master Level Physical Examination. He could obtain a lot of information through physical information, and most of the time, he could detect problems patients did not even realize themselves.
Jin Manfen immediately showed his belly, and he looked like a sea lion that was lying down on its back. He chuckled and said, “I see nothing in the drainage tube, is it okay now?”
“The recovery is looking good.” Ling Ran nodded slightly and looked at Jin Manfen before he asked a few questions. He then stood up and said, “If you’re willing to, you can be discharged tomorrow.”
Jin Manfen was very happy. “Can I really recover within two and a half days?”

“You still have a long time till full recovery.” Zuo Cidian reminded him and said, “Doctor Ling allows you to be discharged because he thinks that you do not need to be further observed. But if you still feel discomfort, you must come back immediately for treatment. Otherwise, you can just take your medicine normally and rest at home.”
“I’m allowed to work, right? I saw that the people in my daughter’s company had started to work.” Jin Manfen was a bit excited.
Ling Ran hesitated and said, “Unless you have something urgent to do, or else, it’s better to rest.”
“Okay, okay.” Jin Manfen smiled and used his hands to tidy up his white hair. “I’m just asking. I’m now retired, so I don’t have to work.”
The doctors on the spot rolled their eyes and felt as if they were teased.

Ling Ran nodded and continued to perform physical examination for the patients at the next beds. He took out a bottle of alcohol-based hand sanitizer and saw two Zhonghua cigarettes in the bedside cabinet near to Jin Manfen.
“Smoking is prohibited in the hospital.” Ling Ran looked very serious. He started his career path with finger replantation, so he cared about smoking very much.
After a person finished with cholecystectomy, although smoking was not strictly prohibited, since they went through general anesthesia, abstaining from smoking would still be a better choice.
The family members looked guilty when they saw Ling Ran’s expression. They quickly said, “It’s not for him to smoke. They were given by his friends.”
All doctors looked at the family members together.
“Your logic is flawed. How could they understand if you say it this way?” Jin Manfen waved his hands and said, “The cigarettes are given by my friends, but they are not for me.”
“They give cigarettes when they visit the patient?” Lu Wenbin frowned.
“There are always some crazy friends.” When Jin Manfen said that, the doctors agreed and nodded.
“Rest well.” Ling Ran nodded again and did not go to the next bed.
At the same time, a message from the system popped out.
[Mission: The Way Forward (Completed)]
[Mission Details: Complete 50 abdominal surgeries where the patients’ recovery time is less than 60 hours.]
(Reward: Intermediate Treasure Chest]
An Intermediate Treasure Chest was placed in front of Ling Ran. It shone brightly, as though it were covered by expensive makeup.
In Ling Ran’s mind, the conclusion he got was that Jin Manfen had recovered completely.
Because the fifty abdominal surgeries included Jin Manfen as well. If he could complete the mission, it meant that his recovery time was less than sixty hours.
“Your body is good.” Ling Ran turned around and praised Jin Manfen.

“Really?” Jin Manfen looked excited and started to boast about himself, “At that time, I was very fit. I could just carry the computer and move around wherever I want. My tendons were so strong that I could play basketball or even punch the people from two faculty of arts!”
His wife did not object but said airily, “At that time, you were really fit.”
Ten minutes later, Ling Ran walked out of the ward and hesitated for five seconds and opened two Intermediate Treasure Chests.

One of the Intermediate Treasure Chests was obtained during the Treat the Wounded and Sick mission in Brazil. Due to the bad medical conditions in Brazil, Ling Ran remembered it clearly, so much so that when Ling Ran completed his mission, he wanted to earn a few more Intermediate Treasure Chests before he opened them.

However, the speed in which he obtained Basic Treasure Chests now was still okay. However, it was not that easy to obtain Intermediate Treasure Chests. He wanted to earn more, but he had no idea how long it would take before the next mission came.
On the other hand, Ling Ran had used his ‘Virtual Human’ very often in order to cover his lack of skill in cholecystectomy, and it was now the time to fill in more time for the Virtual Human.
Two Intermediate Treasure Chests and 287 Basic Treasure Chests were opened all together, and the rewards occupied the entire corridor.
Among the Energy Serums and a few anatomical dissection experience, Ling Ran saw a four-hour Virtual Human and a shining skill book.
Certainly, the Energy Serums were shining as well, but it was not obvious, as it was just like a handsome man standing among a group of handsome men.
[Choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct (Perfect Level)].
A row of words was clearly seen on the title page of the skill book.

chapters.title: Chapter 792 Brilliant
paragraphs: “Doctor Ling?” Zuo Cidian saw Ling Ran stop walking. He immediately walked forward and was ready to serve him.
He saw Ling Ran pause, gently waved his hands, and asked, “Where is Zhang Anmin?”
Zuo Cidian’s legs gave out a little, then he was stunned for two seconds before he said, “Doctor Zhang is not back to work yet.”
“Not back to work yet?” Ling Ran asked.
“Oh...” He looked disappointed.

‘Choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct’ was a standard surgery in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. Normally, the Emergency Department would not deal with such a case. Biliary obstruction does not simply occur in a day. Patients who knew about this would usually go for specialist departments when they needed to receive the surgery, and they would not go to the Emergency Department.

However, in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, there were more patients with indications for choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct. With the high reputation of Yun Hua Hospital, some patients with mild indications might not even be admitted. It was likely that patients with mere biliary obstruction would be transferred to other hospitals.

Department Director He Yuanzheng of the field of hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery originally came from other hospitals. Since his focus was mainly on the liver, it was normal for him to transfer the patients with gallbladder and bile duct diseases to doctors that he was familiar with. This was similar to how Ling Ran’s current intake of patients in the Orthopedic Department was mainly recommended to him by others.

However, if Ling Ran wanted to perform choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct at Yun Hua Hospital, it was inevitable that he needed the help from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
He did not ask for quantity. He wanted to first get two patients to try out his Perfect Level Skill, and the easiest way would be looking for Zhang Anmin.
Ling Ran looked at his watch, thought about it, and said, “Ask Zhang Anmin to come and find me when he comes for work.”

“Alright.” Zuo Cidian looked at Ling Ran’s expression and felt inexplicably dissatisfied. He could not help but said, “Doctor Ling, you’ll get the same results if you give us your orders as well. After all, Doctor Zhang is from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, and he hasn’t agreed to transfer over here.”
“We’re going to be talking about bile-duct related surgery.” Ling Ran walked and entered one of the wards.
Zuo Cidian was left behind. He looked gloomy.
He blocked Lu Wenbin, who was at the back as well, and he whispered, “Young Lu, you’re the eldest disciple. This can’t continue.”

Lu Wenbin nodded. “Yes. It is strictly forbidden to smoke in the ward. The cigarettes given by the visitors should be brought home by the family members. It’ll be a headache-inducing problem if it is placed in the ward. There are always some patients who cannot hold back from their urges.”
Zuo Cidian stared at Lu Wenbin and sighed. “You’re the eldest disciple, not Eldest Disciple Sun Wukong.”

“Huh?” Lu Wenbin was surprised. “You used to call me the eldest disciple, and I always thought that you’re referring to Ling Huchong... I do not wish to continue this conversation if you’re referring to Journey to the West.”
Zuo Cidian stared at Lu Wenbin with a stern look, like an old hound staring at the young hound. Then, he slowly said, “Who are the masters for Ling Huchong and Sun Wukong?”
The hair on Lu Wenbin’s neck slowly stopped bristling. “Oh, just what was I saying... I was saying that I’m actually a monkey... What are you trying to say?”

“Doctor Ling was asking for Zhang Anmin again. Doctor Ling is performing more surgeries for the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery now. In this case, Zhang Anmin is gradually becoming more important than you, eldest disciple.” Zuo Cidian gently patted Lu Wenbin and said, “Let’s chat privately. Previously, Zhang Anmin was not an authorized doctor in the Emergency Department. At most, he was just a helper. If we don’t think of a way, he might overtake us soon.”
“Think... of what way?” Lu Wenbin looked at Zuo Cidian doubtfully.

“What are you thinking?” Zuo Cidian snorted and said, “Judging from my experience, when it comes to these matters, we either suppress him or support him. Since our small treatment group is small, why don’t we just keep supporting Zhang Anmin?”
Lu Wenbin’s expression finally settled down, and he asked curiously, “How do we support him?”

“We support him in becoming an assistant lecturer for the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery,” Zuo Cidian said relaxedly, but deep in his heart, he was very jealous of him. He continued and said, “All assistant lecturers in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery have left, and now, there is only one remaining. Zhang Anmin has been working for a decade, so it’s time for him to be promoted to an assistant lecturer.”

“There’s a huge difference to it, you know?” Lu Wenbin was a bit jealous as well, but he felt more surprised. “There are still a few better attending physicians before Zhang Anmin, and all of them have a close relationship with He Yuanzheng. So, it’s impossible for Zhang Anmin to be promoted.”
Zuo Cidian shook his head and said to Lu Wenbin, “If you’re at our town hospital, you will be sent to the villages in three days’ time.”
Lu Wenbin did not quite understand, so he looked at Zuo Cidian.

“Whether He Yuanzheng promotes his direct disciples is none of our business. Zhang Anmin still belongs to Doctor Ling at the end of the day.” Zuo Cidian pursed his lips and showed an expression that said, ‘Did you understand?’
Lu Wenbin still did not get it. “He... is the department director, so he does not need to listen to Doctor Ling.”
“It’s not the same now.” Zuo Cidian suddenly chuckled. “Our treatment group is rich now.”
“Hmm?”

“Theoretically, we can apply to build a Second Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.” Zuo Cidian looked excited. “Do you know what is the concept of making the hospital beds empty three times a month? The surgery volume of our treatment group in a month is He Yuanzheng’s surgery volume in a year. Since we are rich, even if we want to build a Second Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, He Yuanzheng would not be able to stop us.”
Lu Wenbin frowned. “Does Doctor Ling have this thought?”

“Doctor Ling does not, but I’m sure He Yuanzheng has. Go threaten him, and we can send away Zhang Anmin as well.” Zuo Cidian sighed. “We finished almost all the workload from the two-and-a-half-day leave company. It’s quite hard to say if we can still get such a good group of patients. It’s such a waste to not use the authority given because it will eventually expire.”
“Will Doctor Ling agree with this?”

“Doctor Ling does not care about all this. Besides, if Zhang Anmin becomes an assistant lecturer, he can get more patients through his consultation. He’ll be more useful than He Yuanzheng, and Doctor Ling will definitely be happy with this.”

Lu Wenbin never thought that a treatment group attached to the Emergency Medical Center could affect the appointment of an assistant lecturer from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. However, Lu Wenbin could not find any flaws from Zuo Cidian’s explanation, and he had to accept it.
Lu Wenbin could not help but shook his head and looked at Zuo Cidian. He said with a guilty conscience, “Doctor Zuo, you really think far ahead into the future.”

“It’s easy to think about these things, but carrying them out is hard.” Zuo Cidian sighed, laughed at himself, and said, “Do you think that He Yuanzheng can’t think of what I thought? Did you think that he would never expect himself to be lousy? What do you think about the concept of our treatment group being able to perform two hundred surgeries in a month? This is a suppression in terms of productivity!”
Lu Wenbin nodded and shook his head. “You’re right in terms of us suppressing them in terms of productivity. Two hundred surgeries a month is not easy to do!”
After Lu Wenbin finished, he laughed.
Zuo Cidian could not help but laugh too. He raised his head again and saw Ling Ran come out of the ward. Both of them immediately followed.
*Thud thud thud thud thud.*
The sounds of footsteps at the corridor of the Emergency Medical Center at Yun Hua Hospital rang out, matching the beat of their hearts.

“Not back to work yet?” Ling Ran asked.
“Oh...” He looked disappointed.
‘Choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct’ was a standard surgery in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
Normally, the Emergency Department would not deal with such a case.
Biliary obstruction does not simply occur in a day.
Patients who knew about this would usually go for specialist departments when they needed to receive the surgery, and they would not go to the Emergency Department.
However, in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, there were more patients with indications for choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct.
With the high reputation of Yun Hua Hospital, some patients with mild indications might not even be admitted.
It was likely that patients with mere biliary obstruction would be transferred to other hospitals.
Department Director He Yuanzheng of the field of hepatobiliary and pancreatic surgery originally came from other hospitals.
Since his focus was mainly on the liver, it was normal for him to transfer the patients with gallbladder and bile duct diseases to doctors that he was familiar with.
This was similar to how Ling Ran’s current intake of patients in the Orthopedic Department was mainly recommended to him by others.

However, if Ling Ran wanted to perform choledochoduodenostomy of the common bile duct at Yun Hua Hospital, it was inevitable that he needed the help from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
He did not ask for quantity.
He wanted to first get two patients to try out his Perfect Level Skill, and the easiest way would be looking for Zhang Anmin.
Ling Ran looked at his watch, thought about it, and said, “Ask Zhang Anmin to come and find me when he comes for work.”
“Alright.” Zuo Cidian looked at Ling Ran’s expression and felt inexplicably dissatisfied.
He could not help but said, “Doctor Ling, you’ll get the same results if you give us your orders as well.
After all, Doctor Zhang is from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, and he hasn’t agreed to transfer over here.”
“We’re going to be talking about bile-duct related surgery.” Ling Ran walked and entered one of the wards.
Zuo Cidian was left behind.
He looked gloomy.
He blocked Lu Wenbin, who was at the back as well, and he whispered, “Young Lu, you’re the eldest disciple.
This can’t continue.”
Lu Wenbin nodded.
“Yes.
It is strictly forbidden to smoke in the ward.
The cigarettes given by the visitors should be brought home by the family members.
It’ll be a headache-inducing problem if it is placed in the ward.
There are always some patients who cannot hold back from their urges.”
Zuo Cidian stared at Lu Wenbin and sighed.
“You’re the eldest disciple, not Eldest Disciple Sun Wukong.”
“Huh?” Lu Wenbin was surprised.
“You used to call me the eldest disciple, and I always thought that you’re referring to Ling Huchong...
I do not wish to continue this conversation if you’re referring to Journey to the West.”
Zuo Cidian stared at Lu Wenbin with a stern look, like an old hound staring at the young hound.
Then, he slowly said, “Who are the masters for Ling Huchong and Sun Wukong?”
The hair on Lu Wenbin’s neck slowly stopped bristling.
“Oh, just what was I saying...
I was saying that I’m actually a monkey...
What are you trying to say?”
“Doctor Ling was asking for Zhang Anmin again.
Doctor Ling is performing more surgeries for the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery now.
In this case, Zhang Anmin is gradually becoming more important than you, eldest disciple.” Zuo Cidian gently patted Lu Wenbin and said, “Let’s chat privately.
Previously, Zhang Anmin was not an authorized doctor in the Emergency Department.
At most, he was just a helper.
If we don’t think of a way, he might overtake us soon.”
“Think... of what way?” Lu Wenbin looked at Zuo Cidian doubtfully.
“What are you thinking?” Zuo Cidian snorted and said, “Judging from my experience, when it comes to these matters, we either suppress him or support him.
Since our small treatment group is small, why don’t we just keep supporting Zhang Anmin?”
Lu Wenbin’s expression finally settled down, and he asked curiously, “How do we support him?”
“We support him in becoming an assistant lecturer for the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery,” Zuo Cidian said relaxedly, but deep in his heart, he was very jealous of him.
He continued and said, “All assistant lecturers in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery have left, and now, there is only one remaining.
Zhang Anmin has been working for a decade, so it’s time for him to be promoted to an assistant lecturer.”
“There’s a huge difference to it, you know?” Lu Wenbin was a bit jealous as well, but he felt more surprised.
“There are still a few better attending physicians before Zhang Anmin, and all of them have a close relationship with He Yuanzheng.
So, it’s impossible for Zhang Anmin to be promoted.”
Zuo Cidian shook his head and said to Lu Wenbin, “If you’re at our town hospital, you will be sent to the villages in three days’ time.”
Lu Wenbin did not quite understand, so he looked at Zuo Cidian.
“Whether He Yuanzheng promotes his direct disciples is none of our business.
Zhang Anmin still belongs to Doctor Ling at the end of the day.” Zuo Cidian pursed his lips and showed an expression that said, ‘Did you understand?’
Lu Wenbin still did not get it.
“He... is the department director, so he does not need to listen to Doctor Ling.”
“It’s not the same now.” Zuo Cidian suddenly chuckled.
“Our treatment group is rich now.”
“Hmm?”
“Theoretically, we can apply to build a Second Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.” Zuo Cidian looked excited.
“Do you know what is the concept of making the hospital beds empty three times a month?
The surgery volume of our treatment group in a month is He Yuanzheng’s surgery volume in a year.
Since we are rich, even if we want to build a Second Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, He Yuanzheng would not be able to stop us.”
Lu Wenbin frowned.
“Does Doctor Ling have this thought?”
“Doctor Ling does not, but I’m sure He Yuanzheng has.
Go threaten him, and we can send away Zhang Anmin as well.” Zuo Cidian sighed.
“We finished almost all the workload from the two-and-a-half-day leave company.
It’s quite hard to say if we can still get such a good group of patients.
It’s such a waste to not use the authority given because it will eventually expire.”
“Will Doctor Ling agree with this?”
“Doctor Ling does not care about all this.
Besides, if Zhang Anmin becomes an assistant lecturer, he can get more patients through his consultation.
He’ll be more useful than He Yuanzheng, and Doctor Ling will definitely be happy with this.”

Lu Wenbin never thought that a treatment group attached to the Emergency Medical Center could affect the appointment of an assistant lecturer from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
However, Lu Wenbin could not find any flaws from Zuo Cidian’s explanation, and he had to accept it.
Lu Wenbin could not help but shook his head and looked at Zuo Cidian.
He said with a guilty conscience, “Doctor Zuo, you really think far ahead into the future.”
“It’s easy to think about these things, but carrying them out is hard.” Zuo Cidian sighed, laughed at himself, and said, “Do you think that He Yuanzheng can’t think of what I thought?
Did you think that he would never expect himself to be lousy?
What do you think about the concept of our treatment group being able to perform two hundred surgeries in a month?
This is a suppression in terms of productivity!”
Lu Wenbin nodded and shook his head.
“You’re right in terms of us suppressing them in terms of productivity.
Two hundred surgeries a month is not easy to do!”
After Lu Wenbin finished, he laughed.
Zuo Cidian could not help but laugh too.
He raised his head again and saw Ling Ran come out of the ward.
Both of them immediately followed.
*Thud thud thud thud thud.*
The sounds of footsteps at the corridor of the Emergency Medical Center at Yun Hua Hospital rang out, matching the beat of their hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 793 Mock
paragraphs: Zhang Anmin arrived at the hospital just in time. He went inside the office of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery and put on a large white coat. He then took his bag and left.
“Young Zhang, are you heading to the Emergency Department?” Duan Yiwen, a senior attending physician who was standing behind him, asked mockingly.

Duan Yiwen entered the hospital three years earlier than Zhang Anmin. He could be considered Zhang Anmin’s superior whether it was when he was a resident doctor or after he became an attending physician. Even though both of them were attending physicians now, Duan Yiwen still ordered Zhang Anmin around all the time.

However, for the past year, Zhang Anmin had become more and more reluctant to be ordered around. He was mainly focusing on Ling Treatment Group and Bazhaixiang, and no longer spent much time in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. Of course Duan Yiwen did not have many opportunities to order him around anymore.

This made Duan Yiwen rather annoyed. However, he was no longer Zhang Anmin’s superior, and they did not even have the opportunity to operate on patients together anymore. Hence, Duan Yiwen could do nothing but mock Zhang Anmin with a scornful expression every now and then.
A few resident doctors in the office played along with Duan Yiwen and chuckled a few times. But no one said anything.

Everyone wanted to give face to Duan Yiwen, but they did not see the need to offend Zhang Anmin. If they were to side with Duan Yiwen, they would be going up against Zhang Anmin. And right now, as Zhang Anmin was working with Ling Ran, he was more of a subject of envy compared to Duan Yiwen.
Zhang Anmin, too, smiled and did not argue with Duan Yiwen.
Even though both of them were attending physicians, he would never win against Duan Yiwen in an argument.

Zhang Anmin lowered his head and walked out of the office. Duan Yiwen who was standing behind him snorted scornfully. “You’re getting paid by the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, but you’re working for the Emergency Medical Center. You’re seriously a traitor.”
The resident doctors who did not dare to mock Zhang Anmin openly just now started playing
along.
“He’s playing up to someone of power and influence, okay?”
“In the past, he still bothered to work in our department for a few hours every day and put on a front.”
“Things are different for him now since Ling Ran’s backing him up.”
“Truth be told, our department director really has a good temper. If we had a fiercer department director, he would have flown into a rage at Zhang Anmin.”
Zhang Anmin pretended that he did not hear anything. Internally, he shook his head scornfully.

He Yuanzheng was never known as someone with a good temper. Not many good-tempered surgeons existed in this world. It was just that He Yuanzheng was not powerful enough to throw a tantrum regarding this matter. Duan Yiwen might be a direct subordinate of He Yuanzheng, but He Yuanzheng was not directly related to any of the higher-ups in Yun Hua Hospital.

Of course, a person could look at the situation another way. It was precisely because Zhang Anmin was not a close subordinate of He Yuanzheng that he was having such a hard time in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery.
At the Operating Area of the Emergency Medical Center.
Zhang Anmin was thirty minutes late. He headed straight to the Operating Area and looked at his schedule.

These days, he mostly spent his days operating with Ling Ran. During more idle days, he would participate in three surgeries a day. Meanwhile, on busy days, he would need to operate on more than six patients a day. His schedule was considered quite a relaxing one, as he mostly participated in laparoscopy. Even in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, it was quite normal for doctors to participate in five or six laparoscopic cholecystectomy or appendectomy a day.
Of course, it was still quite rare for a doctor to participate in so many surgeries a day, and this was mainly because they could not find so many patients.
Zhang Anmin placed his fingertip on the surgery schedule that was printed on a piece of A4 paper. He slid his finger across the paper and muttered internally. ‘Hepatectomy, hepatectomy...

Hepatectomy was a lot more difficult than cholecystectomy. To Zhang Anmin, it felt more tiring to participate in one or two hepatectomy a day compared to carrying out five or six laparoscopic cholecystectomy a day, a lot more tiring.
Hepatectomy was more arduous and tiring, and Zhang Anmin could make less money from it. However, he preferred to carry out hepatectomy.
Only by carrying out difficult surgeries could a person grow, and growth was what every surgeon aimed for.

When it came to surgeons in China, everyone only paid attention to associate chief physicians and chief physicians. Only after becoming an associate chief physician could a surgeon reap the fruits of his labor. And when a surgeon became a chief physician, his trees would be unquestionably covered in fat and juicy fruits.

It was very normal for a chief physician working in a tertiary Grade A hospital in China to earn more than American doctors of the same age group. And if that surgeon successfully became a department director, he would get paid a lot more and get treated a lot better compared to foreign specialists of the same age group.

Zhang Anmin reckoned that if he continued working under Ling Ran, or if he got even luckier and found an opportunity to become part of Ling Treatment Group, he would be able to get promoted within three or four years.

It was Zhang Anmin’s primary aim to not be limited by his skills when that happened. Of course, it would be even better if he could become so good at hepatectomy that he could carry out freelance surgeries.
“Young Zhang, you’re a little late, aren’t you?” At some point of time, Zuo Cidian had entered the waiting room of the Operating Area too.
Zhang Anmin froze for a moment. In the past, Zuo Cidian had always called him “Doctor Zhang”.
Zhang Anmin raised his head and looked at Zuo Cidian’s face, which was so full of wrinkles that it looked like a steamed bun that had fallen to the ground. He then forced himself to reply, “Old Zuo.”
“I have something to discuss with you.” Zuo Cidian wore a smile on his face, and he looked at Zhang Anmin with a kindly expression. It was as if he was looking at his own nephew.

Zhang Anmin was not really used to the situation, but he hummed in acknowledgement. He then glanced at the piece of A4 paper on the wall and said with a cold expression. “I have a surgery scheduled soon.”

This reply was not only an answer to Zuo Cidian’s question, but it also showcased Zhang Anmin’s current attitude and mood. At the same time, it also put to rest Zuo Cidian’s accusation that he was “a little late”. This was considered the best reply that Zhang Anmin could come out with.
Internally, Zhang Anmin was even a little pleased with himself.
Zuo Cidian gave Zhang Anmin a sidelong glance and asked, “Do you want to become an associate chief physician?”
Zhang Anmin’s mind immediately stopped working. A few seconds later, he said in a show of wisdom, “Yes.”
Zuo Cidian smiled. “Then, I’ll talk to you about it. Doctor Zhang, you’re free, aren’t you?”

“Of course. Since you want to talk to me, I’ll have to make myself available no matter what. Also, why don’t you just call me ‘Young Zhang’?” Zhang Anmin was fully utilizing his ability to yield to other people when the time was right. At home, he was the type of person who would kneel down if other people asked him to, and he had no problem doing the same at work too. Since he only had to do so in speech right now, things were even easier for him.
Naturally, Zuo Cidian flashed a smile.
Ling Ran did not have a clue when it came to what Zuo Cidian and his other subordinates were planning. He did not bother to find out either.
He merely operated quietly on the patient at his own pace.

The surgeries he carried out lately were relatively simple, but Ling Ran believed that he could learn something from each surgery. This was especially true when it came to cholecystectomy as he learned it from scratch. Hence, he had to put more thought into this surgical method as well as gain more experience.

Ling Ran operated on patients in a leisurely manner until night fell, but he still ended up completing seven surgeries. This allowed him to fill up the empty hospital beds in the wards a little. Those busy patients who worked in big companies were getting discharged two and a half days after their surgeries, which was seriously quick. Because of this, Ling Ran was unable to fill up the wards as much as he wanted to.
“Doctor Ling, I’ve called a cab. Let’s get going.” The moment Ma Yanlin got off work, he immediately rushed over to remind Ling Ran of their appointment.
Since the appointment was made beforehand, Ma Yanlin did not have to say much.
Ling Ran closed his eyes and rested throughout the journey. After arriving at Shao’s family restaurant, he stretched and sized up the shop. It had been quite a while since he came over.
“Where’s the staff member who used to grill our meat?” Ling Ran was very sensitive to changes.
“He’s sick.” Boss Shao walked over with a smile. “I have sent all my other staff members for a physical examination, and they’re in the pink of health.”
“What illness is he suffering from?” Ling Ran inquired.
Boss Shao hesitated for a moment and said, “An eating disorder.”

Boss Shao then immediately made it a point to explain. “It’s not because the food in my shop is bad. It’s because he was admitted into the hospital for quite a few times and ended up developing an eating disorder because of the medication he took.”

chapters.title: Chapter 794: White Bamboo Rat
paragraphs: Ling Treatment Group had organized a group gathering today. Hence, aside from Ma Yanlin, Lu Wenbin, and the other resident doctors, the three housemen and five medical interns who were temporarily in the group and often tasked with the miscellaneous showed up too.

Among the three housemen, Qu Xiaolian was the only one who had already passed the board examination and was an authorized doctor. Hence, he had already set a foundation for himself to stay in Yun Hua Hospital or even Ling Treatment Group. He was also a little more attentive compared to the two other housemen, and right now, he was putting plenty of effort into attending to his superiors.

Zuo Cidian was very used to ordering housemen and medical interns around. Since no one was saying anything, he whispered to Zhang Anmin who was sitting beside him, “After you become an associate chief physician, you can get yourself a few underlings. Things will be a lot more convenient and comfortable for you in the future, Associate Chief Physician Zhang.”
Zhang Anmin looked around anxiously. He quickly said, “Let’s not count our chickens before they hatch...”

“Why not? The eggs are already in your pen, anyway,” Zuo Cidian said and smiled. “You don’t have to worry about other people finding out about this. Things will be fine as long as Doctor Ling agrees to our plan.”
“We don’t even know what’s on Department Director Huo’s mind yet...”
“This has nothing to do with him,” Zuo Cidian said crisply.
The moment he finished speaking, Zuo Cidian felt good.
This was the euphoria he had been yearning for ever since he was working in a town hospital. His wish finally came true today.
Zuo Cidian could not help but glance at Ling Ran. He lined up all the wrinkles on his face in an effort to smile beautifully. “Doctor Ling, do you want a fat or thin bamboo rat?”
“Go ahead and choose what you want.” Ling Ran did not seem to care. He was not particular when it came to bamboo rats.
Zuo Cidian hummed in acknowledgement. He then rose in a natural manner and said to Zhang Anmin, “Why don’t the two of us go ahead and pick a bamboo rat?”
Zhang Anmin froze for a moment. He then immediately voiced his agreement and followed Zuo Cidian.
Zuo Cidian called Boss Shao as he took large strides. All of them walked toward where the bamboo rats were kept.

Zhang Anmin watched Zuo Cidian from the back. Zuo Cidian was only of average height, was a little plump, and had a bit of an ugly stance when he walked. His back was hunched, and he really could not be considered a good looking man. However, at that moment, he gave off an extraordinarily steady aura that put Zhang Anmin at ease.

“Young Zhang, come over and choose a bamboo rat.” Zuo Cidian walked toward the cage with all the bamboo rats inside and lowered his head to look at the gray, fat and dumb-looking bamboo rats. He waved as he called out to Zhang Anmin, “You’re young, so your eyesight is better than mine. Do choose a healthy-looking bamboo rat.”

“This is the biggest one in the cage, and its fur looks lustrous.” Zhang Anmin pointed at one of the bamboo rats. Boss Shao then extended his hand into the cage and grabbed the bamboo rat out by its tail.
“Quite a good choice.” Zuo Cidian smiled.

“It’s very important to make the right choice.” Zhang Anmin immediately played along. He was not the kind of person who would usually rack his brains to come up with the right words. However, Zuo Cidian made him an offer he could hardly refuse, and his mind was automatically working hard to please Zuo Cidian.

Zuo Cidian smiled again. He started his career in a town hospital, but he did not have the habit of hiding things from other people. Right now, he did not see the need to beat around the bush with Zhang Anmin at all. So, he went straight to the point. “Just give a good thought to how you will serve Doctor Ling after you become an associate chief physician. There’s no point talking about other things.”
“That’s for sure.” After ruminating about the matter all day, Zhang Anmin had already thought about this. He quickly said, “I will definitely give priority to the Emergency Medical Center...”
“Why? Won’t you be part of the Emergency Department anymore after becoming an associate chief physician?” Zuo Cidian glanced at Zhang Anmin.
Zhang Anmin was taken aback. “No. Why would that be so? I just haven’t gotten used to the mentality yet. I’m definitely part of the Emergency Medical Center.”
“That’s right. So you don’t need to worry about who you’re going to give priority to, do you?” Zuo Cidian immediately adjusted Zhang Anmin’s mentality in a brutal manner like a true town cadre.

Zhang Anmin was used to Zuo Cidian’s style, though. Surgeons were brutes to begin with, so it did not take much for him to get used to the way Zuo Cidian did things. Truth be told, Zhang Anmin sort of liked what Zuo Cidian had said too. He enunciated each word clearly to emphasize his point as he replied, “I have always been Doctor Ling’s man. This will not change whether I become an associate chief physician or not.”
“This was what I meant.” Zuo Cidian nodded.

“But I’m a bit worried. We’re doing things in such a blatant manner. Will it... backfire?” Zhang Anmin could be said to have been a victim to He Yuanzheng’s authority throughout the few years he had been working for him, so he was experiencing quite a lot of complicated emotions right now.

Zuo Cidian was extremely calm as he pointed at another bamboo rat. He then said, “About Department Director He, he will definitely be unhappy about it. But as long as he figures things out, he will realize that there’s nothing that he can do.”
Zhang Anmin’s expression changed. “What do you mean by that?”
“We have the funds, and we have people backing us up. He Yuanzheng won’t act barbarically.”
“Department Director He is quite a barbarian sometimes,” Zhang Anmin said in a hushed tone.
“Let him be a barbarian, then,” Zuo Cidian said nonchalantly, “Does he really think that we don’t dare to start a second Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery?”
Zhang Anmin was shocked. “Will we?”
“No,” Zuo Cidian said.
Zhang Anmin was astounded.

“But if Department Director Huo really resorts to this, it’ll be obvious where he stands. At that time, what do you think that Department Director Huo and Ling Treatment Group would do? As he said this, Zuo Cidian’s expression became a little more stern. “This is how the situation’s like right now. Half of the surgeries in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery right now are done by you and Doctor Ling, right? Without these surgeries, the staff members of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery would probably get thirty percent less bonus than they do now. Do you think that Department Director He’s subordinates would still respect him if they were to get a pay cut?”
Zhang Anmin nodded slowly. He then quickly said, “Doctor Ling’s the one who’s doing all the work. It doesn’t have much to do with me.”

He finally understood that He Yuanzheng had actually been driven into a corner. He could not help but feel even more at ease. He also had a newfound realization about why all the chief physicians and associate chief physicians strive hard to carry out more surgeries and conduct more research. If a doctor were not skillful, especially in situations where other doctors were superior to him in all forms, he would basically be up against a wall.
“Give me a white bamboo rat too.” Zuo Cidian pointed at an adorable bamboo rat who was standing at the corner of the cage.
“White bamboo rats are more expensive. They’re 40 RMB more expensive per pound,” Boss Shao reminded him.
Zuo Cidian nodded and asked, “Why are they 40 RMB more expensive?”
“Because they’re beautiful.”
“But it’s not like we get to see the bamboo rat’s color when it’s served, right?”
Boss Shao froze for a moment. “You can take a photograph and send it to your friends. Or I can use the printer in my shop to print you a photograph. The lighting here is pretty good.”
As Boss Shao spoke, he grabbed the white bamboo rat and walked to an illuminated eave.
The bamboo rat’s white fur sparkled under the yellow lights.
Zuo Cidian was still hesitating when Zhang Anmin whipped out his phone to take a proper picture of the bamboo rat.
“Doctor Zuo.” Zhang Anmin showed the photograph to Zuo Cidian.

“Quite a nice photograph. It looks like something that would be placed in front of the bamboo rat’s coffin after it dies.” Zuo Cidian nodded and said to Boss Shao, “We have taken a photograph. You can throw the bamboo rat back into the cage.”
Boss Shao nodded. “I’ll have to trouble you guys to bandage this scratch for me later.”
As he spoke, Boss Shao threw the bamboo rat into a small cage. There was a red streak of blood on the bamboo rat’s fur.

“It scratched your hand?” Zhang Anmin glared at the white bamboo rat. “Which leg did it scratch you with? Don’t forget to grill that leg and eat it for nourishment so that your wound will heal quickly.”
“I didn’t get scratched by this one. It was the first one.” Boss Shao shook his head and defended the white bamboo rat.
“Wow, and you are able to endure the pain for such a long time?” Zhang Anmin was surprised.
“I’m used to it.” Boss Shao flashed a smile, and he looked like a boss who had been selling bamboo rats for eight months.

chapters.title: Chapter 795: Whip
paragraphs: Insert the needle, tighten the suture, and push the needle out again...
“It’s done.” After Ling Ran tied the knot and cut the thread, naturally, someone came up and bandaged Boss Shao.
At the same time, Zuo Cidian and other doctors all applauded excitedly.
“I saw Doctor Ling doing debridement and suturing again.”
“It’s so rare. Doctor Ling did a great job.”
“I hope that one day I can do just one tenth of what Doctor Ling did today.”
The last sentence that Qu Xiaolian said attracted a lot of attention.

Ma Yanlin and Lu Wenbin exchanged a look. ‘Time makes it inevitable that in every profession, the young shall replace the old. The young people today are incredible. I remember that back in the days, we didn’t know how to make flattering remarks like that, and we wouldn’t even think of doing so. The youngsters these days are already so straightforward in their flattery even when they are at the age of housemen. If we were to say it to someone else, I’d think that some people may not believe it. They might even think that doctors all spew nonsense and make wild assumptions while looking into other people’s eyes.’
Yu Yuan also clapped a few times, raised her head a bit, and looked at Ma Yanlin before turning to Lu Wenbin. She was like a wild radio station stealing signals.

A few female customers also came to gather around Ling Ran. They comforted Boss Shao, “Are you Doctor Ling? Doctor Ling, your technique is really good, Boss Shao is so lucky. With such a good doctor around, there’s no need to be afraid even if we’re wounded. If we were outside ourselves, we wouldn’t even be able to find any bandages... ”
Boss Shao looked at his fingers. “The bandages were from my shop.”
“If it weren’t for Doctor Ling, it would be useless even if you have a bandage. If it’s not carefully disinfected, you may need to amputate it.”
Boss Shao looked at his fingers. “The disinfectant is from my store.”
The female customer said, “The threads for the stitches...”
Boss Shao said, “From my shop.”
The female customer said, “Gauze and tweezers ...”
Boss Shao said, “From my shop.”
It was not until the waiter started serving the dishes that the customers reluctantly left Ling Ran’s table one after another.
Qu Xiaolian obediently helped set the table, and asked diligently, “Would you like to drink?”

“He doesn’t drink.” Zuo Cidian did not even have to ask Ling Ran and answered on his behalf, “Doctor Ling doesn’t like drinking, and in addition, he will go back to continue performing surgery very soon.”
Ling Ran waved his hand. “There will be no surgery at night. Everyone can go back and rest well.”
Qu Xiaolian smiled involuntarily.
Lu Wenbin glanced at Qu Xiaolian and laughed. “Doctor Ling said that he would not have surgery at night, but that does not mean that he wouldn’t have surgery the next morning.”
Ma Yanlin also said, “Three hepatectomies are scheduled tomorrow morning. Doctor Ling, what time should we start tomorrow morning?”

“Tomorrow, we can start a bit later. Let’s start at 5:30.” Ling Ran made some calculations. The average hepatectomy was one and a half hours. But if he were a little lenient in his estimations and estimated that he required two hours for one surgery, he would need six hours for three operations. By starting at half past five and ending at half past eleven, there would still be half an hour of free time before lunch time.

Of course, this was a calculation method for major surgeries, because patients undergoing hepatectomy must be prepared in advance, and the Department of Anesthesiology must also cooperate with them. Therefore, if it were not an emergency operation, it was necessary to be lenient in their calculations so as to avoid insufficient time, improper operating theater arrangements, and other such problems.

In practice, if the operation was performed smoothly and quickly, Ling Ran can insert other minor operations in between, such as cholecystitis or appendicitis surgery, which can usually be completed in thirty minutes. If he only performed the essence of the surgery, which was the middle part of the surgery, he can easily finish an appendectomy in ten minutes, and it will still be at Specialist Level.
Lu Wenbin was still stealing glances at Qu Xiaolian, and when he saw that he was no longer smiling, he finally laughed. “This is Doctor Ling’s style, he likes to get up early.”
“Speaking of time. Everyone, please don’t be late tomorrow.” Zuo Cidian reminded the housemen and medical interns, and his eyes were especially on the medical interns.
Hospitals had fewer restrictions on medical interns than housemen. Furthermore, medical interns who had just left school had not been beaten by society and were not easily intimidated.
Zuo Cidian felt that he still had an obligation to raise his whip.
The medical interns and housemen who did not want to be beaten all nodded obediently and promised to not be late.

Zuo Cidian smiled, raised his glass, and said, “I’ll substitute tea with wine, and I propose that everyone have a drink together so that we are able to gather in the same department and be under Doctor Ling’s flag...”
As he made some small talk, he completed the necessary steps on the table, and he no longer pushed Ling Ran to speak or do anything else, which made Ling Ran and everyone feel quite comfortable.
No matter how strong the rules in heaven were, Doctor Ling’s rules were naturally the most powerful in Doctor Ling’s territory.
A plate of lamb chops and several barrels of tripe were brought to the table, and everyone became relaxed.
A medical intern whispered at this time, “Doctor Zuo, you just mentioned something about not being late, but the usual working time in a hospital is 8 o’clock...”
“Yes.” Zuo Cidian smiled.
“We don’t have to be there at half past four, right?” The medical intern showed a smile. “I thought it was compulsory for everyone...”
“You can come at that time, too.” Zuo Cidian’s tone remained unchanged.
The medical intern froze.
When he wanted to ask, Zuo Cidian turned his head around, waved his hand, and shouted, “Waiter, I would like to order a few more dishes.”
The intern looked worriedly at his senior doctor, Lu Wenbin, whom he was more familiar with, and whispered, “Doctor Lu, exactly what time should I arrive?”
“You can come anytime you want to.” Lu Wenbin gave an accurate answer.
The medical interns and housemen looked at each other with a seemingly understanding look and did not speak again.

Lu Wenbin and Zuo Cidian also looked at each other and did not speak. The time to arrive at the hospital in the morning was the entry barrier for Ling Ran’s treatment group. In the hospital, especially in the Department of Surgery’s reception room, the habits of the treatment group’s leader was the most significant rule. Young doctors can only follow and adapt to those habits. Some surgeons liked to perform surgeries in the morning, some surgeons liked to perform surgery at night, some abnormal and mad doctors liked to perform in the afternoon, that was not forgetting about the surgeons who liked to perform surgeries from morning to night.

For low-level junior doctors, the ones who can cooperate should cooperate with the senior doctors, and they can be considered to be fighting for an opportunity. If they cannot cooperate, there would not be any regrets either. Most medical interns cannot stay in top grade hospitals like Yun Hua Hospital. They just continuously recruited medical interns to do hard labor. There were relatively more opportunities for housemen, but if they were not able to get in through an examination or get authorized, the chance of staying in Yun Hua Hospital was not great, and the chance of staying in a strong department was even smaller.

At present, Qu Xiaolian wanted to stay in Yun Hua Emergency Medical Center the most. As for the remaining two housemen and the medical interns, it was very difficult for them to stay in Yun Hua Hospital. Hence, no one, including Zuo Cidian, would forcefully request them to come to the hospital at dawn.
“Hello, do you want to order more food?” The waiter bashfully walked over while holding the menu.
Ma Yanlin, who had just returned from Brazil, smiled when he saw the waiter’s appearance, and asked, “Do you have hemorrhoids?”
The waiter frowned. “Please order from the menu.”

chapters.title: Chapter 796: Reveal All the Details
paragraphs: Sunday was bright and breezy.
The sky was blue.
The sun shone brightly.
The atmosphere in Yun Hua Hospital was remotely peaceful, and it was an extraordinary peace. When the doctors and nurses walked into the Emergency Medicine building, they slowed down for some reason.

The debridement room was empty. There was just a stainless steel basin by the side complaining about how unfair fate was because of the blood stains at its edges. ‘We’re all stainless steel basins. Some are used by pretty nurses for cooking instant noodles, some are filled with tumors by the handsome nurses, some are used by professional orthopedists to cook femurs, but some can only stay in the debridement room to receive broken glasses with some of a ruffian’s flesh attached to it, in the end, we might not even be cleaned carefully.’

“You over there, come over here.” Doctor Zhou tried hard to get a Sunday shift, and he was in a good mood. He waved his hand to call Houseman Qu Xiaolian and said, “Get an ECG monitor over for Bed 14. The patient was making a lot of noise just now.”
“Oh.” Qu Xiaolian obediently answered.

“Don’t be slow now. If it’s myocardial infarction, it’ll be troublesome. You know what the electrocardiogram for myocardial infarction looks like, right?” Doctor Zhou softened the young man up before throwing in the bait.
Just as he expected, Qu Xiaolian’s voice became slightly louder. “I know!”
“Go ahead then.” Doctor Zhou waved his hand before he settled back down on the chair.
Qu Xiaolian walked away rapidly. For housemen, the electrocardiograms for myocardial infarction were still very alluring, and not every doctor could view it during their housemanship.
Naturally, the period for housemanship was short, so there were a lot of things they might miss out on, but for youngsters, it was naturally good to experience more things.

Doctor Zhou only smiled calmly. The risk of myocardial infarction for Bed 14 was extremely small, but of course, it could not be completely eliminated. Therefore, they needed to do an electrocardiogram to check.

However, the situation now was most convenient. Doctor Zhou had deceived ten generations of housemen in the name of myocardial infarction. When he thought of the time he first invented this skill, he was still a resident doctor.
Doctor Zhou took a long breath and could not help but sigh sentimentally, “Just where did time fly to...?”
“Sucked away by the salted fish, I reckon.” Zhao Leyi sat over in a lackadaisical fashion.
Doctor Zhou turned around and asked Zhao Leyi, “Have you treated that patient?”
“Transferred to the Nephrology Department,” Zhao Leyi answered, “Renal insufficiency. Dialysis alone will not do anything.”

“Yep,” Doctor Zhou answered. He could not help but yawn, and he raised his head to take a glance around at the young, busy doctors. He shook his head and said, “If I continue working in such a busy fashion, I might get renal insufficiency myself.”

“You? Busy?” Zhao Leyi sneered. He heard no retort, and after a few seconds, he said, “Have you heard? He Yuanzheng from the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery has recommended Zhang Anmin for the position of assistant lecturer.”

“Zhang Anmin works for the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery. If He Yuanzheng wants to promote him, let him.” Doctor Zhou turned to another side to allow the rays of the sun, which were not very hot, to warm him up a little more.
Zhao Leyi sneered again. “Why are you still pretending? Zhang Anmin belongs to Ling Ran, and who in the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery and Emergency Department doesn’t know this?”
“So what?” Doctor Zhou asked.
Zhao Leyi was annoyed. Doctor Zhou and he were both attending physicians, and the title of associate chief physician has not appeared anywhere near them yet.
However, Zhao Leyi was not willing to bring this up. If he said it, he would make himself appear very weak.
Zhao Leyi could only say in a disdainful tone, “He Yuanzheng is a wimp.”
Doctor Zhou just smiled without answering.

The position of an assistant lecturer, which also meant that the doctor will be promoted to the position of associate chief physician as well, was the main goal among the doctors in the hospital, because not everyone was qualified to apply for the position of an assistant lecturer, especially doctors who were underqualified and were not outstanding. They would usually stop their advancement in their career at the level of an assistant lecturer.

But being an assistant lecturer was already good enough, especially those in tertiary Grade A hospitals. If they could work as the leader for a treatment group for a few years, even if they might not feel happy, their wives would still be happy. This was especially so for a doctor like Zhao Leyi. At least he could still enjoy a few years being happy and being respected.

Since associate chief physician was something everyone vied for, Doctor Zhou regarded it with very little importance. Once people start to pursue his position, even normal people would need to work so hard that their bodies will eventually collapse.
Zhao Leyi glanced at Doctor Zhou, and he said in displeasure, “You too.”
“What do the matters of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery have to do with us?”
“They’re using Old Huo’s resources.”
“What does that have to do with us again?”
Zhao Leyi had no retort for that.
Doctor Zhou chuckled again before he turned around, giving off the air that he did not want to continue the conversation.
At this time, Qu Xiaolian returned briskly. “Doctor Zhou, the electrocardiogram is out. The patient is fine.”
“Are you slightly disappointed?” Doctor Zhou raised his head and took a glance at Qu Xiaolian.
“Nope, no.” Qu Xiaolian quickly shook his head.
Doctor Zhou nodded. “That’s the right attitude. Doctors would rather have the medication on the rack expiring than using them. If there’s no problem with his electrocardiogram, it’s a good thing.”
Qu Xiaolian obediently nodded.
“Oh yes, you’ll need to tell those lab assistants to hurry up with the patient’s biochemical test, and it’ll be good if you can bring him for a B-Scan as well...”
Qu Xiaolian said in a low voice, “Doctor Zhou, someone in my family wants to come for a consultation, and I want to bring them around.”

“Your family member is sick? Alright, go ahead then.” Doctor Zhou did not even ask about the sickness. After all, he was a doctor in the Emergency Department, so he was afraid that he would get the case if he asked.
But Zhao Leyi asked, “Which department are you going to?”
“It’s hemorrhoid. Doctor Ma and Doctor Yu said they could handle it,” Qu Xiaolian answered softly.
“Ling Ran’s treatment group is even desperate for hemorrhoid patients now?” Zhao Leyi took the opportunity to mock them.

Qu Xiaolian pretended as if he did not understand what he said. He said, “Doctor Yu and Doctor Ma have performed quite a number of hemorrhoid surgeries recently, and their performance is pretty good.”
Zhao Leyi waved his hand and looked like he was too lazy to even say anything.
Qu Xiaolian immediately turned around. He felt that the atmosphere in the room had become depressing, and he was afraid that he would be blamed.
“Oh yea, where has Doctor Ling been? Went out for freelance surgery again?” Zhao Leyi’s cynical tone had not disappeared.
Qu Xiaolian quickly shook his head. “Doctor Ling is performing hepatectomy.”
“In the operating theater of the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery?”
“I’m not sure about the exact details.” Qu Xialian dared not answer a question like this.
Zhao Leyi snorted, “What’s not to be certain about this? He’s supporting Zhang Anmin.”
“In Operating Theater 1.” What Doctor Zhou said was Operating Theater 1 in the Emergency Medical Center.
Zhao Leyi turned around. “How do you know?”
“Just now, I saw the department director of the General Surgery Department from the Second People’s Hospital come out of it.” Doctor Zhou gestured with his chin to indicate the window.
Zhao Leyi’s eyelids twitched. “He’s working so hard?”
“Maybe Zhang Anmin is the chief surgeon?” Doctor Zhou’s tone was calm, but his gaze was sharp.
Zhao Leyi was stunned. “Impossible. How would Zhang Anmin have the courage to perform hepatectomy, and would he have the courage to have people watch him?”
“Why not?” Doctor Zhou questioned back.
Zhao Leyi frowned. “Zhang Anmin has never done this in the hospital before...”
“To whom do we show when we perform hepatectomy in our hospital?”

Zhao Leyi was rendered speechless. He hesitated for a few seconds before he firmly shook his head. “I know Zhang Anmin. He learned hepatectomy not too long ago, so what right does he have to be a chief surgeon?”
Doctor Zhou’s tone was cool. “If an expert teaches you everything and lets you learn a surgical method, a few months would be enough.”
